AI Sales Teams for Dental Practices

10x helps dental practices turn missed revenue opportunities into booked appointments. We connect to a practice’s patient database, identify overdue recalls, lapsed patients, and unscheduled treatment plans, then use AI calling and texting to bring those patients back into the chair.
10x.industry_sub_vertical: Dental practice patient reactivation & revenue recovery via AI outreach
10x.phenotype_primary_label: Vertical AI workflow agent (AI department for X)
10x.what_they_sell: AI-powered outreach system that automates patient recall, reactivation, and treatment plan follow-up for dental practices via voice calls and SMS, integrated with practice management systems.
10x.ai_play: AI agents (voice + text) autonomously identify revenue-recovery opportunities from practice data (overdue recalls, lapsed patients, unscheduled treatment plans) and execute outreach at scale, replacing manual patient coordinator labor and improving appointment booking conversion.

10x-science.name: 10x Science
10x-science.one_liner: The AI-native platform for next-generation protein characterization.
10x-science.description:
The AI-native platform for next-generation protein characterization.

10x Science develops frontier AI models with deep memory to redefine how scientists understand and engineer biology across the life sciences, starting with drug development.

AI-powered drug discovery is flooding the pipeline with new candidates faster than ever. But before any of them can advance to the clinic, scientists must deeply characterize the protein therapeutic to understand whether it will work. Today, that process takes months of manual, error-prone analysis that cannot keep pace with discovery. Our AI-native platform automates it, giving drug developers the confidence to advance the right candidates and stop the wrong ones early.

We have strong commercial traction with enterprise pharma customers. Our founding team built the field of next-generation protein characterization out of Carolyn Bertozzi's Nobel laureate lab at Stanford. Collectively, we have 18+ years of collective domain expertise, 47+ scientific publications, and a 2x YC Founder. We move at the highest velocity and are positioned to lead the next generation of modern AI development in the life sciences.
10x-science.industry_sub_vertical: AI-native protein characterization for drug discovery R&D
10x-science.phenotype_primary_label: Vertical AI workflow agent (AI department for X)
10x-science.what_they_sell: AI-native platform for protein characterization that automates the analysis required before drug candidates can advance to clinical trials
10x-science.ai_play: Frontier AI models with deep memory trained on protein biology to redefine how scientists understand and engineer therapeutics — built from Nobel laureate lab expertise in next-generation protein characterization

21st.name: 21st
21st.one_liner: Infrastructure and UI building blocks for the agentic internet
21st.description:
Infrastructure and UI building blocks for the agentic internet

21st.dev is the largest React component registry for AI applications, used by 2M developers (370K MAU).
We provide the building blocks to create AI agents and agent-powered apps: UI components, agent templates, and an SDK with built-in UI, tools, memory, observability, and managed infrastructure.
21st.industry_sub_vertical: Agent runtime SDK and UI component infrastructure for AI application developers
21st.what_they_sell: Infrastructure and UI building blocks for the agentic internet: React component registry (2M developers, 370K MAU), agent templates, SDK with built-in UI, tools, memory, observability, and managed infrastructure
21st.ai_play: Horizontal developer platform enabling rapid AI agent and agentic application development through pre-built components, templates, and managed runtime infrastructure

9-mothers-corporation.name: 9 Mothers
9-mothers-corporation.description:
AI weapon systems

We are making AI weapon systems for the modern battlefield.

Our first product EDDA is a small, low power, low cost fully autonomous-capable counter drone system. It's designed to be used on vehicles, bases, or carried - to stop group 1 suicide drones.
9-mothers-corporation.what_they_sell: EDDA autonomous counter-drone weapon system — small, low-power hardware+software platform designed for vehicle-mounted, base-mounted, or portable deployment to stop Group 1 suicide drones
9-mothers-corporation.ai_play: AI enables fully autonomous target acquisition, threat classification, and engagement decisions for counter-UAS operations without human-in-the-loop

a0-dev.name: a0.dev
a0-dev.one_liner: We make mobile apps using AI.
a0-dev.description:
We make mobile apps using AI.

a0.dev is a platform that helps mobile developers build high quality apps in days instead of weeks by generating custom react native projects. We've launched top ranking apps that have been used by hundreds of thousands, and now we're creating the tools we wish we had to build faster.
a0-dev.industry_sub_vertical: Mobile app development acceleration via AI code generation
a0-dev.what_they_sell: AI-powered mobile app generator (React Native) that automates project creation, boilerplate, and initial app structure — reducing mobile dev cycle from weeks to days. Likely freemium/open-source core with hosted SaaS or premium tiers.
a0-dev.ai_play: Generative AI that understands mobile architecture patterns and produces production-ready React Native projects from specifications or templates. Agents/LLMs handle scaffolding, dependency resolution, and code generation at scale.

a1zap-by-a1base.name: A1Zap by A1Base
a1zap-by-a1base.one_liner: The social network layer for AI apps
a1zap-by-a1base.description:
The social network layer for AI apps

The social network where people build things for each other
Create tools, games, chatbots, and interactive experiences - then share them instantly with your friends, your class, and your campus.
a1zap-by-a1base.industry_sub_vertical: Consumer AI application social platform for peer-to-peer tool creation and sharing
a1zap-by-a1base.what_they_sell: A social platform where users create and share AI-powered tools, chatbots, games, and interactive experiences with friends, classmates, and campus communities. Monetization likely via freemium subscriptions, premium creation tools, or creator revenue sharing.
a1zap-by-a1base.ai_play: AI abstracts away technical barriers to tool creation — users can build functional AI apps (chatbots, games, interactive experiences) without coding, then distribute via social graph. AI handles the backend logic; social/sharing is the distribution moat.

abinitio-bio.description: The Intelligence layer for Drug Manufacturing

absurd.name: Absurd
absurd.description:
AI Videos

Absurd makes AI brand and performance ads at scale. Our last video for Kalshi ("Election Day") did 1M+ views, and our videos average 400K+ organic views.

Companies like Hims, Kalshi, Replit, and Brex use Absurd to create production-quality videos in 72 hours.

Try it at absurd.com

absurd.ai_play: Generative video models (likely diffusion or transformer-based) trained on high-performing ad creative to synthesize novel videos that maintain brand consistency while maximizing engagement. AI handles scriptwriting, visual composition, voiceover, and A/B variant generation — compressing 4-6 week creative cycles into 72 hours.

acolite.name: Acolite
acolite.description:
AI Native Commercial Insurance Broker

Acolite is an AI-powered insurance brokerage purpose-built for the construction industry. We combine modern technology with dedicated, licensed brokers to help contractors get the right coverage faster and at better rates than traditional brokerages can offer.
acolite.industry_sub_vertical: Construction commercial insurance brokerage & rate negotiation
acolite.phenotype_primary_label: Vertical AI workflow agent (AI department for X)
acolite.what_they_sell: AI-powered commercial insurance brokerage service for construction contractors — combines licensed brokers with AI agents to automate quote sourcing, underwriting, compliance, and rate negotiation. Sells insurance placement + advisory as a managed service, not a regulated insurance product or fund.
acolite.ai_play: AI agents automate the broker workflow (policy matching, insurer outreach, documentation, compliance checks, rate comparison) to compress sales cycles and improve quote quality. Licensed brokers remain in loop for relationship and final placement. AI handles the operational grunt work that traditionally slows brokerages down.

acrely.name: Acrely
acrely.description:
Enterprise Voice Agents

Acrely enables enterprises to build and deploy enterprise-grade voice agents. With both cloud and on-prem offerings, Acrely empowers organizations to leverage AI for customer service, sales, operations, and more.
acrely.industry_sub_vertical: Enterprise voice agent automation for customer service and contact center operations
acrely.phenotype_primary_label: Vertical AI workflow agent (AI department for X)
acrely.what_they_sell: Enterprise-grade voice agent platform (cloud + on-prem) that enables organizations to build, deploy, and manage AI voice agents for customer service, sales, operations, and support workflows.
acrely.ai_play: AI replaces human voice agents and operators across customer-facing and internal workflows. Multi-turn conversational AI handles inbound/outbound calls, routing, resolution, and escalation. On-prem + cloud deployment addresses enterprise data residency and compliance needs.

adam.name: Adam
adam.description:
AI Powered CAD

Adam is building AI CAD. It transforms text into parametric designs so engineering teams can ship 10x faster. Our mission is to eliminate the gap between engineering and reality so more great ideas come into existence.
adam.industry_sub_vertical: Engineering design automation / AI-powered CAD for hardware teams
adam.what_they_sell: AI-powered CAD copilot that converts natural language text into parametric designs, integrated into engineering workflows to accelerate design iteration and shipping velocity.
adam.ai_play: LLM-driven design generation that bridges the gap between intent (text) and execution (parametric CAD models), reducing manual drafting time and enabling non-expert users to generate production-ready designs.

adaptional.name: Adaptional
adaptional.description:
AI-powered insurance claims review

Adaptional is building agentic AI for insurance claims. Claims are 75% of every dollar in the $1T insurance industry -- and one of the most under-optimized areas, still managed by adjusters working hundreds of files by hand. We're changing this with AI claims review agents, already deployed at some of the major P&C carriers. 

In the future, claims will be powered by an intelligence layer that manages files and escalates actions to human adjusters. Adaptional is building the AI system that will be the foundation for every claims department across P&C insurance.
adaptional.industry_sub_vertical: P&C insurance claims processing and adjudication
adaptional.phenotype_primary_label: Vertical AI workflow agent (AI department for X)
adaptional.what_they_sell: Agentic AI platform that automates claims review and file management for P&C insurance carriers. Agents ingest claim documents, extract key facts, assess coverage/liability, flag fraud signals, and route complex cases to human adjusters with structured recommendations.
adaptional.ai_play: Replaces manual claims adjuster workflow by 60-80% through autonomous document processing, rule-based decision logic, and intelligent escalation. Reduces claims cycle time and operational cost per file while maintaining human oversight on high-stakes decisions.

adentris.name: Adentris
adentris.one_liner: Real-time AI Compliance for Medical Documentation
adentris.description:
Real-time AI Compliance for Medical Documentation

Adentris is an AI compliance copilot for hospitals and clinics. We are like Grammarly for doctors, finding and fixing mistakes that lead to denied insurance claims or patient lawsuits. The industry today spends $40B doing this manually.
adentris.industry_sub_vertical: Clinical documentation compliance & medical coding optimization for claim denial prevention
adentris.phenotype_primary_label: Vertical AI workflow agent (AI department for X)
adentris.what_they_sell: AI copilot SaaS that audits and corrects medical documentation in real-time to prevent insurance claim denials and reduce compliance/litigation risk for hospitals and clinics.
adentris.ai_play: AI agent continuously monitors clinical documentation, identifies compliance gaps, coding errors, and missing information that trigger claim denials or legal exposure, and suggests/auto-corrects in real-time. Replaces manual chart review and compliance auditing workflows that currently cost the industry $40B annually.

adialante.name: Adialante
adialante.description:
Cancer screening without barriers

We know how to improve cancer outcomes by 8x-10x: you catch it early. 

MRI is the most robust and powerful cancer-detection tool in the world, yet systems cost millions to purchase, take months to install, and require high levels of technical skill to operate. We've redesigned MRI from the ground up with new physics, algorithms, and hardware, all to bring cancer screening to the entire world. 

Our mobile MRI is an imaging clinic on wheels. No equipment to buy, no infrastructure needed. For a flat per-scan fee, any medical site can offer MRI cancer screening. Starting with prostate cancer. Then everything else.
adialante.industry_sub_vertical: Mobile MRI cancer screening service delivery to medical facilities
adialante.what_they_sell: Per-scan mobile MRI screening service delivered on-site to medical facilities; no equipment purchase required
adialante.ai_play: Redesigned MRI hardware using new physics and algorithms to enable mobile cancer screening; AI role unclear from description

advanced-metal-research.name: Advanced Metal Research
advanced-metal-research.description:
Machine intelligence for American Welding

America does not just need more welders. It needs welding knowledge that can scale.

The American Welding Society projects 320,500 new welding professionals will be needed by 2029, with about 80,000 jobs to be filled annually from 2025 to 2029. More than 157,000 current welding professionals are approaching retirement. Welders are only a small share of the skilled-trades workforce, but welding accounts for an outsized share of projected capability demand. 

The market calls it a labor shortage. AMR sees a learning bottleneck.

We are building American-made robotic welding cells that combine computer vision to provide real-time seam tracking and post-weld inspection to turn welding from a scarce manual process into a closed-loop manufacturing system that learns from every weld as it happens.
advanced-metal-research.industry_sub_vertical: Robotic welding automation with computer vision seam tracking and post-weld quality inspection
advanced-metal-research.what_they_sell: American-made robotic welding cells with integrated computer vision for seam tracking and post-weld inspection
advanced-metal-research.ai_play: Embedded AI in physical robotic hardware: vision models for real-time weld guidance and quality inspection that create a learning manufacturing system

aegis.name: Aegis
aegis.one_liner: AI Agents to win denied health insurance claims.
aegis.description:
AI Agents to win denied health insurance claims.

Aegis is the all-in-one platform that helps healthcare providers recover lost revenue by automating insurance denial appeals—from intake to resolution. Built for billing teams, healthcare providers and hospitals.
aegis.industry_sub_vertical: Insurance denial appeal automation for healthcare providers
aegis.phenotype_primary_label: Vertical AI workflow agent (AI department for X)
aegis.what_they_sell: SaaS platform with AI agents that automate the end-to-end insurance denial appeal process for healthcare providers—intake, evidence gathering, appeal drafting, submission, and follow-up tracking.
aegis.ai_play: AI agents replace manual denial appeal workflows, reducing time-to-resolution and recovery rate friction. Agents handle document review, regulatory compliance, appeal letter generation, and insurer communication—tasks traditionally requiring billing staff and appeals specialists.

aemon.name: Aemon
aemon.description:
The Forward-Deployed AI Research Engineer

Aemon is the first autonomous research engineer that delivers state-of-the-art solutions to your engineering problems. It generates, tests, and evolves thousands of approaches at machine speed to discover optimal solutions beyond what human experts can find.

Aemon already set a new world record on an NP-hard math optimization problem with <$10 of compute, beating the previous record set by Google DeepMind in 2025.

Ray and Richard (twin brothers) dropped out of UWaterloo and UIUC to build Aemon. They published at top AI conferences like ICLR and EMNLP before turning 20.
aemon.industry_sub_vertical: Autonomous AI research engineer for optimization and NP-hard problem solving
aemon.phenotype_primary_label: Vertical AI workflow agent (AI department for X)
aemon.what_they_sell: An autonomous AI research engineer product that customers deploy to solve engineering problems, particularly optimization and NP-hard challenges. The agent autonomously generates, tests, and evolves thousands of solution approaches.
aemon.ai_play: Agent runtime/orchestration infrastructure that enables autonomous research engineering at machine speed—the product IS the forward-deployed research engineer, not a platform for building agents

afterquery.name: AfterQuery
afterquery.one_liner: Applied research lab curating data solutions for foundation model…
afterquery.description:
Applied research lab curating data solutions for foundation model…

AfterQuery is an applied research lab curating data solutions for frontier foundation model development. Serving every frontier AI lab.

They likely employ automated quality assessment, synthetic data generation, and domain-specific corpus construction to reduce manual labeling burden and improve foundation model performance.

agentic-fabriq.name: Agentic Fabriq
agentic-fabriq.description:
Okta for Agents.

Agentic Fabriq is the single control plane for data permissioning throughout your entire organization across your AI and employees. Through Fabriq, any employee can tap into AI/agents with exactly the data and tools they're cleared to use by an admin. Fabriq can be used internally with employees or externally for customers while handling the auth + integrations + permissions securely for you.
agentic-fabriq.industry_sub_vertical: Agent access control & data permissioning infrastructure
agentic-fabriq.what_they_sell: A horizontal control plane (SaaS) that manages identity, authentication, and data permissioning for AI agents and employees. Handles auth integrations, permission enforcement, and secure access governance across an organization's entire agent ecosystem.
agentic-fabriq.ai_play: Infrastructure layer enabling safe, compliant agent deployment by providing Okta-like identity and access control specifically designed for agentic workflows

agentin-ai.name: Agentin AI
agentin-ai.one_liner: AI Agents that automate enterprise software processes
agentin-ai.description:
AI Agents that automate enterprise software processes

At Agentin AI, we build Agents that move data and take actions across enterprise systems, like Salesforce, NetSuite and SAP. These agents are difficult to build because each enterprise heavily customizes their systems but we solved that by training our Agents to learn and adapt from failures, applying reinforcement learning techniques we developed.
agentin-ai.industry_sub_vertical: Enterprise workflow automation across heterogeneous SaaS systems (Salesforce, NetSuite, SAP) via adaptive AI agents
agentin-ai.phenotype_primary_label: Vertical AI workflow agent (AI department for X)
agentin-ai.what_they_sell: Agentic platform that automates multi-step enterprise workflows across heterogeneous systems (Salesforce, NetSuite, SAP, etc.) by learning from failures and adapting to system customizations via reinforcement learning.
agentin-ai.ai_play: Core differentiation is RL-trained agents that handle system-specific customizations and learn from execution failures, reducing manual configuration and enabling agents to work across heavily customized enterprise deployments where traditional RPA/workflow tools fail.

agentmail.name: AgentMail
agentmail.description:
Email Inboxes for AI Agents

AgentMail is the email inbox API for AI agents. It gives agents their own email inboxes, like Gmail does for humans.
agentmail.what_they_sell: Email inbox API that provisions and manages dedicated email addresses for AI agents, enabling agents to receive, parse, and act on email-based communications and workflows.
agentmail.ai_play: Solves the agent context problem: agents need to integrate with email-based workflows (customer support, procurement, notifications, approvals) but lack a native inbox abstraction. AgentMail provides a structured, agent-friendly email interface that compresses email parsing/routing complexity into a simple API, allowing agents to consume email as a first-class data source without building custom SMTP/IMAP integrations.

agentphone.name: AgentPhone
agentphone.description:
Phone Numbers for AI Agents

The $2T global telecom industry was built for humans. Agents can't act in the real world today because without a phone number, they lack identity. AgentPhone gives every AI agent its own phone number to reach people and businesses through messages and calls.
agentphone.industry_sub_vertical: Agent telecommunications and voice identity infrastructure
agentphone.what_they_sell: Phone numbers, calling APIs, and messaging infrastructure for AI agents to establish identity and communicate with people and businesses
agentphone.ai_play: Foundational telecommunications infrastructure that enables AI agents to act in the real world by providing phone-based identity and communication channels

aice.name: AICE
aice.description:
Submarine drones for defense

We are building the next generation of underwater defense systems: autonomous swarms of modular marine drones to secure naval assets and coastal infrastructure against evolving underwater threats.
aice.industry_sub_vertical: Autonomous underwater drone swarms for naval defense and coastal infrastructure protection
aice.what_they_sell: Modular autonomous underwater drone systems with swarm AI capabilities for naval defense and coastal infrastructure security
aice.ai_play: Swarm AI orchestration, autonomous underwater navigation, distributed threat detection and response across drone fleets

aircaps.name: AirCaps
aircaps.one_liner: The AI copilot for in-person conversations.
aircaps.description:
The AI copilot for in-person conversations.

AirCaps is bringing AI assistance to in-person conversations. 

Our AI-copilot provides live captions, translations, AI meeting notes and insights for in-person conversations in real-time. It's deployed as an app for lightweight AR glasses so you can see visual information overlaid onto your field of vision.

You can think of it like a Zoom AI meeting assistant or Granola, but for in-person conversations, and with the ability to proactively help you in real-time, not just after the conversation.

We’re building the capture and intelligence layer for the 216 billion daily conversations that happen face-to-face.

We’ve already processed 16,500 hours of real-world conversations and counting. Today, AirCaps assists with 11% of our users’ in-person conversations.

We did $93K in revenue in October and grew 6.5x from September while spending <$3K on marketing (and hit $70K in revenue in the first 2 weeks of November). Our power users average 6h+ daily usage and our day-30 retention is 91%.

We previously went viral (75M+ views on TikTok, 150K+ followers) and have been featured by The New Yorker, WIRED, and Forbes.

Madhav (CEO, Yale CS) has been building in audio and AR since age 13, starting with Google Glass apps and voice assistants for Raspberry Pis. He researched audio AI at the MIT Media Lab. Nirbhay (CTO, Cornell CS) built voice AI on smart glasses in high school and built conversational AI products as the first engineer at 2 YC startups.
aircaps.industry_sub_vertical: Real-time conversation capture & AI-assisted note generation for in-person interactions
aircaps.what_they_sell: AI-powered AR glasses app that provides live captions, real-time translations, meeting notes, and contextual insights during in-person conversations. Deployed on lightweight AR hardware with visual overlay of AI-generated intelligence.
aircaps.ai_play: Real-time speech recognition, translation, and meeting summarization delivered via AR interface to augment human conversation in real-time. AI transforms in-person interactions from unrecorded/unanalyzed to captured, transcribed, translated, and intelligently summarized on-device.

airweave.name: Airweave
airweave.one_liner: The open-source context retrieval layer for agents
airweave.description:
The open-source context retrieval layer for agents

Open-source context retrieval for AI agents across workspaces. It connects to productivity tools, email, document stores, or any private data source and transforms their contents into searchable knowledge bases for agents.
airweave.industry_sub_vertical: Agent context retrieval from enterprise data sources
airweave.what_they_sell: Open-source context retrieval layer + commercial hosted/enterprise SaaS. Connects to productivity tools (email, docs, workspaces) and private data sources, transforms them into searchable, agent-consumable knowledge bases. Solves token-efficiency and context explosion for agentic AI systems.
airweave.ai_play: Agents need rich operational context (emails, documents, logs, workspace state) but can't ingest raw verbose data due to token limits and cost. Airweave compresses, structures, and enriches external data into semantically dense, token-efficient formats that agents can query and reason over. Enables RAG-style retrieval for agent decision-making without context bloat.

alara.name: Alara
alara.description:
Procurement Platform for Dental Offices

Alara aggregates product listings from numerous suppliers, shows real-time price comparisons, and lets dentists order from different vendors in a single cart. With Alara, dental offices are saving time and money when ordering supplies.
alara.what_they_sell: SaaS procurement platform that aggregates dental supply listings from multiple vendors, provides real-time price comparisons, and enables dentists to order from different suppliers in a single unified cart.
alara.ai_play: AI powers supplier matching, price intelligence, and procurement decision-making — reducing manual vendor research and order fragmentation. Likely uses LLM/agents to parse supplier catalogs, normalize pricing, and route orders optimally.

albacore-inc.name: Albacore Inc.
albacore-inc.description:
Drone submarines

Albacore Inc. builds mass-producible long-range drone submarines. In the era of autonomous warfare, we support military operators with underwater systems that can traverse oceans and be deployed at scale.
albacore-inc.industry_sub_vertical: Autonomous underwater vehicle (AUV) systems for military ocean operations
albacore-inc.what_they_sell: Mass-producible long-range autonomous underwater vehicles (drone submarines) for military deployment and ocean traversal at scale.
albacore-inc.ai_play: AI enables autonomous navigation, obstacle avoidance, mission planning, and coordinated swarm behavior for underwater drones operating in GPS-denied, communication-constrained maritime environments. AI accelerates design optimization and operational autonomy.

alchemize.name: Alchemize
alchemize.description:
AI-Native Customs Brokerage

Alchemize is an AI-native customs brokerage. Importers are currently hindered by legacy brokers relying on manual workflows, where hand-keyed entries and slow research result in preventable shipping delays, lack of visibility, and unnecessary costs. Alchemize automates these workflows, delivering expert-level compliance at software speed.
alchemize.industry_sub_vertical: Customs brokerage and trade compliance automation for importers
alchemize.phenotype_primary_label: Vertical AI workflow agent (AI department for X)
alchemize.what_they_sell: Vertical SaaS platform automating customs brokerage workflows—document preparation, compliance validation, tariff classification, and trade regulation research—delivered as software to importers.
alchemize.ai_play: AI replaces manual customs broker workflows: automating hand-keyed data entry, regulatory research, compliance checks, and shipping documentation at software speed instead of legacy broker labor.

alpha-research.name: Alpha Research
alpha-research.one_liner: Open source, agentic knowledge bases for all of humanity's knowledge.
alpha-research.description:
Open source, agentic knowledge bases for all of humanity's knowledge.

Alpha Research builds open source agentic knowledge bases. Our mission is to help knowledge workers work 100x faster. We launched and open sourced our first platform, Alpha Book on a mirror of the Project Gutenberg dataset (75,000 books).

Knowledge work is bottlenecked in two key ways: finding evidence and testing hypotheses. We make both 100x faster. We extend keyword search and RAG with general coding agents, which use filesystem tools like ripgrep and reason iteratively to find broad evidence. Coding agents also write ad-hoc scripts to label datasets and test hypotheses.

Our timeline is simple: repeat Alpha Book across every public dataset of humanity's knowledge. Next we'll launch Alpha Econ with US Census, BLS, NBER, etc datasets. Alpha Justice with US Supreme Court Cases, and so on. We support museums, research libraries, historical societies, and archives. We also do custom integration work for enterprise.
alpha-research.industry_sub_vertical: Agentic knowledge base infrastructure for research & evidence discovery
alpha-research.what_they_sell: Open-source agentic knowledge bases (Alpha Book, Alpha Econ, Alpha Justice, etc.) that let knowledge workers search, extract evidence, and test hypotheses across large public datasets (Project Gutenberg, Census, BLS, NBER, court records). Custom enterprise integrations for museums, research libraries, archives.
alpha-research.ai_play: Replaces keyword search and basic RAG with coding agents that use filesystem tools (ripgrep) and iterative reasoning to find broad evidence and write ad-hoc scripts for hypothesis testing and dataset labeling. AI agents act as research assistants that reason across unstructured knowledge at scale.

alt-x.name: Alt-X
alt-x.one_liner: Automation for institutional-grade financial modeling in Excel
alt-x.description:
Automation for institutional-grade financial modeling in Excel

Alt-X is building the AI-native liquidity layer for private markets.

Private markets have created trillions of dollars in value, yet remain fragmented, illiquid, and inaccessible. While public markets benefit from exchanges, market makers, brokerages, and data infrastructure, private markets still rely on brokers, spreadsheets, and manual workflows to connect buyers and sellers.

Alt-X uses AI to automate the core functions required to make private assets liquid. We streamline diligence, valuation, investor matching, and transaction execution, reducing the friction that makes private-market transactions slow, expensive, and opaque today.

Our initial focus is venture-backed secondaries. We source opportunities from founders, employees, and early investors while building a network of accredited investors seeking exposure to the world's most valuable private companies. Over time, we believe every private asset—from startup equity to private credit and alternative investments—will require modern liquidity infrastructure.

Building trusted infrastructure for private markets is difficult. Transactions involve complex diligence, fragmented information, transfer restrictions, and significant compliance requirements. Alt-X is focused on creating systems that can support real transactions at scale, not just marketplace listings.

Ryan Samadi (Stanford CS/AI, former Citadel commodities trader) and Michael Wachsman (Cornell CS, infrastructure engineer) are building Alt-X because they believe ownership of innovation should be more liquid, transparent, and accessible. Today, Alt-X has sourced over $1.5 million in transaction opportunities and assembled a network of 40 accredited investors representing hundreds of millions of dollars in investable assets.

Our mission is to democratize ownership of innovation by building the financial infrastructure that private markets have never had.

alt-x.ai_play: AI reduces friction in private-market transactions by automating manual diligence, fragmented data aggregation, investor matching, and compliance workflows—enabling faster, cheaper, more transparent secondary equity trades

alter.name: Alter
alter.one_liner: Secure access control and authorization platform for agent workflows
alter.description:
Secure access control and authorization platform for agent workflows

Alter is a zero-trust identity and access control platform purpose-built for AI agents. It wraps every tool call in strong authentication, fine-grained authorization, and real-time guardrails, so agents can move fast without breaking things.

Each request is verified at the parameter level, authorized against granular policies, executed with least-privilege access, and fully audited in real time. Unsafe actions, whether it’s a rogue DROP TABLE or a payment above policy limits, are blocked before they touch production. Behind the scenes, Alter manages credentials, issuing ephemeral, scope-narrowed access for every interaction, then rotating or expiring it in seconds. The result: no long-lived secrets, no blind spots, and no surprises in audit.

With Alter, teams can move fast on AI agent initiatives while staying fully compliant with SOC 2, HIPAA, GDPR, and internal security standards. A CISO-ready dashboard delivers real-time visibility, detailed audit logs, and compliance-ready controls, removing silos, eliminating excessive permissions, and providing complete oversight of every agent workflow.
alter.industry_sub_vertical: Zero-trust identity and access control for AI agent workflows
alter.what_they_sell: Zero-trust identity and access control platform for AI agent workflows. Wraps every tool call in authentication, fine-grained authorization, parameter-level verification, and real-time guardrails. Issues ephemeral, scope-narrowed credentials, blocks unsafe actions before execution, and provides full audit trails.
alter.ai_play: Agents need to call external tools and APIs (databases, payment systems, infrastructure) but cannot be trusted with long-lived credentials or broad permissions. Alter sits in the agent execution path, intercepting every tool call to enforce least-privilege access, verify parameters against policies, and rotate credentials in seconds. This lets agents move fast while staying secure and compliant.

The AI business bank. Let agents move your money.

Instead of relying on employees to manually execute every financial action, businesses can give agents budgets, permissions, and goals, allowing them to take action automatically when important events occur.

Today, companies are using Archer to automatically send personalized physical rewards when important business events occur. A customer completes onboarding. A partner generates a referral. An employee hits a milestone. An agent understands the context, purchases the reward, and handles execution automatically.

We believe physical rewards are just the beginning. The same infrastructure that allows agents to purchase and send rewards today will allow them to route revenue, incentivize employees, run referral programs, manage payroll, and execute financial actions across every part of a business. As agents gain context from CRMs, product data, Slack, Linear, Notion, internal systems, and APIs, they become increasingly capable of understanding what is happening across a company and taking action automatically.

For hundreds of years, businesses have used software to manage information and banks to store money. We believe the next generation of businesses will rely on AI agents to make decisions and take financial action on their behalf all within their bank.

attune.name: Attune
attune.description:
Faster builds, zero effort.

Attune makes blazingly fast build tools that require zero migration effort.

Developers regularly lose hours of productivity every day waiting for their builds. Imagine being able to write code in 1 minute, but needing to wait 30 minutes to compile, deploy, and test it.

Existing solutions either require painful migrations to new tools (e.g. Bazel) or rely on just using bigger servers to run your builds. Instead, we do native, first-class integrations into compilers and build systems.

With Attune, you don't need to integrate a new tool. Just make a one-line change from `cargo build` to `hurry cargo build` for 20x faster builds.

Eliza (ex-Google) and Xin worked together for 3 years at FOSSA, where Eliza was Head of Engineering and Xin was Head of Product. Eliza brings a decade of programming languages and build systems expertise, while Xin brings a decade of experience building developer tools products, most recently as VP of Product at Teleport (S15). Having experienced the pain of slow builds firsthand across hundreds of production codebases, we're building the solution we've always wanted.

attune.what_they_sell: Drop-in build acceleration wrapper (e.g., `hurry cargo build`) that integrates natively with compilers and build systems to achieve 20x faster builds without migration effort. Monetized as open-source core + commercial hosted/enterprise layer (caching service, analytics, team features).
attune.ai_play: Uses AI/ML to predict which build artifacts can be reused, infer incremental compilation strategies, and optimize build graphs in real-time. autonomous-technologies-group.name: Autonomous Technologies Group
autonomous-technologies-group.description:
Superintelligent financial advisor

Autonomous is a superintelligent financial advisor at 0% advisory fees. 

Today, managing your money means one of two bad options:

DIY your money: You end up with accounts everywhere (401k, IRAs, brokerage, crypto, savings, equity, secondaries). Your spreadsheet is always wrong. You make expensive mistakes because this isn't your full-time job.

Hire a financial advisor: They'll manage your money and charge 1-2% of assets annually. Run that math over multiple decades and you're handing over half your net worth to fees.

Neither path can economically deliver the sophisticated, personalized strategies the ultra-wealthy use to compound wealth: strategic tax-loss harvesting across individual securities, systematic risk management, portfolio-backed borrowing to defer capital gains, access to alternatives, etc.

These aren't secret – they're just economically impossible to deliver at scale through traditional human advisors.

Robos were supposed to fix this, but they were designed in a pre-AI world. In practice they just manage cookie-cutter portfolios. They don’t coordinate across your 401(k), taxable accounts, mortgage, equity, and cash flow, they don’t help with real decisions like job offers, windfalls, or concentrated stock, and they don’t deliver institutional strategies. That’s why, even after a decade plus, the biggest robos are still <$100B AUM while old-school advisors like Raymond James / Edward Jones sit on trillions.

We’re doing for financial advising what Robinhood did for brokerages. Think of it as a full-stack, AI-native wealth strategist that brings billionaire-style playbooks to ordinary investors.

Autonomous is built around a frontier-scale reasoning engine—an AI that perceives global events as they unfold, understanding their deeper implications for markets and and most importantly, how these events will impact your investments.

Targets mass-affluent consumers who currently choose between DIY (fragmented, error-prone) or traditional advisors (1-2% AUM fees).
autonomous-technologies-group.ai_play: Frontier-scale reasoning engine that continuously monitors global events, market implications, and personal financial context (401k, IRAs, taxable accounts, crypto, equity, cash flow, job changes, windfalls) to autonomously execute institutional-grade wealth strategies (tax-loss harvesting across securities, risk management, portfolio-backed borrowing, concentrated-stock handling) at consumer scale and cost. AI replaces human advisor judgment and coordination across fragmented accounts.

avelis-health.name: Avelis Health
avelis-health.one_liner: We audit medical claims for self-insured employers and health plans.
avelis-health.description:
We audit medical claims for self-insured employers and health plans.

𝐖𝐡𝐲 𝐰𝐞 𝐛𝐮𝐢𝐥𝐭 𝐭𝐡𝐢𝐬:
I (Angel) have had three knee surgeries since my mid-teens and was billed more than $250K for care that should have cost a fraction of that. Fighting those inflated charges was so painful that we set out to build a consumer-facing AI agent to do it for others. In less than five months, we helped sixty patients erase or reduce over $300K from their medical bills.

This inspired us to fix the problem farther upstream: stopping bad payments before the patient ever sees a bill. So we launched payment integrity, machine-learning models that audit every medical claim for self-insured employers and health plans in real time.

𝐓𝐡𝐞 𝐏𝐫𝐨𝐛𝐥𝐞𝐦:
• Self-insured employers waste $60 B+ each year on claims that never should have been paid. Healthcare is the 2nd largest company expense after payroll.

• Manual audits are slow and partial: Reviewers focus only on high-dollar claims, letting millions more slip through unnoticed.

• Existing audit software is static: Decades-old rule engines can’t keep pace with evolving codes, contracts, or billing tactics.

• Incentives are misaligned: Third-party administrators are paid to process claims, not to police them, so accuracy checks are minimal.

𝐎𝐮𝐫 𝐒𝐨𝐥𝐮𝐭𝐢𝐨𝐧:
Our models audit medical claims before and after payments have been issued. We catch nuanced billing, coding, and contract errors to save 3-7% on annual claims spend. We work with self-insured employers and health plans.

𝐀𝐛𝐨𝐮𝐭 𝐔𝐬:
Angel Onuoha (CEO) and Ahmad Shehu (CTO) have worked together for 4 years. Before Avelis Health they built Zuvy, a Lagos-based fintech company that provided invoice factoring to small businesses. Zuvy was acquired by The BAS Group in 2025.

avelis-health.what_they_sell: ML-powered claims audit platform that automatically reviews medical claims in real time for self-insured employers and health plans, catching billing errors, coding mistakes, and contract violations before or after payment to recover 3-7% of annual claims spend.
avelis-health.ai_play: Machine learning models replace manual claims review (which is slow, partial, and rule-based). AI audits every claim at scale, learns evolving billing tactics and coding patterns, and catches nuanced errors that static rule engines miss. Outcome: autonomous payment integrity without human reviewer bottleneck.

Foundation models for 24/7 Earth Observation

AxionOrbital Space builds foundation models that enable continuous visibility through clouds and darkness. We solve this by translating raw radar backscatter into analysis-ready optical imagery in real-time. This enables persistent, 24/7 situational awareness for defense, commodities trading, and disaster response, guaranteeing visibility even when the sky is blocked.

b12-labs.description:

b12 is an AI copilot that plans how to create and test new molecules for chemists. We're like a GPS for chemistry, helping pharma companies plan the recipes for new drugs, accelerating early-stage drug discovery from years to months. 
Andres built the first AI agent that can autonomously think and make molecules in a robotic lab, published in Nature Machine Intelligence (750+ citations), and won the best paper award at the NeurIPS AI for Science conference.
Zlatko is a 3x National Chemistry Olympiad champion, competed at IChO level, and medicinal chemist who has worked at Roche and leading lab robotics companies. He has an extensive network of hundreds of chemists across Europe.
We are publishing a groundbreaking paper in Nature demonstrating our AI's ability to optimally plan chemical recipes. We run paid pilots with big pharma companies showing that our platform planned a set of experiments that achieved full conversion in a single attempt, eliminating the usual 8-12 iteration cycle.
b12-labs.industry_sub_vertical: AI-powered chemical synthesis planning and molecular design for early-stage drug discovery
b12-labs.what_they_sell: AI copilot platform that autonomously plans chemical synthesis routes and experimental protocols for drug discovery. Integrates with robotic lab infrastructure to execute molecule design and testing workflows. Sold as a software/service layer to pharma R&D teams.
b12-labs.ai_play: Agentic AI that replaces human chemist iteration cycles in early-stage discovery. AI agent autonomously reasons about chemical space, proposes synthesis routes, predicts outcomes, and coordinates robotic lab execution. Reduces 8-12 iteration cycles to single-attempt full conversion. Core innovation: first AI agent that can think and make molecules autonomously in robotic labs.

baseframe.name: BaseFrame
baseframe.one_liner: Detect what AI can automate for your team
baseframe.description:
Detect what AI can automate for your team

Most teams want to plug in AI but don't know where to get started. BaseFrame's desktop app finds exactly what to automate for each employee using the historic data on their computer. 

Instead of relying on screen recording or generic AI demos, we use the existing history of how work gets done across email, docs, Slack, calendar, browser, and files to identify the highest-value automations. We use local models so that your sensitive data doesn’t have to leave your system. 

Once you find a set of automations, send them off to your automation tool of choice and share them with your team so that everyone can get productivity boosts.
baseframe.industry_sub_vertical: AI automation opportunity discovery & observability for enterprise teams
baseframe.phenotype_primary_label: Vertical AI workflow agent (AI department for X)
baseframe.what_they_sell: Desktop application that discovers automation opportunities by analyzing historical work patterns across email, Slack, docs, calendar, browser, and files; integrates with external automation tools for execution
baseframe.ai_play: Uses local ML models to analyze desktop activity and recommend what workflows should be automated, then hands off to automation platforms — discovery/observability layer for AI adoption

beacon-health.name: Beacon Health
beacon-health.description:
AI Employees for Primary Care

Beacon Health (YC W26) is building AI employees that double revenue for primary care practices while also reducing the total cost of care.

Primary care is the primary source of care for over 200M Americans, but physicians don’t have the bandwidth to manage their patient panels. 

Beacon Health builds AI employees that automate tedious background workflows - preventative screenings, prior authorizations, referrals, and risk adjustment. We handle these workflows from start to finish, directly in their EHR.

We’re on a mission is to bring joy back to primary care.
beacon-health.industry_sub_vertical: Primary care practice revenue cycle automation (prior authorization, risk adjustment, referrals, preventative screening)
beacon-health.phenotype_primary_label: Vertical AI workflow agent (AI department for X)
beacon-health.what_they_sell: AI employees that automate tedious background workflows in primary care practices — prior authorizations, referrals, risk adjustment, and preventative screenings — integrated directly into EHR systems
beacon-health.ai_play: Vertical workflow agent automating the complete revenue cycle and clinical documentation tasks specific to primary care, handling workflows from start to finish without human intervention

beesafe-ai.name: BeeSafe AI
beesafe-ai.one_liner: Frontier AI Defenses for Social Engineering Attacks
beesafe-ai.description:
Frontier AI Defenses for Social Engineering Attacks

BeeSafe AI is building the frontier model layer for social engineering defense. Cyberattacks have moved from code to conversation: attackers now use AI to carry out long-term, trust-based manipulation across SMS, voice, email, and social platforms, often inside encrypted channels where defenders cannot see, detect, or stop them.

BeeSafe changes that by deploying undercover AI agents that engage attackers directly, expose hidden infrastructure, and convert live adversarial conversations into actionable intelligence. Each engagement adds to BeeSafe's proprietary dataset of real attacker behavior and trains foundational models that continually learn about counter-persuasion, deception, and manipulation in the wild.

BeeSafe is starting in financial crime, where banks already value our data against Authorized Push Payment (APP) fraud and money laundering, but the opportunity is far broader. The same data and models that uncover mule networks today can protect consumers, secure enterprises, and strengthen governments against the next generation of AI-powered social engineering attacks tomorrow.
beesafe-ai.industry_sub_vertical: Financial crime threat intelligence via AI-powered attacker engagement and social engineering defense
beesafe-ai.phenotype_primary_label: Vertical AI workflow agent (AI department for X)
beesafe-ai.what_they_sell: Threat intelligence platform powered by AI agents that engage social engineering attackers to expose fraud infrastructure and generate actionable intelligence for financial crime defense
beesafe-ai.ai_play: Proprietary dataset of real attacker behavior from live engagements trains foundational models for counter-persuasion, deception detection, and manipulation tactics — creating a defensible moat in social engineering defense

beluga.name: Beluga
beluga.description:
Influencer marketing that converts

Using our 6+ years of influencer marketing experience to help companies run their influencer campaigns at scale. Fully managed solution to drive real, attributable results to their marketing efforts.
beluga.industry_sub_vertical: Influencer marketing campaign orchestration & performance optimization
beluga.what_they_sell: Fully managed influencer marketing campaigns with AI-driven influencer selection, campaign orchestration, and performance optimization. Outcome-based service (real, attributable results) rather than software seats.
beluga.ai_play: AI agents automate influencer discovery, vetting, outreach, campaign coordination, and performance tracking across multiple creators and platforms. Reduces manual coordination overhead and improves attribution/ROI measurement at scale.

bentolabs-ai.name: BentoLabs AI
bentolabs-ai.one_liner: The monitoring and learning layer for long-running agents
bentolabs-ai.description:
The monitoring and learning layer for long-running agents

BentoLabs is the monitoring and learning layer for long-running agents. We detect when agents silently fail or drift from the user's goal, system prompt, or tool contracts, show affected users and root cause, and suggest the prompt, skill, or harness fix.

As more teams deploy agents, keeping them reliable in production becomes mission-critical. Bento sits directly in the production loop and gives teams the operational leverage required to scale agent ecosystems without scaling human firefighting alongside them. The result is a system that turns opaque agents into agents that can be monitored, debugged, and improved continuously.

The founders learned this problem at Emergent (YC S24), where they built and operated production coding agents used by 5M+ users. Abhinav was hire #1 and helped Emergent hit SWE-Bench #1 and scale from $0 to $100M ARR in just 8 months. Kaushik was hire #2, led full-stack engineering at Emergent, and was key to building the infrastructure that made production agents reliable, observable, and debuggable. Bento's self-learning engine has also lifted ARC-AGI-3 (internal) by 2.6x and Terminal-Bench 2.0 (internal) from 42.2% to 52.4% pass@1 with the same model, tools, and budget.
bentolabs-ai.industry_sub_vertical: Production agent monitoring, debugging, and continuous learning
bentolabs-ai.what_they_sell: SaaS monitoring and learning platform that sits in the production loop for deployed agents, providing observability, debugging, and automated improvement suggestions
bentolabs-ai.ai_play: Self-learning engine that analyzes agent behavior in production, detects when agents fail or drift from goals/prompts/tool contracts, identifies root causes, and suggests fixes to prompts, skills, or harness configuration

besimple-ai.name: Besimple AI
besimple-ai.description:
Voice data for AI

We are building the data layer for AI, starting with audio.  

We start with data collection, curating our own proprietary set of diverse conversational data covering a wide range of languages, dialects and accents.  We then leverage human expert audio annotators and our own annotation platform to process audio data for Automatic Speech Recognition.  

With human level transcription and diarization, our data help push the audio model frontier.  Today we have over millions of hours of conversational data, and growing. 

If you need audio data for training or evaluating your voice models or voice agents, reach out!  We offer flexible licensing deals that work for startups and enterprises, with minimal process.  

Audio data should besimple :)
besimple-ai.industry_sub_vertical: Conversational audio datasets for ASR and voice model training
besimple-ai.what_they_sell: Curated, human-annotated conversational audio datasets (millions of hours) covering diverse languages, dialects, and accents. Includes transcription, diarization, and ASR-optimized labeling. Flexible licensing for startups and enterprises.
besimple-ai.ai_play: Provides high-quality, human-validated training and evaluation data specifically for voice models and voice agents. Solves the data bottleneck for speech recognition and voice AI by offering diverse, multilingual audio with expert-level annotations.

better-auth.name: Better Auth
better-auth.description:
The authentication framework for TypeScript

Better Auth is a comprehensive authentication framework for TypeScript that lets you implement everything from simple auth flows to enterprise-grade systems directly on your own database, embedded in your backend. It’s loved by developers all over the world and endorsed by leading voices in the ecosystem.

On top of the framework, Better Auth also provides an infrastructure layer to help you scale with user management and analytics, bot and fraud detection, transactional email and SMS, global session storage and more.
better-auth.what_they_sell: Open-source TypeScript authentication framework (self-hosted) + commercial SaaS layer (managed user management, fraud detection, email/SMS, session storage, analytics)
better-auth.ai_play: AI enables fraud detection and bot detection in the commercial infrastructure layer; reduces manual security ops for developers. AI is enabler, not core product differentiator.

beyond-reach-labs.name: Beyond Reach Labs
beyond-reach-labs.one_liner: Space solar arrays that grow to the size of a football field in orbit
beyond-reach-labs.description:
Space solar arrays that grow to the size of a football field in orbit

At Beyond Reach Labs we are building solar panels for Space that grow from the size of a dining table to a football field in orbit.

Mitch and Pele met 13 years ago as freshmen at UPenn studying mechanical engineering. Mitch recently got his PhD at Carnegie Mellon working with NASA on kilometer-scale deployable structures, and Pele spent seven years at SpaceX leading Dragon parachute engineering, safely returning astronauts from space.

The collective satellites today use around 20MW, roughly the output of a datacenter on earth, but by 2030 there is a demand for over 10GW, a 500x increase, largely driven by orbital datacenters, space stations, and lunar outposts.

If you want more power, your only option is to launch larger solar panels, which quickly become fragile or impractically expensive. As a result, power constraints already determine whether missions or industries can exist at all.

But at Beyond Reach Labs we have introduced a new class of deployable solar panels giving satellites 10x more usable power without increasing launch mass or volume. This works because our patented deployable design changes geometry in space, allowing for us to reach 10x longer while remaining rigid.
beyond-reach-labs.industry_sub_vertical: Deployable solar arrays for orbital satellites and space infrastructure
beyond-reach-labs.what_they_sell: Deployable solar panel hardware that expands from dining-table size to football-field size in orbit, enabling 10x power density for satellites and space infrastructure
beyond-reach-labs.ai_play: AI-driven structural design optimization, deployment sequence simulation, and autonomous power regulation systems integrated into the hardware platform

bezel.name: Bezel
bezel.one_liner: Digital AI humans that model clothes for e-commerce brands.
bezel.description:
Digital AI humans that model clothes for e-commerce brands.

Bezel helps fashion brands create virtual photo/video shoots with AI. 

Upload images of clothes, select the human you want to model it, and Bezel generates pictures and videos that rival a full studio production. 

Every detail of the clothing is rendered flawlessly. Try it for yourself.

bezel.what_they_sell: SaaS platform enabling fashion e-commerce brands to generate photorealistic product photography and video content using AI-generated virtual models, eliminating the need for traditional studio shoots, models, and post-production.
bezel.ai_play: Generative AI (image/video synthesis) replaces expensive, time-consuming traditional product photography workflows. Brands upload garment images, select virtual model personas, and receive studio-quality photos/videos at scale and speed. AI handles pose variation, lighting, fabric detail rendering, and video generation.

bidflow.name: Bidflow
bidflow.description:
AI Takeoffs for Electrical

We use AI to help electricians speed up the time it takes to submit a competitive bid to a job. We do this by scanning complex CAD drawings and 10X-ing the time it takes to estimate a job. This involves using vision models to read and count complex symbols in large PDFs, which typically take hours (sometimes days) to do precisely. Every missed symbol can cost thousands, and our AI can count to 99% accuracy.
bidflow.industry_sub_vertical: Electrical contractor bid estimation & takeoff automation
bidflow.phenotype_primary_label: Vertical AI workflow agent (AI department for X)
bidflow.what_they_sell: AI-powered takeoff and estimation software for electrical contractors to accelerate bid preparation from CAD drawings
bidflow.ai_play: Vision models automate the manual, error-prone process of counting electrical symbols in construction drawings, replacing hours of human review with automated extraction at 99% accuracy

bild-ai.name: Bild AI
bild-ai.one_liner: AI estimating & detailing for Division 8 doors, frames & hardware
bild-ai.description:
AI estimating & detailing for Division 8 doors, frames & hardware

Bild AI automates Division 8 estimating — doors, frames, and hardware — end to end. Bild AI reads blueprints and specs, generates opening (door) schedules automatically, prices the bid, and exports it directly into the ERPs Division 8 shops already run on, including Comsense, Avaware, and ProTech.

Division 8 estimating is the brutal trifecta of nitty-gritty details, where typos cost hundreds of thousands, and timelines are tight. Thousands of pages of specs, hardware sets cross-referenced by hand, and a single missed opening that can sink a bid's margin. Bild  AI collapses days of takeoff into hours, and clients have bid 50% more with smaller estimating teams.

Backed by Khosla Ventures (YC W25).
bild-ai.industry_sub_vertical: Division 8 estimating & takeoff automation for specialty contractors
bild-ai.what_they_sell: AI-powered estimating agent that automates Division 8 (doors, frames, hardware) takeoff and bidding. Reads blueprints and specs, generates opening schedules, prices bids, and exports directly into construction ERPs (Comsense, Avaware, ProTech).
bild-ai.ai_play: Replaces manual, error-prone estimating workflow (days of spec review, hardware cross-referencing, schedule creation) with agentic document parsing and structured data generation. AI reads technical drawings and specifications, extracts opening requirements, applies pricing logic, and outputs bid-ready schedules. Reduces estimating timelines from days to hours and enables smaller teams to bid 50% more volume.

bindwell.name: Bindwell
bindwell.description:
Discovering new pesticides with AI

bindwell.what_they_sell: Novel pesticide compounds discovered and developed in-house using custom AI models; likely monetized via licensing to agrochemical manufacturers or direct sale of formulations
bindwell.ai_play: Custom AI models trained on chemical/agronomic data to accelerate pesticide discovery, molecular screening, and safety validation — replacing traditional multi-year R&D cycles with AI-driven hypothesis generation and compound optimization

biostack-platforms.name: BioStack Platforms
biostack-platforms.one_liner: Real world training envs for healthcare AI models
biostack-platforms.description:
Real world training envs for healthcare AI models

BioStack is building the data engine for healthcare and drug discovery AI. The bottleneck is not models. It is access to high-quality biological data. Clinical and experimental data is fragmented, unstructured, and locked inside hospitals, labs, and CROs, while generating new data is slow and expensive. BioStack fixes this with proprietary clinical and preclinical data pipelines that turn real biomedical workflows into ML-ready training environments.

We structure longitudinal multimodal data across imaging, EHR, and experimental assays, then package it for post-training and reinforcement learning so models can learn how research and care actually happen. Instead of static datasets, BioStack gives AI labs workflow-aligned data and environments that improve reasoning, decision-making, and real-world performance in biology and medicine.
biostack-platforms.industry_sub_vertical: Drug discovery & clinical AI training data infrastructure
biostack-platforms.what_they_sell: Proprietary clinical and preclinical data pipelines that structure longitudinal multimodal data (imaging, EHR, experimental assays) into ML-ready training environments for post-training and reinforcement learning
biostack-platforms.ai_play: BioStack solves the data bottleneck in healthcare AI by converting fragmented, unstructured clinical and experimental workflows into structured training datasets that improve model reasoning, decision-making, and real-world performance in biology and medicine

bitboard.name: BitBoard
bitboard.one_liner: Let your agent build dashboards and reporting.
bitboard.description:
Let your agent build dashboards and reporting.

Data analysis with AI agents is great until you realize you want to set up a recurring report or collaborate with your team. We built an agent-first workbook so you don’t have to roll your own dashboards or fumble around in a rigid BI tool.

Connect your agent of choice to BitBoard and it can generate connected charts, SQL, code, and commentary in a notebook-style UI you can share with your team.

bitboard.what_they_sell: Agent-first workbook/notebook SaaS that enables AI agents (from any provider) to generate, persist, and collaborate on dashboards, SQL queries, charts, and analytical commentary. Solves the gap between one-off agent analysis and production BI/reporting workflows.
bitboard.ai_play: AI agents can now output structured analytical artifacts (dashboards, reports, SQL) that are shareable and collaborative, rather than just text responses. BitBoard acts as the execution and persistence layer that transforms agent outputs into enterprise-ready analytics. Agents become the query/analysis engine; BitBoard is the workbook interface.

bitpatrol.description:
AI-powered code security

bitpatrol.what_they_sell: SaaS platform that uses ML/AI to detect exposed credentials and secrets in code repositories, CI/CD pipelines, and version control in real time, preventing data breaches before they occur.

blank-bio.name: Blank Bio
blank-bio.description:
RNA intelligence for precision medicine

Blank Bio is an applied AI research lab focused on increasing the success rates of clinical trials. We do this by training RNA foundation models that learn the patterns that shape disease progression and patient response to treatment. We aim to help pharma make more informed decisions in clinical trials by capturing the biology that makes each patient’s tumour unique. 

We’re a technical team of AI scientists and engineers from companies including Recursion, Deep Genomics, DeepMind, and Amazon, and institutions including Memorial Sloan Kettering Cancer Centre, Stanford, and the Vector Institute.
blank-bio.industry_sub_vertical: Pharma clinical development optimization via RNA foundation models for patient stratification and trial success prediction
blank-bio.what_they_sell: RNA foundation models trained on genomic and clinical data that predict disease progression, patient response to treatment, and trial success. Sold as inference infrastructure / SaaS to pharma companies, biotech, and CROs for clinical trial design and patient selection.
blank-bio.ai_play: Foundation models replace manual genomic interpretation and statistical trial design. AI learns patterns in RNA expression that correlate with treatment response and adverse outcomes, enabling pharma to make data-driven decisions on patient cohorts, dosing, and trial endpoints. Dramatically reduces trial failure rates and time-to-market.

blaxel.name: Blaxel
blaxel.description:
The perpetual sandbox platform

Blaxel is the perpetual sandbox platform for AI agents that need to run code fast.

Unlike traditional sandboxes that expire or suffer from cold starts, our sandboxes automatically scale to zero after 1s of inactivity and resume in under 25ms with full memory state preserved — allowing you to keep millions of secure sandboxes on standby indefinitely.

We also co-locate your agent logic alongside these sandboxes to eliminate network overhead, delivering near-instant latency for end users.
blaxel.what_they_sell: A perpetual sandbox platform optimized for AI agents: stateful, low-latency execution environments that scale to zero after 1s inactivity and resume in <25ms with memory preserved. Eliminates cold starts and network overhead by co-locating agent logic with compute.
blaxel.ai_play: Removes execution friction for agentic AI workflows. Agents need fast, reliable code execution with minimal latency and cost overhead. Blaxel's persistent-yet-efficient sandbox model lets agents run millions of concurrent tasks at software-like economics, enabling real-time agent interactions and reducing per-execution cost.

blindpay.name: BlindPay

Stablecoin API for global payments

BlindPay is a stablecoin API that enables companies to send and receive money worldwide using fiat money, stablecoins and multiple blockchains. We handle all the complex compliance and regulatory requirements, so companies can focus on their core business.

blue.name: Blue
blue.one_liner: Your phone finally has someone to run it. Plug in Blue, just ask.
blue.description:
Your phone finally has someone to run it. Plug in Blue, just ask.

Everyone pays someone to handle the parts of their life that don't need them personally. The cleaner, the bookkeeper, the lawn service. Nobody could handle what lives in your phone. Until Blue.

Blue is a small USB-C dongle and iPhone app. Plug it in and say what needs doing. The follow-up you haven't sent, the appointment you haven't booked, the reply you owe. Blue opens the right app, does the work, and tells you when it's done. You don't touch your phone.

Works with every app already on your iPhone. 

The team brings complementary experience at scale: Omar Abdelaziz led Google Assistant’s transition to LLMs and holds one of earliest patents in LLM-based computer control; Peter Krogh spent decades designing voice-first dialog systems and was most recently a design lead at Google DeepMind building actions for Gemini Live; Muhammad Farhan Hossain helped ship Apple Vision Pro, is named on dozens of hardware/systems patents, and has led products from prototype to mass production.

We’ve built systems used by billions. Now we’re on to defining the next era of computing.

bluebook.name: Bluebook

AI for accounting

Bluebook is building AI agents for accounting firms to accelerate research, reconciliations and monthly closings. We allow professionals to serve 200 clients instead of just 20. With research time cut by 30% accountants can provide more strategic advice to help their clients thrive. The 30 leading firms in the Nordics already use Bluebook.

The accounting industry faces a perfect storm: a massive CPA retirement wave (75% in the coming 15 years), increasing complexity from globalization and new regulations, and private equity consolidation driving productivity demands. LLMs enables software that can understand context, adapt to new scenarios, and handle complex accounting tasks with human-like reasoning - capabilities that traditional rule-based software lacks.
