bond.name: Bond
bond.description:
Your AI Chief of Staff

Bond is an AI Chief of Staff that gives CEOs and busy executives real-time visibility into what’s happening across the company and tells them what to focus on. Saving execs 10+ hours a week.
bond.what_they_sell: SaaS seat-based AI assistant that aggregates real-time company data (metrics, updates, alerts) and surfaces actionable priorities for CEOs and executives, reducing time spent on information gathering and decision-making.
bond.ai_play: AI agent that continuously monitors cross-functional data sources (dashboards, Slack, email, docs, metrics), synthesizes context, and proactively surfaces what the executive should focus on — replacing manual status-gathering and prioritization work.

booko.name: Booko
booko.description:
Dynamically pricing the whole economy.

Booko helps businesses that sell bookable time slots make more money by dynamically pricing their time. Unlike physical inventory, unsold time slots disappear forever, yet most time-slot-based businesses still rely on static pricing. We integrate with existing booking systems to adjust prices and incentives based on historical utilization, availability, and demand. Early customers see ~20% revenue uplift by selling time that would have otherwise gone unsold.
booko.industry_sub_vertical: Revenue optimization for appointment-based service businesses (salons, fitness studios, healthcare clinics)
booko.phenotype_primary_label: Vertical AI workflow agent (AI department for X)
booko.what_they_sell: Dynamic pricing software that integrates with existing booking systems to automatically adjust prices and incentives for time-slot-based businesses (salons, fitness studios, medical practices, etc.)
booko.ai_play: AI replaces manual pricing decisions and static rate cards with real-time optimization algorithms that learn from historical booking patterns, availability windows, and demand signals to prevent revenue loss from unsold time slots

boom-ai.name: Boom AI
boom-ai.one_liner: AI agents that recover lost revenue through real conversations.
boom-ai.description:
AI agents that recover lost revenue through real conversations.

Boom reaches out to your customers before you lose them.

We run proactive outbound conversations at scale: recovering churned users, re-engaging drop-offs, and protecting revenue you thought was gone. AI agents hold real conversations with your customers over SMS, email, WhatsApp, or phone, in their language, on the channel they actually answer.

Every month, companies lose 5-15% of revenue to churn, and more walks out through abandoned signups and failed onboarding. The tools built to fix this don't work. Win-back emails get ignored. Cancel flows only catch people at the door. Hiring humans doesn't scale. Boom does the one thing that works: a real conversation. 1,000x the reach of manual outreach, and the customer can reply.
boom-ai.industry_sub_vertical: E-commerce and SaaS churn recovery through AI-driven customer outreach
boom-ai.phenotype_primary_label: Vertical AI workflow agent (churn recovery automation)
boom-ai.what_they_sell: AI agents that autonomously conduct outbound conversations (SMS, email, WhatsApp, phone) to recover churned customers, re-engage drop-offs, and prevent revenue loss. Agents hold real, contextual conversations in customer language across preferred channels.
boom-ai.ai_play: Replaces manual outreach teams and ineffective win-back email campaigns with agentic conversational AI that scales to 1000x reach while maintaining two-way dialogue. AI agents handle customer objections, personalize messaging, and execute retention workflows autonomously.

boost-robotics.name: Boost Robotics
boost-robotics.one_liner: Robots for the inspection and maintenance of data centers
boost-robotics.description:
Robots for the inspection and maintenance of data centers

Boost Robotics is building autonomous mobile manipulation robots to remotely perform manual tasks in data centers. 

The surge in AI applications is pushing data centers to scale faster than they can manage, leading to suboptimal operations and staffing shortages amid rising power and compute demands.

We save data centers millions in insurance premiums and SLA violations by increasing the frequency of inspection and maintenance while reducing the time it takes to triage and address failures.
boost-robotics.industry_sub_vertical: Data center infrastructure inspection and predictive maintenance via autonomous mobile manipulation robots
boost-robotics.what_they_sell: Autonomous mobile manipulation robots that perform inspection, diagnostics, and maintenance tasks in data centers. Hardware + software stack for autonomous operation in complex industrial environments.
boost-robotics.ai_play: AI enables autonomous perception, navigation, and manipulation in unstructured data center environments. Computer vision + reinforcement learning for task execution reduces manual labor, increases inspection frequency, and accelerates failure triage. AI transforms data center ops from reactive/manual to predictive/autonomous.

bootloop.name: BootLoop
bootloop.one_liner: Firmware in minutes, not months - rigorously tested on real hardware
bootloop.description:
Firmware in minutes, not months - rigorously tested on real hardware

BootLoop is building the first AI agent to write and test firmware on real hardware. Existing AI coding assistants fail completely with embedded systems, but our agent ingests datasheets, schematics, and other design files to write firmware in your style and automatically test it on your hardware.
bootloop.industry_sub_vertical: Embedded systems firmware testing & validation automation
bootloop.what_they_sell: AI agent that writes firmware from datasheets/schematics and automatically tests it on real hardware, reducing firmware development cycles from months to minutes.
bootloop.ai_play: Agent ingests hardware design files (datasheets, schematics, design specs) via RAG, generates firmware matching customer's coding style, and autonomously executes test suites on actual hardware to validate correctness before handoff. Replaces manual firmware coding and hardware testing workflows.

bramante.name: Bramante
bramante.one_liner: Life sciences instrument and reagent manufacturing
bramante.description:
Life sciences instrument and reagent manufacturing

We manufacturing instruments and reagents that are purpose built for AI, automated labs, and personalized medicines.
bramante.industry_sub_vertical: Life sciences instrument and reagent manufacturing for automated labs and personalized medicine
bramante.what_they_sell: Purpose-built life sciences instruments and reagents designed for AI-driven automated labs and personalized medicine workflows. Hardware + consumables optimized for autonomous lab execution.
bramante.ai_play: AI accelerates instrument design, manufacturing precision, and autonomous lab operation. Instruments are built from ground up to integrate with AI orchestration systems (agent control, real-time feedback loops, adaptive protocols). AI enables higher throughput, lower error rates, and personalized medicine at scale.

bravi.name: Bravi
bravi.one_liner: The AI operating system powering home services businesses
bravi.description:
The AI operating system powering home services businesses

Bravi is building the AI operating system for home-services businesses, using AI-powered customer communication as the wedge.

We replace the front office (calls, chats, follow-ups) with AI agents that never miss a lead, then layer an internal AI copilot that understands products, pricing, and technical documentation.

We started with fenestration (shutters, windows, garage doors), a large, complex vertical with no modern software, before expanding to adjacent trades.

Bravi is already live with leading installers and manufacturers across Europe and the US, turning missed demand into revenue.
bravi.industry_sub_vertical: Home services customer communication & lead capture automation (fenestration, trades, installation)
bravi.what_they_sell: AI operating system for home-services businesses: front-office AI agents (customer calls, chats, lead capture) + internal copilot (product/pricing/technical knowledge). Replaces manual customer communication and internal lookup workflows.
bravi.ai_play: AI agents handle inbound customer communication (never miss leads), qualify and route jobs, and provide internal staff with real-time product/pricing/technical guidance. Turns missed demand into captured revenue by automating the entire customer-to-dispatch workflow.

brickanta.name: Brickanta
brickanta.description:
Agentic AI for Society Builders

Brickanta  – agentic AI for society builders. Hundreds of construction-specific AI agents for project analysis, insights, tenders, procurement, and more. Combine the latest AI technology with your organization's project data, templates, and workflows to identify risks and opportunities early and produce better decision support. Brickanta has raised $8 million from leading AI, construction, and real estate investors behind companies like OpenAI/ChatGPT, Airbnb, Klarna, Spotify, and Plangrid-Autodesk, as well as star investors such as Mario Götze, Anton Osika, and Northzone (see movie and press). The founding team has been building and implementing AI in construction and industry since 2018 at companies such as ABB, Fabege, Husqvarna, IKEA and Konecranes.
brickanta.industry_sub_vertical: Construction project AI agent orchestration & workflow automation
brickanta.phenotype_primary_label: Vertical AI workflow agent (AI department for construction)
brickanta.what_they_sell: Suite of construction-specific AI agents (100+) that automate project analysis, risk identification, tender evaluation, procurement workflows, and decision support. Agents integrate with customer's project data, templates, and operational workflows via API/SaaS.
brickanta.ai_play: Agentic AI replaces manual project review, risk assessment, and procurement triage work. Agents consume project documents, historical data, and templates to autonomously surface risks, opportunities, and recommendations early in project lifecycle. Reduces decision latency and human review overhead for construction operators.

brickwise.name: Brickwise
brickwise.one_liner: AI property manager for landlords and estate agents
brickwise.description:
AI property manager for landlords and estate agents

We've built an AI property manager that automates maintenance requests, handling tenant calls and messages 24/7, following up by chasing contractors and resolving issues.

We're based in London, but have over 10 customers throughout the world, from San Francisco to Dubai. We have a reliable sales pipeline, including a >$1m cARR enterprise contract. Since our formation 6 months ago, we have raised over $3M in funding.

Ismail, co-founder & CEO, is an ex-Founder at LiveLink AI, where he raised $3M, growing the platform to editing 150k videos per month. He also built his own prop firm to $500k ARR.

Elias, co-founder & CTO, was an early engineer at a YC backed company, acquired by Google. While a senior engineer at Google for 5 years, he took the product from $50k ARR to >$100m. CS at Bristol, MBA from Imperial.
brickwise.industry_sub_vertical: Rental property maintenance request automation and contractor dispatch
brickwise.phenotype_primary_label: Vertical AI workflow agent (AI department for property management)
brickwise.what_they_sell: SaaS platform delivering an AI property manager that automates the full maintenance lifecycle: ingests tenant requests (calls, messages, tickets), triages and prioritizes issues, dispatches to contractors, tracks resolution, and follows up with tenants and service providers — 24/7 autonomous operation.
brickwise.ai_play: Multi-agent orchestration replaces human property managers and administrative staff. Agents handle tenant communication (NLU, routing), contractor outreach and negotiation, issue tracking and escalation, and compliance documentation. Reduces labor cost per property and accelerates resolution time.

bron.name: Bron
bron.description:
ChatGPT for Sports Betting

Bron is the ChatGPT for sports betting. Find +EV bets across 150+ sportsbooks and prediction markets, build parlays automatically, and surface the best bets of the day — in seconds.

Download Bron on the App Store here: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/bron-ai-sports-analysis/id6761323087
bron.industry_sub_vertical: Sports betting & prediction markets retail execution
bron.what_they_sell: Mobile app (iOS) that uses AI to identify +EV (positive expected value) bets across 150+ sportsbooks and prediction markets, automatically construct parlays, and surface daily best bets.
bron.ai_play: AI agent ingests real-time odds, historical performance data, and predictive models across multiple sportsbooks to detect arbitrage opportunities and optimize bet construction — replacing manual line-shopping and parlay building. Core value is speed (seconds vs. hours) and coverage (150+ books vs. manual checking).

brownie.name: IncidentFox
brownie.one_liner: AI SRE agent that triages, coordinates, and fixes production incidents
brownie.description:
AI SRE agent that triages, coordinates, and fixes production incidents

AI SRE agents that automatically learn each customer’s system so they work just like an in-house engineer.
brownie.industry_sub_vertical: AI-driven production incident triage and remediation for DevOps/SRE teams
brownie.phenotype_primary_label: Vertical AI workflow agent (AI department for X)
brownie.what_they_sell: Vertical AI SaaS agent that automates the full incident response workflow for DevOps/SRE teams—triaging, coordinating, and fixing production incidents without human intervention
brownie.ai_play: Deploys a specialized AI agent that learns each customer's infrastructure and operational patterns, then autonomously handles incident detection, diagnosis, and remediation as a virtual SRE engineer

browser-use.name: Browser Use
browser-use.one_liner: Leading open-source web agent project with 50k stars in 3 months
browser-use.description:
Leading open-source web agent project with 50k stars in 3 months

We enable AI to control the browser. 
Browser-use is the biggest open-source web agent project. 
We got 40k stars in the last 3 months.
browser-use.industry_sub_vertical: Web agent runtime & browser automation framework
browser-use.what_they_sell: Open-source web agent framework (40k+ stars) enabling AI to control browsers autonomously. Monetization likely via hosted API, enterprise SaaS tier, or managed inference service wrapping the OSS runtime.
browser-use.ai_play: Browser-use is the runtime/harness layer for web-based agentic workflows. It abstracts browser control (navigation, form filling, clicking, reading DOM) as a tool interface that LLM agents can invoke. Solves the 'how does an AI agent interact with web UIs' problem — critical infrastructure for vertical agents, RPA automation, and web scraping workflows.

bubble-lab.name: Bubble Lab
bubble-lab.description:
Prompt once, automate forever.

Bubble Lab turns natural language into visual, production-ready workflows — built for modern ops teams, with built-in observability, logs, and execution traces.

Deploy to Slack in one click so your team can build and run workflows from anywhere.
bubble-lab.phenotype_primary_label: Vertical AI workflow agent (AI department for X)
bubble-lab.what_they_sell: Self-service workflow automation platform that converts natural language prompts into visual, production-ready workflows with built-in observability, deployable to Slack for cross-functional operations teams
bubble-lab.ai_play: Natural language as the interface layer for workflow creation — users prompt once to generate automated workflows instead of manual configuration or coding

bud.name: Bud
bud.description:
Agent with a computer

Bud is an agent with a computer. You can use it from web, text, or telegram. Bud can build & code, fully use a browser, do professional work (research, slides, docs, excel), use skills, and run completely autonomously.
bud.industry_sub_vertical: General-purpose AI agent runtime for enterprise knowledge work automation
bud.what_they_sell: A general-purpose AI agent accessible via web, SMS, and Telegram that autonomously executes professional workflows: research, document creation, spreadsheet manipulation, coding, and browser-based tasks. Multi-channel interface (web, text, Telegram) for task submission and monitoring.
bud.ai_play: Bud is an agentic OS — a computer-using agent that replaces human execution of knowledge work tasks. Rather than vertical-specific automation, it's a horizontal agent that can handle any browser-based or code-based workflow. The core innovation is reliable autonomous computer use (browser control, tool chaining, error recovery) across diverse job functions.

burnt.name: burnt
burnt.one_liner: Agentic Operating System for Food Supply Chain
burnt.description:
Agentic Operating System for Food Supply Chain

Food Supply Chain companies have been using legacy ERPs for decades. Everyone knows these are necessary evils that essentially run the business but take up a lot of operational capacity. They are not about to just rip and replace their existing system that runs their whole business with a system that takes years to implement. Imagine if they could implement AI that runs the ERP for them, in weeks?

Burnt’s building an agentic OS for the Food Supply Chain with AI Agents for each department. 

Our AI Agent, Ozai, has started by replacing the whole order management job function at food distribution companies, so that sales and customer service teams can focus on what matters - the customer. Ozai monitors all incoming messages (emails, phone calls, voicemails, whatsapp, fax etc.), figures out if it's an order, learns each customer's habits, shorthand, and favorite products, picks up on any prep notes, and enters it straight into the existing ERP. It'll even go back to the customers on your behalf when it's not sure about something, clarify things and carry on working. 

The more it sees, the smarter it gets.
burnt.industry_sub_vertical: Food distribution order management and fulfillment automation
burnt.phenotype_primary_label: Vertical AI workflow agent (AI department for Food Supply Chain)
burnt.what_they_sell: Agentic operating system (Ozai) that automates order management and fulfillment workflows for food distribution companies. The agent ingests orders from multiple channels (email, phone, WhatsApp, fax), learns customer preferences and shorthand, clarifies ambiguities autonomously, and writes directly into existing legacy ERP systems without requiring rip-and-replace.
burnt.ai_play: AI agent replaces the entire order management job function by handling multi-channel order intake, customer context learning, and ERP data entry. Reduces operational overhead for sales and customer service teams while integrating seamlessly with incumbent legacy systems (no migration risk). Agent improves over time as it sees more customer patterns.

burt.name: Burt
burt.description:
AI teammates for logistics

We're building for the people that keep the world moving. 

Freight brokers and forwarders operate on razor-thin margins in a relationship-driven business — yet most of their teams spend the majority of their day on manual, repetitive work.

We help freight brokers and forwarders build AI teammates that handle their repetitive, manual tasks so teams have time to focus on customers, carriers, and growing the business.
burt.phenotype_primary_label: Vertical AI workflow agent (AI department for X)
burt.what_they_sell: Vertical AI SaaS platform that deploys AI teammates to automate repetitive manual tasks specific to freight brokerage and forwarding workflows
burt.ai_play: AI agents that handle quote requests, carrier outreach, load matching, documentation, and customer communication—freeing freight broker and forwarder teams to focus on relationship management and business growth

butter.name: Butter
butter.description:
Embedded Sandboxes for Agents

Butter is building bVisor, an incredibly lightweight sandbox runtime for AI agents.
It embeds directly into your local process, providing a safe bash environment without the overhead of VMs or remote infra.
butter.industry_sub_vertical: Agent sandbox & execution runtime for safe tool execution
butter.what_they_sell: bVisor: lightweight embedded sandbox runtime for AI agents. Provides safe bash execution environment that runs in-process without VM or remote infrastructure overhead.
butter.ai_play: Enables agents to safely execute arbitrary code/bash commands locally with minimal latency and cost. Solves the execution layer for agentic workflows — agents need to run tools, scripts, and system commands but need isolation and safety guarantees.

button-computer.name: Button Computer
button-computer.one_liner: Button is the wearable AI that can talk.
button-computer.description:
Button is the wearable AI that can talk.

We’re launching a small hardware device: a button that you clip to your shirt. You press it to talk to AI, and it responds instantly.
button-computer.industry_sub_vertical: Consumer wearable AI voice assistant hardware
button-computer.what_they_sell: Physical wearable button device bundled with AI voice assistant software — hardware+software product sold direct to consumers
button-computer.ai_play: AI-native voice interface in physical wearable form factor — the AI is the product experience, not a feature layer

bystreet.name: Bystreet
bystreet.one_liner: Your key to the hotel market.
bystreet.description:
Your key to the hotel market.

ZoomInfo but for hotels. Figure out who owns any property in CALA and access contact data to reach them.
bystreet.industry_sub_vertical: Hotel ownership & decision-maker intelligence for acquisition teams
bystreet.what_they_sell: B2B SaaS platform that aggregates and structures hotel ownership, management, and contact data for California and Latin America. Enables users to identify property owners and decision-makers, then access verified contact information to reach them.
bystreet.ai_play: AI-powered entity resolution, property-to-owner linking, and contact data enrichment. Uses NLP/ML to parse fragmented public records, deed databases, and hospitality registries to create canonical owner profiles and deduplicate contacts across sources. Likely uses web crawling + structured extraction to build and maintain the dataset.

byteport.name: Byteport
byteport.description:
Global upload acceleration for 1GB-100TB files.

Founded in 2025, Byteport is a technology company that builds mission-critical network infrastructure for robotics, satellite, AI, and enterprise applications all over the world. Businesses of every size—from new startups to public companies—use our software to accelerate file transfer online.
byteport.industry_sub_vertical: Network acceleration infrastructure for large-file transfer (robotics, satellite, AI, enterprise)
byteport.phenotype_primary_label: Vertical AI workflow agent (AI department for X)
byteport.what_they_sell: Network acceleration infrastructure (software) that speeds up large-file uploads (1GB-100TB) for technical buyers building robotics, satellite, AI, and enterprise applications
byteport.ai_play: Mission-critical network infrastructure layer enabling AI/robotics/satellite workloads that require fast, reliable large-file transfer at global scale

cactus.name: Cactus
cactus.one_liner: Low-latency AI engine for mobile devices & wearables
cactus.description:
Low-latency AI engine for mobile devices & wearables

Check out the project: https://github.com/cactus-compute/cactus
cactus.industry_sub_vertical: Edge AI inference runtime optimization for mobile & wearable devices
cactus.what_they_sell: Open-source low-latency AI inference engine (Cactus) optimized for mobile/wearable hardware, with commercial monetization via hosted inference service, enterprise support, or model optimization consulting.
cactus.ai_play: Cactus solves the edge AI bottleneck: running neural networks on resource-constrained devices (phones, wearables, IoT) with minimal latency and power consumption. Core innovation is likely quantization, pruning, or hardware-aware compilation to compress models without sacrificing accuracy. Enables on-device AI without cloud dependency.

caddy.name: Caddy
caddy.one_liner: Your partner for everyday work, lives in iMessage
caddy.description:
Your partner for everyday work, lives in iMessage

Caddy is the operating system that works proactively for you. It learns how you work and acts on your behalf, keeping work moving while your context and voice stay intact.

Instead of producing generic AI output, Caddy creates real work artifacts that sound like you and fit how you actually work. Today, it operates across the tools you use every day, including email, calendar, Slack, Linear, and Notion.

Caddy is built by the team behind Loom’s AI and core product. We believe the next era of computing is software that understands intent, handles ambiguous work, and quietly gets work done in the background.
caddy.industry_sub_vertical: Cross-functional work automation & task orchestration for knowledge workers
caddy.what_they_sell: An AI operating system (agent runtime) that proactively automates work across email, calendar, Slack, Linear, Notion, and other enterprise tools. Learns user work patterns and executes tasks autonomously while maintaining user voice and context.
caddy.ai_play: Core product is an agentic AI that understands user intent from ambiguous requests, orchestrates actions across multiple SaaS tools, and generates work artifacts (emails, messages, tasks) that sound like the user. Replaces manual task execution with autonomous background agents.

cajal-technologies.name: Cajal
cajal-technologies.one_liner: Scaling formal verification to accelerate scientific discovery
cajal-technologies.description:
Scaling formal verification to accelerate scientific discovery

Cajal (YC W26) is massively scaling formal verification to accelerate scientific discovery. We deploy superhuman AI mathematicians to high-impact applied domains, starting with quantum computing and finance.

We do this with Lean - a framework that allows us to formally verify any mathematical statement, grounding AI in truth and validating the tools discovered by our systems.
cajal-technologies.industry_sub_vertical: Formal verification infrastructure for mathematically verified proof generation in quantum computing and quantitative finance R&D
cajal-technologies.what_they_sell: Formal verification infrastructure and tooling that generates mathematically verified statements and proofs for AI training and scientific research applications
cajal-technologies.ai_play: Uses Lean formal verification framework to ground AI mathematical reasoning in provable truth, creating verified training data and validation tools for researchers in quantum computing and quantitative finance

callab-ai.name: Callab AI
callab-ai.one_liner: AI voice agents for on-prem telephony stack.
callab-ai.description:
AI voice agents for on-prem telephony stack.

58% of the $400B call center industry runs on on-prem phone systems, and until now bringing AI voice automation to them meant ripping out their entire infrastructure first. That's the largest unserved segment in the market. Callab AI connects directly to legacy PBX systems like Avaya, Cisco UCM, and Mitel, and automates up to 70% of call volume with zero migration needed.

We plug into these environments without requiring a rip-and-replace. We serve clients across three continents, including brands like Dunkin Donuts.
callab-ai.industry_sub_vertical: On-prem legacy PBX call center automation (Avaya, Cisco UCM, Mitel integration)
callab-ai.phenotype_primary_label: Vertical AI workflow agent (AI department for X)
callab-ai.what_they_sell: Proprietary AI voice agent platform that plugs into existing on-prem PBX systems to automate up to 70% of call volume without rip-and-replace migration
callab-ai.ai_play: Vertical workflow automation for call center operations, specifically targeting the underserved on-prem legacy infrastructure segment

calltree.name: Calltree
calltree.one_liner: Enterprise-grade AI support reps for call centers
calltree.description:
Enterprise-grade AI support reps for call centers

Calltree makes enterprise-grade AI support reps for call centers. Our AI reps take voice calls and chats like other AI support agents but can also use internal enterprise tools like a homegrown CRM or internal dashboards, like the highly trained humans working there today.
calltree.industry_sub_vertical: AI agent automation for enterprise call centers and BPOs
calltree.what_they_sell: AI agent software that replaces human support reps in call centers. Agents handle inbound/outbound voice calls and chats, integrate with internal enterprise tools (CRM, dashboards, knowledge bases), and execute customer service workflows autonomously.
calltree.ai_play: Multi-modal agentic AI (voice + chat) with tool-use capability to access internal enterprise systems in real-time, eliminating the need for human escalation or manual data lookup. AI learns enterprise-specific workflows and tool patterns to operate like trained human reps.

canary.name: Canary
canary.one_liner: The first AI QA engineer that understands your code
canary.description:
The first AI QA engineer that understands your code

AI coding tools have made developers 100x faster but customer-facing incidents are up 43% YoY, QA hasn't kept up. Canary is the first AI QA engineer that understands your codebase. Instead of relying on flaky DOM scraping or screenshot analysis, Canary reads your source code directly to understand developer intent and catch broken user flows before they hit production. Engineering teams go from weeks of manual testing to 90%+ coverage in days. Built by a team that built coding agents at Windsurf, Cognition and Google.
canary.industry_sub_vertical: AI-powered QA test automation for software engineering teams
canary.phenotype_primary_label: Vertical AI workflow agent (AI department for X)
canary.what_they_sell: AI QA engineer software that automates testing workflows for engineering teams by reading source code to understand intent and generate comprehensive test coverage
canary.ai_play: Code-native AI agent that replaces manual QA work by analyzing source code directly (vs DOM scraping or screenshot analysis) to understand developer intent and automatically generate tests

candor.name: Candor
candor.one_liner: We help companies win government funding with AI
candor.description:
We help companies win government funding with AI

Candor helps defense and deeptech companies navigate the government procurement process with AI. We inject agents into the procurement process - agents that not only surface opportunities but actively pursue them - giving anyone the same capabilities as large contractors. 

When we met at Stanford 4 years ago, it was rare for startups to work with the US Government. In the years that we’ve been involved in the burgeoning Defense Tech ecosystem, a lot has changed. Silicon Valley and the US Government are closer than they’ve been in decades.  

As fellows in Stanford’s Center for National Security Innovation, we’ve had the privilege of speaking with dozens of government officials who have come to Silicon Valley looking to fund and scale startups solving their most urgent problems. 

However, we’ve seen firsthand the struggles these startups face in securing gov funding. Marcus, having spoken with dozens of defense startups in his time helping lead the Stanford Defense Tech Club and trying to set up a national security startup accelerator has seen this especially.

That’s why we’re making it easier to find and apply for opportunities, taking the application process from weeks to days.

We’re only going to see more cooperation in the coming years. With that, there will be increasingly more funding going towards companies in defense, energy, biotech, quantum, etc. Candor lets you unlock that funding potential.
candor.industry_sub_vertical: Defense procurement opportunity discovery and application automation for government contracts
candor.what_they_sell: AI agents that automate government procurement workflows for defense and deeptech startups — opportunity discovery, application preparation, compliance validation, and submission management. Converts weeks-long manual processes into days.
candor.ai_play: Agentic AI that parses government RFPs/funding solicitations, extracts requirements, matches company capabilities, auto-generates compliant applications, and tracks submission deadlines. Replaces manual procurement labor with autonomous agents that level the playing field between startups and large contractors.

candor-security.name: Candor
candor-security.one_liner: Insider Threat for the Modern Enterprise
candor-security.description:
Insider Threat for the Modern Enterprise

Insider threats cost the average enterprise $17.4M per year and take up to 3 months to contain. Most of those threats (employees leaking IP, contractors staging data for exfil, accounts misusing AI tools like Copilot) get buried in thousands of noisy alerts from traditional security tools. Candor changes this by telling your security team exactly who to watch before they cause damage. Zero tuning, detection from day one, and it actually learns from analyst feedback.
candor-security.industry_sub_vertical: Enterprise insider threat detection and behavioral analytics for data exfiltration prevention
candor-security.what_they_sell: SaaS platform that detects insider threats (employee data exfiltration, IP leakage, account misuse) by analyzing user behavior and system activity. Reduces alert noise and surfaces high-risk actors with zero tuning required.
candor-security.ai_play: AI-driven behavioral anomaly detection that learns from analyst feedback to continuously improve threat ranking and reduce false positives. Replaces manual alert triage and pattern matching with learned risk models.

capacitive.name: Capacitive
capacitive.description:
The data gateway for agents.

We supercharge agents from Cursor to AgentKit with product and team-level context. Connect us once to where your internal data lives, then create secure data gateways with granular cross-platform permissions, comprehensive monitoring, and robust security filtering.
capacitive.industry_sub_vertical: Agent data gateway & internal knowledge access
capacitive.what_they_sell: A data gateway / API layer that connects agents (Cursor, AgentKit, etc.) to internal data sources with granular permissions, monitoring, and security filtering. Enables agents to access product and team context securely without exposing raw data.
capacitive.ai_play: Solves the 'agent data access' problem: agents need rich internal context (docs, code, team state, product data) to operate effectively, but enterprises need fine-grained access control, audit trails, and security filtering. Capacitive acts as a trusted intermediary that structures and gates data for agent consumption.

captain.name: Captain
captain.one_liner: Give AI agents accurate knowledge search that scales
captain.description:
Give AI agents accurate knowledge search that scales

Captain delivers the most accurate file search engine built for AI agents. We’ll index data from the sources folks already use like S3, SharePoint, and Google Drive, and easily scale multimodal, petabyte-level content search. We’re the Snowflake for Unstructured Data.

chrt builds the software for forwarders and professional couriers who pick up and deliver these orders. Couriers use chrt to coordinate and track their shipments, including a driver app and fleet management tools. Forwarders use chrt to dispatch couriers, book flights, and track time-critical orders from start to finish. Shippers use chrt to place these orders with their providers and to monitor everything. 

In addition, we also sell physical tracking devices that can be used to track valuable cargo or assets.

This gives us full control of the shipment and allows us to provide shippers with end-to-end tracking. It also allows us to intervene early if we notice something is going wrong.

We’re software engineers that became friends years ago at McKinsey. Kyle is an expert in Time-Critical Logistics, having led strategy at a leader in the space. Aaron is an expert at designing and implementing AI systems to handle complex coordination. We were shipping code together on nights and weekends for years before chrt; now we’re also shipping freight.

Enables safe, scalable multi-agent parallel development.

compyle.name: Compyle
compyle.one_liner: The coding agent that actually collaborates with you
compyle.description:
The coding agent that actually collaborates with you

Compyle is a less autonomous coding agent that asks before it acts. We're like Cursor or Claude Code - but you won't need to rewrite your codebase every time you use it for more than a small task.

We built Compyle because we were frustrated with the direction other coding agents are headed. They're all racing to be more autonomous, running for hours without human input.

This doesn't work for real production code. When agents run autonomously, they make countless small decisions that pile up in your codebase. Engineers lose ownership - they don't know what was implemented, can't effectively debug or maintain it, and struggle to build on top of it. The code becomes a black box, and they're forced to throw it away.

Compyle keeps engineers in the driver's seat.
compyle.industry_sub_vertical: Collaborative AI coding agent for production codebases
compyle.what_they_sell: A collaborative coding agent (SaaS) that generates code but requires human approval before execution, maintaining engineer ownership and codebase integrity across multi-step tasks.
compyle.ai_play: AI generates code suggestions and refactorings, but pauses for human review/approval at decision points rather than executing autonomously. This keeps engineers in control, reduces accumulation of unreviewed changes, and prevents 'black box' code that must be discarded. Differentiator vs. Cursor/Claude Code is the human-in-the-loop checkpoint architecture.

confluence-labs.name: Confluence Labs
confluence-labs.one_liner: AI models that learn from experience
confluence-labs.description:
AI models that learn from experience

While modern AI excels in any area you can collect a lot of data for, it struggles in areas where data is sparse or costly to attain. Designing new molecules, discovering new physics, and engineering new materials are all domains where collecting data is extremely costly. 

We dream of a world where AI accelerates research in all of these domains and creates a more abundant future for humanity, but the current technology is not there. That’s why we started Confluence Labs. 

We are building AI that can design highly effective experiments in data-sparse domains and learn maximally from the data it already has.
confluence-labs.industry_sub_vertical: AI models for experimental design in data-sparse scientific domains (materials science, molecular discovery, physics)
confluence-labs.phenotype_primary_label: Vertical AI workflow agent (AI department for X)
confluence-labs.what_they_sell: Foundational AI models and infrastructure for experiment design in data-sparse scientific domains (materials, molecules, physics)
confluence-labs.ai_play: Building AI that can design highly effective experiments and learn maximally from limited data where traditional supervised learning fails due to data scarcity

congruent.name: Congruent
congruent.one_liner: AI native radars for self-driving cars
congruent.description:
AI native radars for self-driving cars

At Congruent, we build radars for end-to-end autonomous systems. The most advanced autonomous systems are trained as a single neural network from raw sensor data to navigation actions. For a sensor to be included in these pipelines sensor stacks requires two key properties: access to raw sensor data and a high-fidelity sensor simulator. Current automotive radars have neither, they output heavily processed point clouds and no raw radar simulator exists for driving scenes. Congruent solves both problems: a radar architecture that exposes raw data, paired with a world model based radar simulator. Radar is the only depth sensor at a price point that scales to every car on the road and works in all weather conditions. Congruent is building the radar compatible with the training architectures that will make mass-market vehicles autonomous.
congruent.industry_sub_vertical: Autonomous vehicle radar hardware & sensor fusion for end-to-end neural network training
congruent.what_they_sell: Radar hardware + simulator for autonomous vehicle developers
congruent.ai_play: AI-native radar architecture that exposes raw data for end-to-end neural network training, paired with world model based radar simulator

conntour.name: Conntour
conntour.one_liner: AI to monitor thousands of security cameras.
conntour.description:
AI to monitor thousands of security cameras.

Conntour enables organizations to query thousands of security cameras using natural language.

Users can search past footage (“Find a man with tattoos on his left arm”), configure real-time alerts (“Notify me if someone climbs over the wall”), and extract data (“How many pickup trucks entered yesterday?”).

Unlike traditional video analytics limited to pre-defined parameters (like a weapon, bag, or license plate), Conntour supports unlimited, highly specific scenarios described in plain language. This enables a single human to monitor thousands of cameras.

Matan (CEO) worked with security cameras for years, leading video surveillance in the Israeli Military. Tomer (CTO) is a second-time founder and former director of engineering. Our team also includes computer vision experts from Israel’s elite 8200 intelligence unit and former top officials from the Mossad.

Conntour is backed by General Catalyst, selected for the first-ever Palantir fellowship, and advised by Bob Flores, former CTO at the CIA.
conntour.industry_sub_vertical: Defense surveillance & threat detection for security operations centers
conntour.what_they_sell: SaaS platform enabling security operations teams to query, search, and monitor thousands of security cameras using natural language instead of pre-configured rules. Users can search historical footage, set real-time alerts, and extract structured data from video without manual review.
conntour.ai_play: Computer vision + NLP agents replace traditional video analytics systems limited to pre-defined object detection (weapons, bags, plates). AI understands arbitrary, highly specific scenarios described in plain language ('man with tattoos on left arm', 'someone climbing wall', 'pickup trucks'), enabling one human to monitor thousands of cameras instead of dozens.

ConstellationOS bridges this gap by providing zero-intervention network handoffs, predictive thermal load-balancing, and sub-second optical routing.

Our founding team spent years building and operating satellite systems at SpaceX, Blue Origin, and NASA. We started Constellation to solve the problem we kept running into: reactive monitoring doesn't scale.

We are building the sub-second routing protocols and hyperscale load-balancing infrastructure that will manage the future of off-world telecommunications and compute. 

hello@constellation-io.com

ContextFort fills this gap by instrumenting the browser layer to observe and govern agent activity, preventing data exfiltration, unauthorized access, and compliance violations.

contrario.name: Contrario
contrario.one_liner: AI hiring platform powered by expert recruiters
contrario.description:
AI hiring platform powered by expert recruiters

In under six months, Contrario has crossed $6M in annualized revenue, paid out $1M+ to recruiters, and placed 150+ candidates — making it one of the fastest-growing AI recruiting platforms on the market.

Backed by Y Combinator, Nexus Venture Partners, Goodwater Capital, and Inventum Ventures, alongside angels including David Chen (ex-HRT), Abhijeet Dwivedi (OpenAI), Hank Couture (DoorDash), and Jerry Cain (Stanford CS). Built by Stanford dropouts. Headquartered in San Francisco.

AI augments recruiter productivity and decision-making, enabling the platform to scale recruiting capacity without proportional headcount growth. Network effects: AI agents learn from recruiter expertise; recruiters benefit from agent-assisted workflow.

corsair.name: Corsair
corsair.description:
Integration Layer for AI Agents

What Corsair is:
Corsair gives you (or your agent) safe access to hundreds of integrations. It natively handles all integration plumbing. The only code you write is the code that's specific to your use case. Your data stays yours.

Why we wrote it:
Integrations make products capable. Integrations are also frustrating to write. If you look at any codebase with integrations, 95% of the code is identical. It's all just basic plumbing. The part of the integration that is unique to a codebase and actually adds value is probably just a few lines. We shouldn't waste time writing and maintaining the 95% for a few lines. The developer community has just accepted that we do. Corsair handles the 95% so you don't have to. It's really hard to get wrong.
corsair.industry_sub_vertical: Agent integration abstraction & API access layer
corsair.what_they_sell: Open-source integration abstraction layer + commercial SaaS that gives AI agents (and developers) safe, standardized access to hundreds of third-party APIs and data sources without writing boilerplate integration code.
corsair.ai_play: Removes the friction of connecting agents to external tools and data. By handling 95% of integration plumbing (auth, retry logic, error handling, rate limiting), Corsair lets agent builders focus on agent logic, not integration mechanics. Enables agents to reliably call external services at scale.

cortex-ai.name: Cortex AI
cortex-ai.one_liner: Large-scale real-world robot & human data for embodied AI
cortex-ai.description:
Large-scale real-world robot & human data for embodied AI

Cortex AI builds the world’s most diverse and large-scale real-world workplace robot & egocentric dataset — where the physical world becomes the next training and evaluation set for embodied AI.

We power frontier labs developing robotics foundation models and general-purpose robots by providing the data they need:
1️⃣ Egocentric Data — real-workplace human video with hand/body pose, depth, and subtask labels.
2️⃣ Robot Data — trajectories collected from manipulators and humanoids in real industry settings.
3️⃣ Human-in-the-Loop Rollouts & Evals — real-world deployments with remote operators who recover robots when they fail, capturing data that feeds back into training and continuously improves models.

Additionally, through the Cortex Marketplace, workplaces get paid to host data-collection and evaluation sessions, while labs access the in-the-wild data that truly matters. This draws on Lucas’s previous experience as co-founder of Carousell, a C2C marketplace that scaled to a $1B+ valuation.
cortex-ai.industry_sub_vertical: Robotics foundation model training & evaluation data generation
cortex-ai.what_they_sell: Large-scale real-world robotics datasets: egocentric human video (hand/body pose, depth, subtask labels), robot manipulation trajectories from real industry deployments, and human-in-the-loop evaluation rollouts. Monetized via licensing to robotics labs and foundation model builders, plus a two-sided marketplace where workplaces earn fees for hosting data collection and evaluation sessions.
cortex-ai.ai_play: Cortex solves the critical bottleneck in embodied AI: real-world, diverse, in-the-wild training and evaluation data at scale. Rather than synthetic or lab-only data, they capture authentic workplace robot failures, human demonstrations, and task execution in production settings. This data directly improves robotics foundation models and enables continuous model improvement via human-in-the-loop recovery and re-training loops.

corvera.name: Corvera

crosslayer-labs.name: Crosslayer Labs
crosslayer-labs.one_liner: Protect, monitor and defend your Internet presence
crosslayer-labs.description:
Protect, monitor and defend your Internet presence

Crosslayer Labs detects impersonation attacks on websites and APIs. We provide "outside-in" monitoring of customer infrastructure, comprehensively discovering and monitoring all Internet dependencies, including DNS, BGP, TLS certs, Javascript. We correlate signals from different layers of the Internet stack to identify attack patterns. Our alerts are actionable and contain root cause analysis/remediation recommendations. duranium.name: Duranium
duranium.description:
Reshoring critical metal production

China and Russia control the world’s critical minerals. We can produce Titanium, Magnesium, Aluminum, Zirconium & Hafnium in the U.S. more profitably than any existing process, and carbon neutrally via co-production.

Carbochlorination is the primary process for producing critical metals like titanium, hafnium, and zirconium, and was once the standard for magnesium. The problem: conventional carbochlorination relies on purchasing carbon feedstocks, wastes valuable byproducts, and is highly CO₂-intensive.

Duranium changes this with a novel reactor that recycles CO₂ emissions back into feedstock (CO) while generating a valuable co-product (bleaching agents). This closed loop slashes emissions and delivers Chinese-level metal pricing without subsidies — unlocking the full potential of carbochlorination for U.S. critical mineral production.

Excellence an after-school maths and science program. We replace/supplement private tutoring and long-term study programs such as Kumon (over 30B TAM). US Parents are our primary customers. 

Our web and iPad software serves both ambitious and struggling students. As we believe each student is unique, we adapt our high quality courses and exercises to their knowledge and learning style in a very granular way. To facilitate learning, they get detailed text, voice and graphical explanations, can craft study plans, revise and memorize, and received human mentorship if needed. We believe LLMs have made edtech interesting, as technology now allows us to replicate a tutoring learning experience.

In addition, we offer a program with daily courses and exercises, detailed feedback on their worksheets and more (super Kumon).

Finally we sell the AI tutoring and exercise databases to schools in a B2B and B2B2C model and already work for the most prestigious institutions in France (Ecole polytechnique, college Stanislas...).

We're a passionate team of ex-quants, mathematicians and physics champions devoted to improving science education.
excellence-learning.industry_sub_vertical: K-12 adaptive AI tutoring for math and science
excellence-learning.what_they_sell: AI-powered adaptive tutoring platform for K-12 students in math and science, delivered via web and iPad. Offers personalized courses, exercises, detailed explanations (text/voice/graphical), study planning, and optional human mentorship. Also licenses AI tutoring and exercise databases to schools (B2B/B2B2C).
excellence-learning.ai_play: LLMs enable granular personalization of tutoring experience at scale — adapting course difficulty, explanation style, and exercise selection to each student's knowledge level and learning style. Replaces/supplements private tutoring (Kumon model) with software-driven, AI-personalized instruction.

exin-therapeutics.name: Exin Therapeutics
exin-therapeutics.one_liner: AI drug discovery platform for neurotherapeutics
exin-therapeutics.description:
AI drug discovery platform for neurotherapeutics

We use AI and high-throughput mouse studies to discover therapeutics that modify neural activity in the brain. The initial focus is on epilepsies associated with autism and Parkinson’s disease with the potential to expand to any neurological disorder underlined by a dysfunction in neural activity. Our R&D is guided by AI models trained on high-density multimodal mouse data generated in-house.

We are 3 Oxford-trained neuroscientists supported by an experienced SAB from Harvard, Science Corp (ex-Neuralink), EPFL, Meta, and UCL.

In 1.5 months since landing in SF, we went from nothing to (1) opening and operating an animal lab in South SF, (2) obtaining a proof-of-concept in mice, (3) building a multimodal AI model that directs our screening approach and (4) submitting two provisional patents; all while utilizing less than 50% of our YC funding.
exin-therapeutics.industry_sub_vertical: AI-accelerated drug discovery for neurological disorders (epilepsy, Parkinson's disease)
exin-therapeutics.what_they_sell: AI-driven drug discovery platform for neurotherapeutics. Uses in-house high-throughput mouse studies combined with multimodal AI models to identify and validate therapeutic candidates that modify neural activity. Initial focus: epilepsies associated with autism and Parkinson's disease.
exin-therapeutics.ai_play: AI models trained on proprietary high-density multimodal mouse neuroscience data (electrophysiology, imaging, behavioral) guide compound screening and target selection. AI replaces manual hypothesis-driven screening with data-driven, automated discovery workflows. Dramatically compresses R&D cycle from years to months by directing wet-lab experiments toward highest-probability therapeutic targets.

exla.name: Exla
exla.one_liner: An SDK to run transformer models anywhere
exla.description:
An SDK to run transformer models anywhere

Exla aggressively quantizes AI models to minimize memory usage and maximize inference speed. Whether you're deploying LLMs, VLMs, VLAs, or custom models, Exla reduces memory footprint by up to 80% and accelerates inference by 3–20x - all with just a few lines of code.

https://cal.com/exla-ai/schedule
exla.industry_sub_vertical: Model quantization and inference optimization for edge and cost-sensitive deployments
exla.what_they_sell: SDK for aggressive model quantization and inference optimization — enables developers to deploy transformer models (LLMs, VLMs, VLAs) anywhere with 80% memory reduction and 3–20x inference speedup via a few lines of code.
exla.ai_play: Exla abstracts away the complexity of model optimization (quantization, pruning, kernel-level acceleration) so developers can deploy large models on resource-constrained environments (edge, mobile, on-prem) without retraining or sacrificing accuracy. Reduces the infrastructure cost and latency barrier for agentic AI deployment.

exonic.name: Exonic
exonic.description:
Unsupervised Biological AI

What if you could train a biological foundation model on... the entire internet?

Exonic is pioneering a new generation of biological foundation models, focused on heterogeneous, unstructured, and noisy datasets.

Our first application is the design of safer gene therapies.

In 2025, we used AI to set a new state of the art in liver cancer targeted gene therapy, validated in vitro in our lab in San Francisco.

So far in 2026, we have trained a new model with unprecedented zero-shot generalization on genomic regulatory expression in hold-out biosample datasets. More to be shared soon.
exonic.industry_sub_vertical: Gene therapy design and safety optimization via biological foundation models
exonic.what_they_sell: Biological foundation models trained on heterogeneous genomic and biomedical datasets, with initial application to gene therapy design and safety optimization. Models enable zero-shot prediction of genomic regulatory expression and therapeutic efficacy.
exonic.ai_play: AI-native biotech R&D: trains unsupervised foundation models on unstructured biological data (internet-scale genomic datasets, biosamples, regulatory sequences) to replace manual gene therapy design iteration. First validated use case: safer, more targeted liver cancer gene therapies designed and validated in-house. Models generalize across hold-out datasets without task-specific fine-tuning.

expanse.name: Expanse
expanse.description:
Unlock wasted GPU capacity.

Expanse unlocks wasted GPU capacity. We recover idle compute through three capabilities: resource prediction (right-sizing job submissions before they reach the scheduler), optimisation suggestions (code and config changes researchers can apply themselves), and failure prediction (catching jobs that will fail before they consume hours of GPU time).

We’re four engineers. We ran HPC and GPU training workloads at the largest quant funds and national supercomputing centres. We faced this problem first hand and the only fix was to over-provision and burn millions. Ismaeel built the first multimodal HPC resource predictor as research at EPCC (Edinburgh’s Parallel Computing Centre), which beat every published baseline. This is the tool we wish we had.
expanse.industry_sub_vertical: GPU training job resource prediction, optimization & failure prevention for HPC clusters
expanse.what_they_sell: AIOps platform that right-sizes GPU job submissions, suggests code/config improvements, and predicts job failures before they waste compute time
expanse.ai_play: Multimodal HPC resource predictor trained on cluster telemetry to forecast GPU requirements and prevent waste across any ML/HPC workload

expected-parrot.name: Expected Parrot
expected-parrot.one_liner: Simulate your customers with AI agents
expected-parrot.description:
Simulate your customers with AI agents

Expected Parrot helps companies simulate their customers with AI agents to explore pricing, product, marketing, communications and other scenarios at scale. Our open-source library and no-code web app let you design custom agent personas and conduct interviews and surveys with them using LLMs of your choice to generate results and reports. Everything is cached and reproducible, and you can send the same surveys to human respondents to validate results in the same interface.
expected-parrot.industry_sub_vertical: Customer simulation & synthetic data generation for product research
expected-parrot.what_they_sell: Open-source library + SaaS platform for designing AI agent personas and running simulated customer interviews, surveys, and scenario testing. Users design custom personas, conduct interviews with LLM-powered agents, generate reports, and validate results against real human respondents in the same interface.
expected-parrot.ai_play: AI agents act as synthetic customers/respondents to simulate market research at scale. LLMs generate realistic persona-driven responses to product, pricing, and marketing scenarios. Caching and reproducibility enable deterministic, cost-efficient research workflows. Hybrid human-AI validation (synthetic + real respondent comparison) reduces research bias and increases confidence in findings.

f2.name: F2
f2.one_liner: The AI platform for private markets investors
f2.description:
The AI platform for private markets investors

F2 is the AI platform for private markets investors. Purpose-built for private credit, private equity, and commercial banking, F2 accelerates diligence, underwriting, and portfolio monitoring, helping teams evaluate deals over 60% faster. 

F2 turns unstructured deal data into investment-grade analysis and polished memos in minutes. Unlike general-purpose AI, F2 is built with the domain expertise and depth to handle the most complex financial analysis. Already trusted across thousands of deals, F2 makes collaboration easy and retains historical context, so past work compounds into future wins. 

Headquartered in New York City, F2 is backed by leading investors including NFX, Left Lane Capital, and Y Combinator.
f2.industry_sub_vertical: Private markets deal diligence and underwriting automation for PE, credit, and commercial banking
f2.what_they_sell: SaaS platform that automates diligence, underwriting, and portfolio monitoring workflows for private equity, private credit, and commercial banking teams. Ingests unstructured deal data (documents, financials, contracts) and produces investment-grade analysis and memos.
f2.ai_play: AI agents parse complex financial documents, extract key metrics, synthesize analysis, and generate polished investment memos—replacing manual, time-intensive diligence work. Domain-specific training on private markets workflows enables 60% faster deal evaluation vs. manual processes.

f4-industries.name: F4 Industries
f4-industries.one_liner: The GD&T Analysis Platform for Engineering Drawings
f4-industries.description:
The GD&T Analysis Platform for Engineering Drawings

GD&T takes years to master. Engineers must encode their design intent into a dense syntax that manufacturers must decode, and not everyone gets it right. 

Put ten engineers in front of the same drawing and you may get ten different interpretations. Which means errors often surface later in interface stack-ups, manufacturing, or in the field - when they’re far more expensive to fix.

That’s why we built F4 - the platform that analyzes GD&T to determine whether your designs are ready for production.

Drop in your drawing and 3D file. F4 analyzes every element of your GD&T to assess whether your design is clear, manufacturable, and production ready. To make the drawing easier to understand, engineers can visualize their datums, reference frames, and tolerance zones directly on the 3D model. F4 also calculates tolerance stack-ups instantly - directly from the drawing. What once took hours of manual work now takes seconds.

When issues are found, F4 flags them and guides engineers toward resolving the problem.

After analyzing your drawing, F4 also automatically generates design and inspection reports - stack-up tables, FAI reports - ready to share with your team.

And it does all of this locally on-device with no AI used for analysis. Producing deterministic results engineers can trust.
f4-industries.industry_sub_vertical: Engineering design validation & GD&T analysis for manufacturing
f4-industries.what_they_sell: SaaS platform that analyzes GD&T (Geometric Dimensioning & Tolerancing) in engineering drawings and 3D CAD files to validate design clarity, manufacturability, and production readiness. Generates tolerance stack-ups, design reports, and FAI documentation automatically.
f4-industries.ai_play: AI/ML models trained on engineering best practices and manufacturing constraints analyze drawing semantics, detect GD&T errors, ambiguities, and stack-up issues that would otherwise require hours of manual expert review. Deterministic analysis (no black-box inference) produces results engineers can trust and act on. Reduces design iteration cycles and catches manufacturing defects before production.

flai.name: Flai
flai.one_liner: We Bring Customers to Your Dealership
flai.description:
We Bring Customers to Your Dealership

The problem we solve: 56% of dealership leads arrive after business hours, and most dealers lose these potential customers to competitors who happen to be available 24/7. Missing after-hours calls alone costs the average dealership $1M annually in lost revenue.

We built Flai to fix this - AI assistants that answer dealership calls 24/7, scheduling test drives, oil changes, or running outbound recall campaigns so no opportunity slips away.

The result: No more missed opportunities, no more losing customers to competitors.

Our founding team has built voice AI products at HappyRobot, scaled infrastructure at Uber for millions of users, and applied data science at Netflix to solve operational challenges.

We're not just answering phones, we're helping dealerships win in an AI-first world where availability determine who gets the sale.

flai.ai_play: Replaces human receptionist/BDC (business development center) labor for after-hours and peak-load call handling. AI agents capture leads that would otherwise be lost to competitors, schedule appointments autonomously, and reduce manual administrative overhead. Monetized as vertical SaaS subscription per dealership.

fleetline.name: Fleetline
fleetline.one_liner: Optimizing fleet planning with data driven algorithms
fleetline.description:
Optimizing fleet planning with data driven algorithms

Fleetline is building the first complete-context algorithmic load planner for mid to large-sized trucking fleets. Today’s dispatchers face an overwhelming task: balancing regulations, customer demands, live fleet data, and individual driver needs, all while coordinating across siloed tools and teams. Mistakes run rampant, and each mistake is thousands of dollars. Even the select fleets using algorithms that have fleet-wide context struggle: the outputs are rigid, hard to interpret, and are blind to real-world nuances like driver preferences and schedule exceptions. Fleetline solves this by combining advanced optimization with LLMs that can easily adapt algorithms to each fleet’s needs and capture driver-specific information. The result is smarter planning truly optimized for every fleet and its drivers.
fleetline.industry_sub_vertical: Trucking fleet load planning & dispatch optimization
fleetline.what_they_sell: End-user SaaS platform that deploys AI agents to automate load planning and dispatch for mid-to-large trucking fleets. Agents integrate with fleet management systems, live vehicle telemetry, regulatory databases, and driver preferences to generate optimized routes and assignments that dispatchers can understand and override.
fleetline.ai_play: Combines constraint-satisfaction optimization (vehicle routing, regulatory compliance, capacity) with LLM-based reasoning to adapt plans to fleet-specific nuances (driver preferences, schedule exceptions, real-world constraints). LLMs make rigid algorithmic outputs interpretable and flexible; optimization ensures feasibility and cost efficiency. Agents continuously ingest live fleet context (vehicle location, driver status, customer demands) and re-optimize in real time.

flick.name: Flick

There are many AI tools that can give you 8-second casual clips to post on social media, but when it comes to creating truly high-quality films with coherent storylines, consistent characters, and cinematic aesthetics, they don’t come close due to their lack of flexibility, creative control, and fragmented creative flow.

Founded by an award-winning filmmaker and a founding engineer at Instagram, Flick defines an interface specifically designed for native AI filmmaking that feels natural and enables end-to-end creative flows. Think of Flick as Figma for AI filmmaking.

There are 4 complete AI short films created using Flick that got 20+ awards in international film festivals already and our early creator residency community are generating several AI short films every week.

We are also building a community where we produce our own AI films as well as collaborating with other well-known filmmakers to share their “behind-the-scenes” workflows as resuable templates to inspire users in our community. We not only build product, we also build world-class content.

The whole film industry will be revolutionized by AI and our goal is to be “the product” that defines this category.

flick.what_they_sell: End-to-end AI filmmaking SaaS platform enabling creators (prosumers, independent filmmakers, content studios) to produce Hollywood-quality short films with coherent narratives, consistent characters, and cinematic aesthetics. Includes native AI editing interface, character/scene management, template library, and community distribution.

Founders' filmmaker expertise embedded in UX design (Figma-like interface) to make AI filmmaking feel natural and non-fragmented. Community + template library creates network effects and reduces friction for new creators.

floot.name: Floot
floot.one_liner: The easiest way for non-coders to build apps with AI.
floot.description:
The easiest way for non-coders to build apps with AI.

Floot lets non-coders & entrepreneurs build real web apps that actually work. We’re taking a new approach by building everything from the ground up for AI.

✨ Try building an app at floot.com

Existing AI app builders fall short of enabling non-coders to build real, serious apps. They often:
- Break down when building anything more than a prototype or toy app
- Have non-coders stuck with errors they don’t understand
- Require non-coders to handle multiple services designed for developers (e.g. for backend, database, hosting, etc)

The fundamental problem: these AI app builders just cobble together existing developer tools and slap AI on top, but these tools were designed for humans and not for AI.

The result? Non-coders get excited, start building, hit a wall, and then abandon their projects.

Floot is purpose-built for AI. Our secret sauce:

1) Instead of reusing a coding framework designed for humans, we created a specialized framework that dictates how AI should write code and how the code runs on our infrastructure. This allows us to enforce best practices, detect errors earlier, and give the best feedback to the AI. As a result, Floot can write better code and fix issues more effectively.

2) Floot has the entire tech stack built-in (backend, database, hosting, etc) so building and managing an app feels seamless, especially for non-coders. And because we control every layer of the stack, we can optimize each layer for AI-first coding.

Because of this, non-coders can get more done with less time and prompting. They can finally build serious apps that work, instead of getting stuck in frustrating error loops and then abandoning their projects.

We also built a highly scalable hosting system directly on AWS so Floot apps can handle real traffic and business demands. This means non-coders can build, deploy, and scale their apps on a single platform seamlessly.

Plus, Floot is really fun…
floot.industry_sub_vertical: AI-assisted no-code web application development platform for non-technical entrepreneurs
floot.what_they_sell: A no-code SaaS platform enabling non-coders and entrepreneurs to build, deploy, and scale production-ready web applications using AI-assisted code generation. Floot provides an integrated tech stack (backend, database, hosting, observability) optimized for AI-first development, eliminating the need for users to manage multiple developer tools.
floot.ai_play: AI is the core development engine: LLMs generate application code within Floot's specialized framework that enforces best practices, detects errors early, and provides corrective feedback to the AI. The framework is purpose-built for AI code generation (not adapted from human-centric frameworks), enabling higher code quality, faster iteration, and better error recovery than existing AI app builders. AI handles full-stack development; users provide intent via natural language prompts.

foaster.name: Foaster
foaster.one_liner: The AI-native consulting firm for AI transformation.

The AI-native consulting firm for AI transformation.

Foaster is the AI-native consulting firm for AI transformation, powered by agents instead of armies of consultants.

Companies are spending millions on AI tools, pilots, workshops, and roadmaps. But most confuse AI adoption with AI transformation. Adoption is buying tools. Transformation is understanding how work should change across every team, workflow, and role. Traditional consulting moves too slowly for that: a few interviews, a few workshops, a static roadmap, then the company is left to execute.

Foaster uses AI agents to go much faster and much deeper. Agents interview employees at scale, map how work actually happens, and build in days a roadmap showing what should be automated, redesigned, or improved first. Then Foaster stays embedded to keep the transformation moving through adoption tracking, deeply personalized upskilling, and continuous follow-up.

The result is the precision and scale of AI, with human experts brought in where judgment, expertise and implementation matter most.

Today, contractors run complex businesses on a patchwork of tools that were never designed for construction — estimates in spreadsheets, plans in email, proposals copy-pasted from old Word docs, photos scattered across phones. Nothing talks to anything else, and the admin work never stops.
Foreman replaces that patchwork with a single platform that manages the full lifecycle of a construction job, from first estimate to final invoice. Contractors upload plans, photos, or a project description, and Foreman's AI instantly generates structured takeoffs, scoped estimates, and professional proposals — in minutes, not hours. From there, every customer record, document, permit, photo, change order, and conversation lives in one place, organized around the job.
The result: contractors spend less time buried in admin and more time building. They bid faster, manage jobs with less chaos, and close projects cleanly — without duct-taping five tools together to do it.

AI Grading for Teachers

Frizzle uses AI to grade handwritten math assignments for teachers and transform them into rich analytics and differentiated assessment to help personalize instruction for every student. Frizzle is the most valuable piece of software for teachers ever, as it eliminates the most time-consuming part of their workflow so they can focus on teaching.

Frizzle shifts education from waterfall to agile learning. Instead of waiting for end-of-unit tests to discover gaps, teachers get continuous, real-time insight into student thinking from everyday work. Feedback becomes immediate, instruction adapts weekly, and learning iterates (measure, adjust, improve) so every student progresses faster with less teacher burnout.

Frizzle was named an official White House AI Education Partner alongside OpenAI and Meta: https://www.whitehouse.gov/edai/.

Frizzle was co-founded by Abhay Gupta and Shyam Sai, who met in high school over 10 years ago.

Replaces 10+ hours/week of manual grading with minutes of AI processing.

galactic-resource-utilization-space-inc-.one_liner: Moon Hotel -> The Intergalactic Construction Company of Earth
galactic-resource-utilization-space-inc-.description:
Moon Hotel -> The Intergalactic Construction Company of Earth

GRU Space is building permanent lunar infrastructure to make humanity interplanetary within our lifetime, starting with the first hotel on the Moon. In just 6 weeks, we built the world's first Moon factory: patent-pending hardware that turns lunar regolith into bricks and inflates modular pressurized habitats designed to withstand lunar temperature and pressure extremes. 

Our first mission lands on the Moon in 2027 to demonstrate in-situ brick manufacturing and habitat deployment. A second mission lays the hotel's foundation inside a lunar cave, and a third opens the first lunar hotel, targeted for 2032. 

We don’t stop at Moon hotels. GRU’s long-term plan:

1. Build the first hotel on the Moon. GRU solves off‑world surface habitation.
2. Become the Moon Base Company of America: build roads, mass drivers, warehouses, and physical infrastructure.
3. Repeat on Mars and build the first cities there.
4. Own property on the Moon and Mars as these economies grow.
5. Reinvest profits into resource utilization systems on the Moon, Mars, asteroids, and beyond—reaching our final form: Galactic Resource Utilization.

GRU Space is backed by investors in SpaceX and Anduril, is part of Nvidia's Inception program, and our launch generated 1B+ views across 60+ countries, earning invitations to the White House, Senate, and Pentagon.
galactic-resource-utilization-space-inc-.what_they_sell: Integrated hardware + software systems for lunar construction: regolith processing factories, modular pressurized habitats, deployment infrastructure, and autonomous operational control systems

galen-ai.name: Galen AI
galen-ai.one_liner: Personal AI healthcare agent, powered by clinical and wearable data.
galen-ai.description:
Personal AI healthcare agent, powered by clinical and wearable data.

Galen is an AI-powered personal healthcare companion. We enable patients to securely connect their medical records from over 800 healthcare institutions across more than 12,000 locations in the United States, United Kingdom, and Canada. We also connect with over 20 popular wearable devices including Apple Watch, Fitbit, and Dexcom, bringing all your medical records and health data into one unified space. 

We founded Galen because for over four years, Viraj struggled to navigate several conditions related to chronic low back pain. He often found himself waiting weeks for responses from his care team, received little guidance or education about new diagnoses, and was overwhelmed trying to manage overlapping conditions and medications.

His experiences are not unique. Our healthcare system is overloaded and fragmented, and often, patients are left to navigate their care on their own. Everyday there are nearly 1 billion health-related Google searches, but the responses to such queries are generic and impersonalized, because the searches lack any insight into a users personal health background.

By leveraging your own data and state-of-the art LLM memory capabilities, Galen delivers personalized insights, proactive health recommendations, and 24/7 on-demand medical support — empowering patients to be an active part of their health team. We are a consumer app in beta testing and will be available on the App Store soon!

galen-ai.what_they_sell: Mobile app (iOS/Android) delivering a personal AI healthcare companion that aggregates medical records from 800+ US/UK/CA healthcare institutions and 20+ wearable devices (Apple Watch, Fitbit, Dexcom) into a unified interface. Provides 24/7 on-demand medical support, personalized health insights, proactive recommendations, and patient education tailored to individual medical history and chronic conditions.
galen-ai.ai_play: LLM-powered conversational agent with long-context memory and RAG over patient's own clinical data + wearable telemetry. AI personalizes generic health information to individual patient context (diagnoses, medications, conditions, real-time biometrics), replacing impersonal web search with clinically grounded, patient-specific guidance. Reduces friction in patient-provider communication and enables autonomous health navigation.
