getasap.name: GETASAP
getasap.one_liner: Distribution at the Speed of Compute
getasap.description:
Distribution at the Speed of Compute

Fresh-produce supply chains are built around guesswork. Growers plant without clear demand signals, distributors overbuy to protect against shortages, and retailers end up eating the waste. GETASAP fixes this by rebuilding distribution around real demand and fast execution. We deliver wholesale fresh produce with 8-hour same-day delivery, using micro-fulfillment centers positioned close to demand so we can operate with far less safety stock.

Behind the scenes, we look at live retail sales, purchasing, and waste patterns to decide what to source, where to place inventory, and when to replenish. That lets us buy closer to actual demand, turn inventory faster, and materially reduce spoilage. For retailers, GETASAP replaces procurement teams and fragmented supplier management—we handle sourcing, inventory decisions, and fulfillment end to end as a single, reliable partner. As more volume flows through the network, demand becomes clearer, sourcing gets smarter, and the operation becomes cheaper and more predictable over time.

ghosteye.name: GhostEye
ghosteye.one_liner: Vulnerability Management for the Human Layer
ghosteye.description:
Vulnerability Management for the Human Layer

Right now, someone could look up your employees online, craft a perfect phishing email using what they find, and get into your systems by lunch. Or just call your help desk and pretend to be a new hire. No malware. No exploit. Just a conversation.

GhostEye does this first. We continuously map your employees' real-world exposure the same way a threat actor would, then automatically generate and launch personalized phishing attacks, scam calls, texts, and deepfakes to test them before the real thing hits. Every attack is unique because every employee's exposure is unique.

Quantified human risk scores that track over time. Employees shown exactly how they were compromised. Not a training platform. A security tool.
ghosteye.industry_sub_vertical: Human-layer vulnerability assessment and social engineering testing
ghosteye.what_they_sell: Continuous human-layer vulnerability assessment platform that maps employee real-world exposure (social media, public records, organizational data) and automatically generates personalized phishing attacks, scam calls, texts, and deepfakes to test employee resilience before real threat actors exploit them. Delivers quantified human risk scores and post-incident forensics showing exactly how each employee was compromised.
ghosteye.ai_play: AI generates hyper-personalized social engineering attacks (phishing emails, voice calls, texts, deepfakes) tailored to each employee's unique exposure surface. Uses LLMs to craft contextually relevant pretexts, voice synthesis for scam calls, and potentially generative media for deepfakes. Automates at scale what manual red-teaming does manually — but continuously, uniquely per employee, and with measurable outcomes.

gigacatalyst.name: Gigacatalyst
gigacatalyst.one_liner: Customize your software to every user with AI

Customize your software to every user with AI

Gigacatalyst allows sales and CS teams to build missing features that customers need, so you stop losing business because of feature gaps. We’ve helped our customers unblock $1M in sales in 6 weeks.

We do this with an embedded AI customization layer that learns your APIs. Each customer can now adapt your product to match their workflows perfectly, and share it across their team with our in-built app store.

The result is that customers use your SaaS more, retain for longer, and expand quicker, because they get bespoke implementation for their exact usecase, without waiting.

We're live with the top Series B companies with 90% repeat usage rate. Our customers tell us that Gigacatalyst is the best way to increase usage, retention, and expansion in 2026.

glue.name: Glue
glue.one_liner: The Interface Design Canvas for AI agents
glue.description:
The Interface Design Canvas for AI agents

Glue is an open source design editor for AI agents. It gives coding agents an infinite canvas to create new interfaces, iterate on existing ones, and turn those changes into production-ready code all in real time.

The rise of coding agents is collapsing EPD into one role: builders. This new paradigm means design and engineering can now converge to a single workflow. Builders no longer want static mockups in one tool, and implementation in another.

Glue is a collaborative workspace where builders and agents can create new components, iterate on existing interfaces, and implement as code. The same tight feedback loop that once made Figma powerful for designers is now built for builders and their armies of agents. Being open source allows us to penetrate workflows at zero cost and build trust quickly.

Right now there are no design tools with AI as the primary user. Existing tools bolt on copilots as an afterthought. Soon, every company will have AI agents building their interfaces. We are building the surface for this workflow.
glue.industry_sub_vertical: AI-native interface design canvas for coding agents
glue.what_they_sell: Open-source design editor (infinite canvas) + commercial hosted workspace for builders and AI agents to collaboratively create interfaces and generate production code
glue.ai_play: Positioning AI agents as first-class design tool users rather than bolt-on copilots; tight feedback loop between design iteration and code generation mirrors Figma's designer workflow but for agent-assisted builders

godela.name: Godela

godela.description:
AI Physics Engine to replace simulations and prototypes

Godela is an AI-powered physics engine that gives engineers faster, cheaper replacement to simulations and physical prototypes.
No set up, no wait. Just ask—and get simulation quality result.

godela.what_they_sell: AI-powered physics engine SaaS that replaces traditional CAD simulations and physical prototypes for aerospace and advanced manufacturing engineers. Replaces expensive FEA/CFD solvers and physical prototyping cycles with fast, scalable neural inference. AI dramatically compresses R&D cycle time and cost.

gojiberry-ai.name: Gojiberry AI
gojiberry-ai.one_liner: AI GTM agents for B2B teams
gojiberry-ai.description:
AI GTM agents for B2B teams

Gojiberry is building the AI GTM team for B2B companies.

We start with outbound: Gojiberry finds buyers showing intent, enriches them, reaches out, follows up, handles replies, and books qualified meetings.

Companies use Gojiberry to replace the old way of doing outbound: buying tools, hiring SDRs & agencies, testing lists, writing messages, and guessing what works. Gojiberry turns it into one AI team that finds buyers and books meetings.

Every campaign makes Gojiberry smarter. It learns which buyers convert, which signals matter, which messages get replies, and which actions create revenue. Over time, Gojiberry uses what works across similar companies and industries to help every new customer get better results from day one.

Long term, Gojiberry will become the system that finds every revenue opportunity and acts on it: outbound leads, website visitors, inbound leads, old CRM leads, replies, meetings, CRM updates, new campaign ideas, and account expansion.

The goal is to make every B2B company able to run a high-performing GTM team without hiring one.

We grew from $0 to $2.5M ARR in 10 months, are growing 35% MoM, profitable, and used by 2,000+ customers.

Customers get 2-5x more positive replies than traditional outbound.
gojiberry-ai.industry_sub_vertical: B2B outbound sales prospecting & meeting booking automation
gojiberry-ai.phenotype_primary_label: Vertical AI workflow agent (AI department for X)

gojiberry-ai.ai_play: Multi-step agentic system that learns from campaign outcomes (reply rates, conversion signals, message effectiveness) and applies learnings across customer base to improve results over time

goldbridge.name: Goldbridge
goldbridge.description:
Ramp for Real Estate

Goldbridge is building the financial operating system for the largest asset class in the world – real estate. More than $1T in rent flows through landlord bank accounts annually, with roughly a quarter locked in idle reserves and security deposits – and billions more leaking from unnecessary property expenses. And with $2.5T in real estate loans about to mature in 2027/28, property owners are desperate to boost their income ASAP. 

Goldbridge solves this problem by creating the first AI-powered banking platform for real estate owners. We are backed by Y Combinator and other world-class investors, and our founding team includes a 2x YC founder, former White House advisor, and 100-unit real estate owner/operator with deep industry expertise. Come help us redefine the future of real estate.
goldbridge.industry_sub_vertical: Real estate owner treasury and reserve management with AI-powered banking
goldbridge.what_they_sell: AI-powered banking platform and financial operating system for real estate owners. Core offerings: deposit/treasury accounts, automated reserve and security deposit management, expense optimization, and lending products tailored to real estate cash flows and maturity cycles.
goldbridge.ai_play: AI automates treasury optimization (identifying idle reserves, optimizing deposit allocation), expense categorization and reduction, underwriting for real estate-specific lending (using property financials, lease data, maturity risk), and predictive cash flow modeling. AI changes the banking SKU by enabling lower-cost, higher-yield products for real estate owners vs. traditional banks.

golf.name: Golf
golf.description:
Agentic AI Security and Governance

Golf gives enterprises visibility into shadow AI and control over AI agents and MCP. See what's connected, enforce policies, and generate audit trails - all from one place.

golf.what_they_sell: Enterprise platform providing visibility, control, and compliance for AI agents and MCP (Model Context Protocol) deployments. Core offering: shadow AI detection, policy enforcement, audit trail generation, and governance dashboards for enterprises running agentic AI workloads.

Solves the governance gap: as enterprises deploy more autonomous agents, they need visibility into what's connected, what policies are enforced, and compliance evidence. Golf provides the observability and control layer.

golpo.name: Golpo
golpo.one_liner: Create Whiteboard Explainer Videos with AI from a Prompt or Document
golpo.description:
Create Whiteboard Explainer Videos with AI from a Prompt or Document

Golpo AI is the world's best platform to create fully produced whiteboard explainer videos from just a prompt or document. Instead of hiring an agency, you simply input a prompt or document explaining what you want, and in minutes you get a whiteboard explainer video in a style similar to Khan Academy or RSA Animate. After creation, you have the ability to edit all aspects of the video with just prompts. 

It's perfect for training, faceless YouTube, marketing, technical, and educational videos — any video where understanding is important. Trusted by over 120,000 users, Golpo features include but are not limited to: 

1) Convert your narration into an explainer video (with your narration as audio and the video time aligned) 
2) Input your document or prompt. Document can be of virtually any format or type (text, audio, video etc.) 
3) Script-to-video with matching audio
4) Videos up to 10 minutes
5) 50+ languages
6) dead-simple editing after generation
7) Insert your own videos and images into the generation, used as-is without alteration.
8) 10+ visuals styles, including pen in hand, voice cloning, vertical video, custom branding and more! API access available.
golpo.industry_sub_vertical: AI-powered explainer video generation for marketing and training collateral
golpo.what_they_sell: SaaS platform enabling users (educators, marketers, content creators, trainers) to generate fully-produced whiteboard explainer videos from prompts, documents, or narration in minutes. Includes editing, multi-language support, custom branding, and API access.
golpo.ai_play: Replaces manual video production (scripting, storyboarding, animation, voiceover) with end-to-end generative AI. Users input intent (prompt/document) and receive production-ready video; AI handles script generation, visual synthesis, audio alignment, and style application.

govguard.name: GovGuard
govguard.description:
AI Infrastructure for Government Agencies

Today, when a city gets a FOIA request, the process is still painfully manual.

City clerks have to hunt through archived emails, meeting minutes, PDFs, and shared drives just to find the relevant records. Many offices still manually black out sensitive information with a Sharpie, line by line.

Local governments spend billions processing these requests. It’s slow, expensive, and a large request can create massive backlogs. If a city misses the deadline for a request, they can be sued for failing to comply with public records law.

GovGuard uses AI agents to automatically search across years of records, flag sensitive information for redaction, and prepare draft response letters for review. Our redaction engine handles harder edge cases like trade secrets and privileged material. Legacy tools require clerks to manually cite state codes for every redaction, while GovGuard is built with these exemptions.

The new surge of AI-generated requests are overwhelming clerk offices. Most cities we speak with are seeing request volume grow 2x year over year, with no increase in staff. The tools they have today are basically Jira. They help manage the ticket/request, but not complete the work.
govguard.industry_sub_vertical: Government public records compliance and FOIA request processing automation
govguard.phenotype_primary_label: Vertical AI workflow agent (AI department for X)
govguard.what_they_sell: Vertical AI SaaS platform that automates FOIA request processing for city and local government agencies—agents handle record search, sensitivity flagging, redaction, and response letter generation
govguard.ai_play: Vertical workflow agent that replaces manual FOIA clerk work with AI-driven end-to-end automation, handling document discovery, exemption classification, and compliance-ready output

Robot Cowboys that Herd Cattle with AI Drones

GrazeMate builds autonomous drones that herd cattle.

On command, our drones fly to a paddock, position themselves around the mob, and move them where they need to go. What used to take a full day of helicopters, motorbikes, and horses now runs on a schedule.

We work with some of the largest cattle ranches in the world. While the drones are herding, they're also estimating animal weights, measuring grass biomass, monitoring water levels, and flagging sick animals. We're building physical AI that lets a grazier manage thousands of head across millions of acres from their phone.

groundcontrol.name: GroundControl

GroundControl builds mission-critical software for manufacturers in highly-regulated industries (aerospace, defense, medical)

Our core product automates lengthy, complex, and regulated quality documentation in aerospace manufacturing.

As an example, the Boeing 777 is made up of over 3 million parts sourced from manufacturers around the world. These manufacturers must complete quality documentation for every part on this aircraft (machined parts, printed circuit boards, wire harnesses, assemblies, and more).

GroundControl helps manufacturers complete this required documentation accurately, in minutes instead of days.

groundcontrol.what_they_sell: SaaS platform that automates quality documentation workflows for aerospace and defense manufacturers. Agents parse manufacturing specs, part data, and test results to auto-generate required compliance documentation (FAA, AS9100, etc.) that would otherwise require days of manual work per part.
groundcontrol.ai_play: AI agents replace manual quality documentation labor by understanding domain-specific compliance requirements, ingesting unstructured manufacturing data (specs, test reports, CAD), and generating audit-ready documentation. Reduces days of work to minutes while maintaining regulatory compliance and traceability.

guild.name: GUILD

halluminate.name: Halluminate
halluminate.one_liner: Data and RL environments to automate knowledge work
halluminate.description:
Data and RL environments to automate knowledge work

We help foundation model labs and enterprises train computer use AI with data and sandboxes.

A knowledge worker spends 90% of their day on a computer. A productive AI agent must similarly learn how to use our computers, browsers, and software to deliver real world value. 

Today, browser and computer use AI is inaccurate, slow, and expensive. Model labs and enterprises who want to improve these agents are bottlenecked by two resources: 

1) High quality datasets for benchmarking and evaluations
2) Realistic sandbox environments for safe and accurate testing/training (ex. a simulated version of Salesforce) 

Halluminate offers a suite of products and services to address both these issues. 

Our evaluation service combines proprietary datasets with high quality annotations to help our customers identify and prioritize the biggest failure modes of their computer- and browser- use AI. 

Our platform provides a catalog of fully managed sandboxes, empowering our customers to safely and accurately test/train at scale, resulting in improved performance. 

Our customers see
- Improved browser- and computer-use agent performance
- New and emergent frontier agent capabilities
- Data driven prioritization leading to exponentially faster development speed
- Increased revenue/sales via marketing from public benchmarks

Our paying customers already include leading computer use model labs and the two largest browser agent companies in the space. 

Wyatt and Jerry are friends that met their first week of school studying CS at Cornell University. They’ve been working and studying together for 7+ years.
halluminate.industry_sub_vertical: Training & evaluation data generation for computer-use and browser-use AI agents
halluminate.what_they_sell: High-quality evaluation datasets with expert annotations + managed sandbox environments (simulated software instances like Salesforce) for benchmarking and training computer-use and browser-use AI agents.
halluminate.ai_play: Halluminate solves the data and environment bottleneck for foundation model labs and enterprises building computer-use agents. They provide: (1) curated, annotated datasets that identify failure modes in agent performance, enabling data-driven prioritization of improvements; (2) realistic, fully-managed sandbox environments that allow safe, scalable training and testing without production risk. This directly accelerates agent capability development and reduces iteration cycles.

harbera.name: Harbera

Reduces administrative burden and eliminates revenue leakage from preventable credential gaps.

harper.name: Harper

AI-native commercial insurance brokerage

The fastest & most scalable graph-vector database on the market

hexa.description:
We automate sourcing and quoting. Distributors sell more at higher margins.

Hey everyone, we’re Ishaan, Auri and Mann - cofounders of Hexa 👋


TLDR

Hexa automates sales and procurement for industrial distributors and manufacturers, helping them source parts cheaper and quote faster to grow revenue by over 10%.



The Problem

Mid-market distributors and high-volume manufacturers run everything through legacy ERPs, and those systems still depend on humans to key in every quote, order, and invoice.

Sales reps spend their days reading RFQs from email, PDF, Excel, and fax, then retyping them into the ERP instead of talking to customers.

Quoting takes hours, which means distributors respond slowly and lose 15%+ of revenue each year.

The people who actually know how to run these systems are retiring. Over half the workforce will leave this decade, and the knowledge in their heads walks out with them.

You cannot grow faster than you can hire. Service slows and relationships suffer.

The Solution



Hexa plugs into the systems you already use and brings AI agents natively inside the ERP. No rip-and-replace, live in days.

Hexa watches every channel a request comes in on and runs the full workflow:

* Quoting: Reads the RFQ, matches the right SKU and pricing, and drafts the quote so it is ready to send.
* Order Entry: Matches the incoming PO to the quote, creates the sales order, and writes it into the ERP.
* Procurement & Finance: Sources out-of-stock items at the best cost, then reconciles AP/AR and catches discrepancies humans miss.

Reps review

hexa.what_they_sell: AI agents embedded in ERP systems that automate end-to-end sales and procurement workflows: RFQ parsing, quote generation, order entry, supplier sourcing, and AP/AR reconciliation for industrial distributors and manufacturers.
hexa.ai_play: Replaces manual data entry and quote-to-cash cycles by deploying agents that read unstructured RFQs (email, PDF, Excel, fax), match SKUs to pricing, generate quotes, create sales orders, source out-of-stock items, and reconcile invoices—all natively inside existing ERPs without rip-and-replace.

inloop-robotics.industry_sub_vertical: AI-native robotic fulfillment automation with continuous learning from production failures
inloop-robotics.what_they_sell: AI-native robotic fulfillment systems deployed in warehouses that continuously learn and improve from production operations
inloop-robotics.ai_play: Ship imperfect robotic policies into production, detect failures in real-time, recover automatically when possible, escalate to remote human operators when needed, and convert every failure into training data for continuous improvement

insforge.name: InsForge

insforge.phenotype_primary_label: Vertical AI workflow agent (AI department for X)

inspector.name: Inspector
inspector.description:
AI IDE for front-end development

inspector.what_they_sell: AI IDE that bridges visual design and code production — designers/developers select UI elements on live front-end, edit them visually (Figma-like), and AI writes the code changes directly to the codebase.

instaagent.name: InstaAgent

instaagent.ai_play: AI generates persona-specific ad creatives and copy from one brief, then learns from performance to scale winners—replacing manual creative production and A/B testing labor

instinct.name: Instinct

Building lunar landers

instinct-xyz.name: Instinct

Hyperliquid.

intelligence-factory.name: Intelligence Factory
intelligence-factory.description:
Human Intelligence for Robots

Robotics is the new paradigm. With hardware converging, Intelligence is the biggest bottleneck. Our world was built for humans and we're giving robots the ability to reason and act like us. 

The way we learn any task - by seeing, doing, and feeling - is how we train robots. We're building general intelligence that works on any robot and fits seamlessly within our world.
intelligence-factory.industry_sub_vertical: General-purpose robot reasoning & embodied AI for unstructured environments
intelligence-factory.what_they_sell: General-purpose robot intelligence software/models that enable robots to reason and act in human-built environments across different hardware platforms
intelligence-factory.ai_play: Training foundation models for robotics using human-like learning (vision, action, proprioception) to create hardware-agnostic intelligence that generalizes across tasks and robot form factors

interfaze.name: Interfaze
interfaze.one_liner: AI model built for deterministic developer tasks
interfaze.description:
AI model built for deterministic developer tasks

Interfaze is an AI model built on a new architecture that merges specialized DNN/CNN models with LLMs for developer tasks that require deterministic output and high consistency like OCR, web scraping, classification, Speech-to-text (STT) and more.

Read paper:https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.04101
interfaze.industry_sub_vertical: Deterministic AI model API for developer tasks (OCR, web scraping, classification, STT)
interfaze.what_they_sell: AI model API endpoint for developers needing deterministic output on structured tasks (OCR, web scraping, classification, STT) — sold as API/SDK to engineering teams across industries
interfaze.ai_play: Novel hybrid architecture merging specialized DNN/CNN models with LLMs to achieve high consistency and deterministic output where pure LLMs are unreliable

interfere.name: Interfere
interfere.one_liner: Production visibility for teams that ship fast
interfere.description:
Production visibility for teams that ship fast

Interfere is the experience layer for modern product teams. Detect, triage, and fix bugs automatically – no human required. Interfere finds issues in your app, understands what's happening, and owns resolution from first signal to production.
interfere.industry_sub_vertical: Production bug detection & automated root cause analysis for engineering teams
interfere.what_they_sell: API/SaaS platform that automatically detects production bugs and issues in shipped applications, triages them with AI-driven root cause analysis, and autonomously executes fixes without human intervention.
interfere.ai_play: AI agents autonomously monitor production telemetry, parse error signals and logs, synthesize context about what failed and why, and execute remediation workflows. Replaces manual debugging and triage cycles with agentic automation.

inth.name: Inth
inth.description:
Privacy compliance, enforced in code

Inth makes privacy compliance live where the risk actually is: the codebase and runtime. Companies still rely on dashboards, questionnaires, and policy docs to prove compliance, but consent breaks in code, deletion breaks in code, and vendors, logs, AI systems, and agent-written changes all move user data in code. Inth sits in the repo, detects user-data privacy risk, maps it to files and owners, and generates the evidence regulators and enterprise buyers ask for. Its wedge is c15t, an open-source consent SDK with 2.6M npm downloads and adoption from teams like Zed, Infisical, and Expo. Inth is making every codebase compliant by default.
inth.industry_sub_vertical: Privacy compliance enforcement in code repositories and runtime environments for regulated enterprises
inth.vertical_label: Compliance audit & change tracking for regulated environments
inth.what_they_sell: Privacy compliance enforcement platform: open-source consent SDK (c15t) + commercial SaaS layer for detecting privacy risk in code/runtime, mapping violations to files/owners, and generating compliance evidence for regulators and enterprise buyers
inth.ai_play: Automated detection of user-data privacy violations in code and runtime; maps risk to specific files and code owners; generates compliance evidence (deletion, consent, vendor tracking) that regulators and enterprises require

inventoryquant.name: InventoryQuant

inventoryquant.description:
We automate the inventory process in insurance

We automate inventory and contents processing for insurance and insurance-adjacent industries, including public adjusters, restoration contents, and insurance companies. We also handle various inventory and estimate adjacent processes that cost many billions of dollars a year and thousands of years of man hours.

inversion-semiconductor.name: Inversion Semiconductor
inversion-semiconductor.one_liner: Manufacturing the most powerful chips, 15x faster
inversion-semiconductor.description:
Manufacturing the most powerful chips, 15x faster

Inversion Semiconductor is developing the next-generation chip fabrication machine, to create the most powerful chips 15x faster. Our vision is to reshore advanced chip fabrication capabilities in the West.

We're building a lithography machine. Lithography uses light to pattern circuit features on silicon. We're scaling transistors to their physical limits by shrinking particle accelerators 1000x, to create a high power light source. 

Using our light source we will double transistor density for a given numerical aperture and 3x throughput.
inversion-semiconductor.what_they_sell: Next-generation lithography machine hardware for advanced chip fabrication; compact particle-accelerator-based light source enabling 15x faster chip manufacturing and 2x transistor density improvement
inversion-semiconductor.ai_play: AI accelerates design optimization of the particle accelerator optics, manufacturing precision of ultra-compact light source components, and real-time process control during lithography operations. AI may optimize beam path simulation, defect detection in produced chips, and adaptive manufacturing parameters.

inviscid-ai.name: Inviscid AI
inviscid-ai.one_liner: Real-time Physics Simulations for Industrial Facilities & Data Centers
inviscid-ai.description:
Real-time Physics Simulations for Industrial Facilities & Data Centers

Inviscid AI builds physics-informed AI solutions that transform how buildings and data centers operate. By combining real-time IoT sensor data with computational fluid dynamics (CFD) modeling, we create digital twins that simulate building performance in real time and autonomously optimize operations.

Our platform optimizes airflow patterns and ventilation strategies to eliminate dead zones, improve air distribution, and reduce the load on mechanical systems. On the energy side, we minimize HVAC power consumption, reduce cooling costs, and lower overall operational expenses while maintaining optimal thermal comfort and indoor air quality. Beyond immediate operational efficiency, we optimize equipment scheduling and maintenance cycles by predicting system behavior under different conditions, allowing facilities managers to proactively address issues before they become problems.

Our physics first approach ensures that we're not just optimizing against historical patterns, but optimizing based on a deep understanding of how air, heat, and energy actually move through your building, enabling us to find solutions that traditional rule-based or purely data-driven systems would miss.
inviscid-ai.industry_sub_vertical: Real-time HVAC optimization & predictive maintenance for industrial facilities & data centers
inviscid-ai.phenotype_primary_label: Vertical AI workflow agent (AI department for X)
inviscid-ai.what_they_sell: Physics-informed AI platform that creates real-time digital twins of buildings and data centers, combining IoT sensor data with computational fluid dynamics to autonomously optimize HVAC operations, airflow distribution, and equipment maintenance scheduling
inviscid-ai.ai_play: Physics-first approach using CFD modeling + real-time sensor fusion to simulate building thermodynamics and airflow, enabling optimization strategies that pure data-driven or rule-based systems cannot discover

invo.name: Invo
invo.what_they_sell: Infrastructure layer enabling deployment, orchestration, and optimization of computer-use agents — agents that interact with software systems, APIs, and UIs autonomously. Provides runtime harness, execution sandboxing, tool routing, and cost/reliability optimization for agentic workflows.
invo.ai_play: Abstracts away the complexity of building reliable, scalable agent systems that can control computers and software. Reduces friction for developers building agent applications by providing battle-tested runtime infrastructure, similar to how Kubernetes abstracted container orchestration.

iron-grid.what_they_sell: AI-native insurance product for hardware equipment (likely IoT, industrial, or consumer electronics). iron-grid.ai_play: AI changes the insurance SKU itself: real-time risk scoring based on device telemetry/diagnostics, dynamic pricing, predictive claims modeling, and automated underwriting. Enables hardware manufacturers or distributors to offer embedded insurance at scale without traditional underwriting friction.

ironledger-ai.description:
AI-enabled Corporate Cards and Invoice Processing for Real Estate

IronLedger automates property accounting for property managers, developers and contractors, starting with accounts payable. We eliminate more than $70K of accounting costs annually for over 50K multifamily units.

https://www.ironledger.ai/

ironledger-ai.what_they_sell: SaaS platform automating accounts payable and property accounting workflows for real estate operators (property managers, developers, contractors). Eliminates ~$70K annual accounting labor per property portfolio.

item.name: item
item.one_liner: The AI-Native CRM that works for you
item.description:
The AI-Native CRM that works for you

item connects to all your customer tools, gathers and enriches context automatically, and becomes your company’s source of truth — one place where your team and your AI agents share the full picture to act autonomously.

At the center is the Assistant — your sidekick for daily work. It can send follow-ups, research leads, or add deals with a simple prompt. No complex UI, drop-downs or fields, simply ask.

For repeatable work, you build Agents that you can train like new hires, simply by writing documents that describe your processes. item Agents run business processes across sales, support, and account management autonomously.

item.what_they_sell: AI-native CRM platform with dual interface: (1) Assistant copilot for ad-hoc sales tasks (follow-ups, research, deal entry), (2) trainable Agents that autonomously execute repeatable sales workflows (prospecting, qualification, account management) by learning from process documentation.
item.ai_play: Replaces manual CRM data entry and repetitive sales workflows with autonomous agents trained on company process docs. Agents integrate with existing customer tools (email, calendar, etc.) to gather context and execute tasks without human intervention. Core differentiation: natural-language process definition (write docs, agents learn) vs. traditional workflow builders.

jarmin.name: Jarmin
jarmin.description:
AI Employees for human-level roles

Jarmin.ai builds AI employees for human-level roles. It learns its responsibilities, understands your data, embeds into your systems, and becomes part of your team's day-to-day workflow. Completely hand over full initiatives or individual tasks.

Hire AI ML Engineers, Account Executives, Paralegals, Financial analysts, Compliance analysts, and more.

Jarmin’s founding team is from Meta SuperIntelligence Labs (Staff Engineers), Apple (Machine Learning Engineer), AWS (scaling infra), Lockheed-Martin (Research), and JPMorganChase (SWE) with experience building AI/ML and automating complex work of Researchers, Data Scientists, ML Engineers with AI.
jarmin.industry_sub_vertical: Agentic AI workforce automation for enterprise knowledge work (ML engineers, account executives, paralegals, financial analysts, compliance analysts)
jarmin.what_they_sell: SaaS platform deploying specialized AI agents that autonomously execute human-level job functions (ML Engineers, Account Executives, Paralegals, Financial Analysts, Compliance Analysts) end-to-end. Agents learn domain workflows, integrate with enterprise systems, and execute tasks with minimal human oversight.
jarmin.ai_play: AI agents replace or augment human workers in knowledge-intensive roles by learning responsibilities, understanding proprietary data, embedding into existing workflows, and executing complex tasks autonomously. Differentiation is in role-specific agent training, system integration depth, and ability to handle multi-step initiatives.

jeevy-fabrication.name: Jeevy Fabrication
jeevy-fabrication.one_liner: AI Driven EPC - Weld Fabrication Contractor
jeevy-fabrication.description:
AI Driven EPC - Weld Fabrication Contractor

Jeevy Fabrication is an AI-powered contractor that connects complex weld jobs to the best-fit shops—fast. We deliver top-tier QA and total transparency, all at better traditional outsourced pricing.

Our software reduces bid and scheduling time for our in-network shops by over 80%. It converts manufacturing drawings into an accurate bill of materials and a resource-loaded, high-fidelity schedule—eliminating costly errors and rework. Using this our in-network fabricators can bid on more jobs and deliver more reliable results than their competitors. 

We also offer our clients a streamlined purchasing and project tracking experience. Clients submit purchase requests, track schedules, access key documents, and receive real-time photo updates—all in one place. We provide traceability for easy material review and maintenance of domestic content standards as required. Faster decisions, fewer delays, complete visibility.
jeevy-fabrication.industry_sub_vertical: Manufacturing EPC job matching and supply chain orchestration for weld fabrication
jeevy-fabrication.what_they_sell: End-to-end weld fabrication contracting service (EPC) with AI-driven job matching, scheduling, QA, and supply chain transparency. Acts as prime contractor connecting clients to vetted in-network fabrication shops, with AI handling bid optimization, material planning, scheduling, and compliance tracking.
jeevy-fabrication.ai_play: AI converts manufacturing drawings → bill of materials + resource-loaded schedules; automates bid/scheduling (80% time reduction for shops); optimizes job-to-shop matching; provides real-time traceability and domestic content compliance. AI enables Jeevy to operate as a capital-light, high-margin prime contractor by automating procurement, supplier coordination, and compliance—replacing manual EPC labor.

jinba.name: Jinba
jinba.description:

Enterprise-grade permissions, audit logging, and on-prem deployment built in. We serve 40,000 enterprise users at major financial institutions.

Build something your colleagues want.
jinba.industry_sub_vertical: Chat-driven no-code workflow automation for cross-functional enterprise teams
jinba.what_they_sell: Horizontal no-code workflow automation platform sold as enterprise SaaS with chat-driven authoring interface, permissions management, audit logging, and on-prem deployment options

jo.name: jo

A new personal AI that actually knows you.

Less "chatbot" and more "a second brain that does things."

jo.what_they_sell: Consumer-facing personal AI application accessible via Mac client and private cloud infrastructure, integrated with messaging platforms (Telegram, WhatsApp)
jo.ai_play: LLM-powered personal AI that continuously learns user context and behavior to function as an autonomous second brain, with local + private cloud hybrid architecture for privacy

joindex.name: Dex
joindex.description:
The AI Coworker in Chrome

ThirdLayer is an applied research and product lab building the next interface for human–AI collaboration.

Our first product is Dex, an AI copilot for the browser. Think Cursor for knowledge work, optimized for speed and embedded directly where you work.

Most web agents are built for set-and-forget tasks. But real work is fluid and messy—spread across tabs, tools, and evolving decisions. Dex transforms your browser into an intelligent, multimodal workspace that understands your intent through voice, text, and action. It enhances familiar interfaces, automates tedious steps, and removes the friction of handoffs.

Beneath the surface, Dex is more than a browser agent — it’s a foundation for:

● Long-term, cross-modal memory grounded in real workflows
● A new interaction layer to replace static UI with a collaborative canvas 
● Personalization: understanding how individuals approach tasks and navigate software

We're building the infrastructure for adaptive, intent-aware systems that work the way you do.
joindex.industry_sub_vertical: Browser-native AI copilot for cross-functional knowledge work automation
joindex.what_they_sell: Dex: a browser-embedded AI copilot that automates knowledge work tasks across web applications via voice, text, and action. Seat-based SaaS subscription targeting individual knowledge workers and teams.
joindex.ai_play: AI replaces manual, repetitive steps in browser-based workflows by understanding user intent across multiple tabs and tools in real-time. Multimodal input (voice, text, action) + cross-modal memory enables fluid, context-aware task automation without rigid workflows.

juno-chat.name: Juno
juno-chat.one_liner: AI Health Assistant for Chronic Illness
juno-chat.description:
AI Health Assistant for Chronic Illness

Launched in October, Juno now supports 90,000+ patients globally and has grown to $70K MRR.

juno-chat.what_they_sell: Direct-to-consumer subscription AI health assistant mobile/web app for chronic illness patients
juno-chat.ai_play: AI-native conversational interface replaces traditional symptom trackers and static health content with personalized, interactive chronic illness management

juxta.name: Juxta
juxta.one_liner: Building a GPS alternative 100x more powerful with no hardware needed.
juxta.description:
Building a GPS alternative 100x more powerful with no hardware needed.

Juxta is creating the first Universal Positioning System (UPS) — a GPS alternative that can monitor movement anywhere on earth with no new hardware, minimal internet connection, and remote deployment. Using custom machine learning models and a first-of-its-kind synthetic fingerprinting technology, Juxta can make any indoor, outdoor, or underground space location-aware in minutes for a fraction of the cost of any other geospatial technology.

Juxta's UPS can be leveraged across industries — from securely tracking soldiers in combat zones to providing offline positioning for robots to offering asset tracking in warehouses and ports around the globe.
juxta.industry_sub_vertical: Warehouse & asset tracking positioning infrastructure for logistics and defense operations
juxta.what_they_sell: Universal Positioning System (UPS) — a software/ML-based GPS alternative that enables location awareness indoors, outdoors, and underground without new hardware. Deployed via synthetic fingerprinting models trained on domain data. Sold as infrastructure/API to defense, logistics, robotics, and asset-tracking enterprises.
juxta.ai_play: Custom ML models and synthetic fingerprinting technology replace traditional GPS hardware and surveying. AI learns spatial signatures from minimal data, enabling rapid deployment (minutes vs. months) and sub-GPS accuracy at fraction of cost. Core IP is the learned positioning model, not the hardware.

kaelio.name: Kaelio
kaelio.one_liner: The open-source context layer for data agents
kaelio.description:
The open-source context layer for data agents

Kaelio is the company behind ktx, the open-source context layer that makes data agents reliable. 

Data agents today fail because they lack structured context and determinism. Metrics are defined in five places, governed in none. Teams spend months on semantic layer projects that never finish.

ktx fixes that. Connect your warehouse, BI tools, and docs. ktx builds the context layer automatically. Your team governs it. Any agent can query it. One context layer across your entire data stack.
kaelio.industry_sub_vertical: Data warehouse context layer for AI agents
kaelio.what_they_sell: Open-source context layer (ktx) that automatically builds and governs a unified semantic/context layer across data warehouses, BI tools, and documentation. Enables data agents to query structured, deterministic context instead of raw unstructured data.
kaelio.ai_play: Solves the 'context explosion' problem for data agents — agents need rich warehouse context (metrics, dimensions, governance rules) but can't ingest raw SQL schemas or unstructured docs. ktx compresses and structures warehouse metadata + docs into token-efficient, semantically dense context that agents can reliably query. Replaces manual semantic layer projects with automated context generation.

kaigo-health.name: Kaigo Health
kaigo-health.description:
AI outpatient care workforce

Kaigo Health provides an AI-powered outpatient care management platform that automates and scales remote care management for Medicare patients including post-discharge followups, ongoing check-ins, and monitoring. Using phone calls as an age-friendly interface, we aggregate patient responses, voice biomarkers, and remote patient monitoring data for powerful preventative and proactive healthcare.
kaigo-health.industry_sub_vertical: Medicare Advantage remote care management & readmission prevention
kaigo-health.what_they_sell: AI-powered outpatient care management platform that automates remote care workflows for Medicare patients: post-discharge follow-ups, ongoing check-ins, health monitoring, and preventative interventions via voice-first interface. Aggregates patient responses, voice biomarkers, and RPM data into actionable clinical insights.
kaigo-health.ai_play: Autonomous voice agents replace manual care coordinators and nurses for routine patient outreach, monitoring, and triage. AI extracts clinical signals from voice (biomarkers, sentiment, health status) and integrates with EHR/RPM systems to enable proactive, scalable care at Medicare margins. Reduces labor cost per patient interaction while improving compliance and outcomes tracking.

kairos.name: Kairos
kairos.description:
Specialized AI for Critical Industries

Kairos closes the last-mile reliability gap in AI deployments. 

We bring frontier techniques to companies in critical industries, deploying specialized agents that encode operator expertise and reliably automate their most manual workflows.

kairos.what_they_sell: Specialized AI agents that automate manual, high-stakes workflows in critical industries (energy, utilities, manufacturing, defense). Agents encode operator expertise and integrate with existing operational systems to execute complex, reliability-critical tasks autonomously.
kairos.ai_play: Frontier AI techniques (RL, specialized models) applied to encode domain operator expertise into reliable agents. Focus on closing the 'last-mile reliability gap' — ensuring agents handle edge cases, exceptions, and safety-critical decisions that prevent deployment in regulated/critical environments. Likely includes observability, evals, and safety validation to prove reliability to risk-averse operators.

kaizen.ai_play: AI agents act as digital workers, navigating web UIs and legacy portals without code changes to backend systems. Replaces RPA and manual BPO labor by learning workflows from observation and executing them autonomously at scale.

kalinda.name: Kalinda
kalinda.one_liner: Deep research for class action law firms
kalinda.description:
Deep research for class action law firms

Kalinda helps class action law firms qualify potential cases in minutes with AI.

The nature of class action/mass torts involves thousands of cases for a single lawsuit. For every plaintiff (injured person), law firms involved in these cases compile everything from the products they used to the injuries they have. This data is extensive, granular, and buried deep in thousands of pages of medical, financial, and employment records and others.

Kalinda extracts, summarizes, and aggregates data from these records for attorneys with AI.

When scaled across an entire litigation, Kalinda works tirelessly and in parallel—turning a process that once took months into just a few hours. 

Kalinda provides firms with the equivalent manpower of hundreds of paralegals and legal nurses, allowing them to quickly determine which claimants are eligible and helping them file faster and in greater volume.

To date, we’ve processed 600k pages of records and are live with 2 of the largest plaintiff law firms in the U.S!
kalinda.industry_sub_vertical: Class action and mass tort litigation case qualification and discovery
kalinda.what_they_sell: AI-powered document processing and case qualification platform for class action law firms. Extracts, summarizes, and aggregates plaintiff data from medical, financial, and employment records to determine claimant eligibility and streamline case filing at scale.
kalinda.ai_play: Replaces manual paralegal and legal nurse work by automating extraction and aggregation of unstructured data across thousands of plaintiff records. Compresses months of document review into hours, enabling firms to qualify cases and file faster and in greater volume.

kalpa-labs.name: Kalpa Labs
kalpa-labs.description:
Scaling Generalist Speech models

We're building the next frontier of speech models. Generalist speech models that unlock in-context learning & strong instruction following for speech models alongside unifying existing speech capabilities like speech to text, text to speech, voice cloning, etc.
kalpa-labs.industry_sub_vertical: Generalist speech foundation models for unified speech task inference
kalpa-labs.what_they_sell: Generalist speech foundation models with in-context learning and instruction-following capabilities; unified inference layer for speech-to-text, text-to-speech, voice cloning, and other speech tasks via a single model backbone.
kalpa-labs.ai_play: Building reusable speech foundation models that replace task-specific speech models and enable downstream applications (voice agents, accessibility, transcription, synthesis) to leverage a single, more capable inference substrate. In-context learning allows customers to adapt the model to domain-specific speech patterns without retraining.

kanava-ai.name: Kanava AI
kanava-ai.one_liner: Your First AI Sales Hire for Wholesale Distributors
kanava-ai.description:
Your First AI Sales Hire for Wholesale Distributors

Distributors face a shrinking workforce and rising call volume.

Kanava AI builds voice-based agents that act like junior sales reps — starting with routine inbound calls, stock and price checks, field note logging, and CRM updates using live ERP data.

As the system learns from top reps and real workflows, it levels up: managing full sales calls, surfacing upsells, coaching teams, and reactivating dormant accounts.

kestral.name: Kestral
kestral.one_liner: We automate your entire product development lifecycle.
kestral.description:
We automate your entire product development lifecycle.

Kestral makes it clear what your customers want most, prioritizes those tasks for highest leverage, and closes the loop with those customers.

We (Brian and Bernard) have been close friends since university, and most recently worked together at Asana, leading AI and Authorization efforts. There we realized AI can completely disrupt the $50B Work Management Market, but it required a fresh start.

What work we even choose to manage in the first place is critical, and the most important insights from customers are silo-ed in sales/CS while R&D gives their best shot at roadmaps meant to deliver impact. Significant requests sit in a backlog, duplicate asks flood the system, months wasted on "strategic investments". We want to bridge this gap.

This message is resonating with heads of sales, heads of product, CEOs, as well as individuals, all trying to make sure the most important things get done, with less wasted effort and more revenue/retention.

Kestral works by automatically take in customer data like sales call transcripts & feature request messages and a team of agents:
1. analyze them for actionable takeaways, deal blockers, and nice to haves
2. consolidate them and manage all the asks with citations
3. prioritize them by impact and frequency to cut through the noise so you can see the biggest opportunities clearly
4. connect them to your existing strategic roadmap so when the work gets done, we can automatically follow back up with your customers and win them over

This is just step one of our mission to revolutionize how work gets done -- starting with what we choose to work on, and hope you follow us along for the ride!

kestral.ai_play: AI agents replace manual, time-intensive work of product managers and heads of product who currently manually parse sales/CS data, consolidate duplicate requests, and prioritize roadmaps. Agents handle ingestion (transcripts, messages), analysis (NLP extraction of intent/impact), consolidation (deduplication with citations), and closed-loop customer engagement (auto-follow-up). Reduces roadmap planning cycle time and eliminates information silos between sales/CS and R&D.

The agent picks up on what each shopper actually wants from how they ask, what they hesitate on, what they compare, and what objection makes them bounce. We're building for human shoppers today and the AI agents that shop and discovery for them. Either way, the entire website needs to get a lot smarter and personalized. 

Two surfaces. One brand layer. Built for scaling DTC ecommerce brands.

kita.name: Kita
kita.one_liner: Automate credit review for lenders in emerging markets
kita.description:
Automate credit review for lenders in emerging markets

In emerging markets, open finance is still nascent. Most of the population is traditionally unbanked, banking APIs don’t exist, and a borrower’s financial history lives in documents: e-wallet records, bank statements, utility bills, and more. Because this data is unstructured, credit and risk teams are forced into manual review. This slows decisioning, increases costs, and caps lending volume. 

Kita is the AI platform for global lending operations. We help lenders in emerging markets automate application completion, document verification, and underwriting from messy financial documents — using AI to extract fraud-checked data and localized risk signals that power faster, better credit decisions.

Under the hood, Kita is a learning engine. We link document-level signals to repayment outcomes, allowing our models to continuously improve fraud detection and risk assessment over time. This creates a compounding advantage for lenders as their distinct underwriting decisions feed back into the system.

We’re Carmel and Rhea. We met before Stanford and have been building together ever since. Carmel is from Manila, is a repeat founder, and spent three years in product at Apple. Rhea has a research background in computer vision and received the highest honor in Stanford Computer Science. Together, we combine deep local context with strong technical execution to build the infrastructure that expands access to credit in emerging markets.

klaimee.description:
Liability insurance for AI Agents. You deploy agents, we cover you.

Klaimee is the first insurance for your AI agents. It covers what traditional E&O and cyber explicitly carve out, so you can deploy agentic AI at scale with real peace of mind.
Built for companies deploying agentic AI, self-serve from day one.

The problem: AI agents are taking actions autonomously buying, emailing, modifying sensitive data. AB 316 already holds deployers liable. EU AI Act enforces in August. Cyber and E&O insurance are excluding AI claims. Companies shipping agents have zero coverage and no third-party proof their agent is safe. Enterprise legal asks "who pays if your agent breaks something?" and there's no good answer.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        
We built the answer. Critical-category risk evaluation, certification, financial guarantee, liability insurance and the documentation enterprise procurement needs to sign off.

Team: Ines (ex-General Manager at SafetyWing, grew insurance product from $5M to $60M revenue, 5 years launching insurance products from scratch and structuring a TokioMarine MGA into its own carrier) + Julien (AI software engineer + corporate strategy, enterprise compliance).

We understand how insurance works, what enterprises require, and why startups can't wait 6 months for either.

libretto.name: Libretto
libretto.one_liner: Turn website workflows into reliable APIs
libretto.description:
Turn website workflows into reliable APIs

Libretto is an open-source CLI that lets agents turn website workflows into fast, reusable scripts you can deploy

The problem: Most browser automation tools work by sending an AI agent to operate a website in real time, like a robot typing and clicking on your behalf. This is slow, expensive, and unpredictable. They rely on fragile DOM parsing that breaks on legacy and complex sites, and you can never fully trust what the agent will do on unintuitive or inconsistent workflows.

Our approach: Libretto helps your coding agents generate workflows as actual, readable code during development, not at runtime. Under the hood it combines Playwright with direct in-session network/API calls for reliability and bot detection evasion. It also supports step-through debugging and a read-only mode to prevent accidental data changes while your agent builds and debugs workflows.

This makes Libretto cheaper, faster, and easier to maintain, especially for more complex websites and high stakes workflows.
libretto.industry_sub_vertical: Agent web workflow automation & API generation for healthcare operations
libretto.what_they_sell: Open-source CLI + commercial SaaS that converts website workflows into reliable, maintainable code (APIs/scripts) that agents can execute deterministically. Combines Playwright with direct API calls to replace fragile DOM-based browser automation.
libretto.ai_play: Enables AI agents to reliably interact with legacy/complex websites by generating executable workflow code during development rather than relying on runtime DOM parsing. Reduces hallucination risk, cost, and latency by converting web interactions into structured API calls and debuggable scripts.

AI Referral Automation for Primary Care Clinics

Locata is an AI referral management platform for Primary Care. This frees up staff to focus on patient care.

Primary care back-offices are severely understaffed and overburdened by administrative work associated with referrals. Additionally, patients suffer navigating the complex referral process, which can have disastrous health effects if they don’t get the care they need. These factors point to a glaring gap in the system—where out of over 100 million specialist referrals issued annually in the US, only half are actually completed. Locata is tackling this problem head-on, saving administrative staff hours each week and ensuring that the referral process goes as smoothly as possible for patients and their providers.

Alejandro and Josh met at Stanford where they graduated with BS degrees in Computer Science. Alejandro was a senior software engineer at Meta’s Reality Labs where he led development of several AI features for wearable products and prior to that conducted AI research at Stanford Medicine. Josh graduated with a masters in Computer Science, specializing in AI, before working as a software engineer at Google where he developed AI products that served over 1 billion users.

Within two weeks of building our product, we signed a major regional health center and have saved them over 100 hours of work in our first month live.

This inevitably means payments: accessing paywalled data, transacting for services or with other specialist agents. But autonomy requires guardrails. Businesses and developers will need a way to ensure their agents only spend how much and on what they’re supposed to.

The machine economy is coming, and Locus (YC F25) is building the connector businesses will need to participate. We connect agents securely to funds, letting you define permissions and limits for every transaction. Each payment is traceable, auditable, and fully reconcilable with your existing financial stack.
locus.industry_sub_vertical: AI agent payment infrastructure & financial guardrails
locus.what_they_sell: Payment infrastructure and financial guardrails for autonomous AI agents — a secure, auditable layer that allows agents to execute transactions (access paywalled data, pay for services, transact with other agents) within defined permission and spending limits. Integrates with existing financial stacks and provides full reconciliation and traceability.
locus.ai_play: As agents move from tools to autonomous actors executing open-ended workflows, they need the ability to transact autonomously but safely. Locus solves the 'agent financial autonomy' problem by providing permission-based payment execution, spend controls, and audit trails — enabling the machine economy while maintaining business guardrails.

logical.name: Logical
logical.one_liner: A proactive desktop copilot. Clippy, but actually good.
logical.description:
A proactive desktop copilot. Clippy, but actually good.

Logical is a desktop AI that acts as a proactive and largely promptless copilot, designed to reduce the friction of using AI for everyday tasks. It transfers context across apps, and allows taking action on many apps with just a few clicks. Logical can assist with drafting emails, writing docs, noting meetings and can even automatically detect action items. Need to prompt? Logical can understand intent in much fewer words than a regular chatbot. Plus, user data is never sent to Logical servers. Logical is the AI resurrection of Clippy, but actually good.
logical.industry_sub_vertical: Enterprise knowledge management & cross-app context automation for knowledge workers
logical.what_they_sell: Desktop AI copilot that operates proactively across applications (email, docs, meetings) with minimal prompting, context transfer between apps, and local-first data privacy (no server transmission of user data).
logical.ai_play: Reduces friction of AI interaction through proactive task detection (action items, email drafts, meeting notes), cross-app context awareness, and intent inference from minimal input. Local-first architecture differentiates on privacy and latency vs. cloud-based copilots.

logosguard.name: LogosGuard
logosguard.one_liner: The risk management software for enterprises adopting AI
logosguard.description:
The risk management software for enterprises adopting AI

Enterprises are racing to adopt AI, but often don't have the right controls in place or know how to verify vendors are compliant. LogosGuard turns AI policies into executable controls, stress-tests your AI products, and continuously monitors changes, giving enterprises the confidence to scale AI responsibly.
logosguard.industry_sub_vertical: Enterprise AI governance and compliance automation
logosguard.what_they_sell: SaaS platform that translates AI governance policies into executable controls, performs stress-testing and red-teaming of AI products, and provides continuous monitoring of AI system changes and compliance drift.
logosguard.ai_play: AI-powered policy-to-control translation and automated compliance verification. Uses AI to parse enterprise AI policies, generate test scenarios, monitor model behavior changes, and flag compliance violations in real-time — replacing manual governance audits with continuous, scalable oversight.

lopus.name: Lopus
lopus.description:
Growth Operations Data Platform

Pointing an AI at all your data is a recipe for disaster - it will confidently lie, hallucinate, and drive your business into the ground.

What if you could trust your AI the way you trust a calculator?

That's Lopus.

We build a self-healing semantic layer that captures your business logic.
Including every metric, every definition, every edge case.
Defined once, and trusted everywhere.

No SQL. No dashboards. No waiting on the data team.
lopus.industry_sub_vertical: Enterprise data governance & AI-safe semantic layer for growth operations
lopus.what_they_sell: A self-healing semantic layer that captures business logic, metrics, definitions, and edge cases once and makes them trustworthy for AI consumption across the organization. Enables non-technical users to query data via AI without SQL or dashboards.
lopus.ai_play: Solves the 'AI hallucination over messy data' problem by building a canonical, governed knowledge representation layer. AI agents can query this trusted ontology instead of raw data, eliminating confident false answers. Acts as context infrastructure that compresses and structures enterprise data into semantically dense, AI-safe formats.

lotas.name: Lotas
lotas.description:
AI for Data Science and 3D

For our first product, we built Rao: an AI coding assistant into RStudio — an IDE used by up to 5 million data scientists and statisticians who use the R programming language to analyze data. Rao could read, write, and edit code while understanding the user's context (codebase and environmental variables).
lotas.industry_sub_vertical: Data science & statistical analysis tooling for research professionals
lotas.what_they_sell: Rao: an AI coding assistant embedded in RStudio IDE that reads, writes, and edits R code with contextual awareness of the user's codebase and environment variables. Seat-based SaaS or usage-based API for data scientists and statisticians.
lotas.ai_play: AI copilot that understands the developer's local context (codebase, environment, prior code patterns) to provide intelligent code suggestions, generation, and editing — reducing manual coding friction for data science workflows. Context-aware code completion replaces generic LLM suggestions with domain-specific, project-aware assistance.

lua-global-inc.name: Lua Global Inc
lua-global-inc.description:
The mid-market agent platform

Lua is the mid-market agent platform.

We deliver enterprise reliability with the speed, flexibility, and economics that mid-market companies demand - helping them deploy AI agents that drive sales, support, and operations across everyday channels and tools.

We scale through developer agencies and channel partners, enabling rapid distribution without a large enterprise sales motion or scaled forward deployed teams. We think of Lua as an agentOS that abstracts all of the complexity required to launch enterprise grade agents and combine it with the tools needed for these agents to succeed in the real world.

Lua was founded by Lorcan O Cathain (CEO) and Stefan Kruger (CTO)- experienced founders who have spent 15 - 20 years each scaling technology companies across emerging markets.

We sell to mid-market enterprises and developer agencies in the US and internationally. Developers are increasingly our primary ICP but we run SMB & enterprise sales motions to accelerate our learnings and further develop our product:
- SMB ($25- 1k per month): fully automated self-serve agents that handle sales and support for eCommerce companies, hotels, restaurants and general service businesses. If you’ve been on our website you’ve likely seen this.
- Enterprise: We directly sell to mid-market (~ $50M- $1BN) businesses across the US and internationally to eat our own dog food and strengthen our platform.
lua-global-inc.industry_sub_vertical: Mid-market enterprise AI agent orchestration platform for sales, support, and operations
lua-global-inc.what_they_sell: AgentOS platform: abstraction layer for deploying, managing, and orchestrating AI agents across sales, support, and operations workflows. Targets mid-market enterprises and developer agencies with self-serve SaaS (SMB tier) and direct enterprise sales (mid-market tier). Agents integrate with everyday business tools and channels.
lua-global-inc.ai_play: Lua abstracts the complexity of agent deployment, tool integration, and multi-channel orchestration. Core value is reducing time-to-production for mid-market teams and enabling developer agencies to rapidly deploy agents without building custom infrastructure. Agents handle sales, support, and ops autonomously across integrated channels.

lucent.name: Lucent
lucent.one_liner: AI that automatically improves products from user behavior
lucent.description:
AI that automatically improves products from user behavior

Lucent is an AI product manager that automatically improves products based on how users behave. We use AI to watch and understand user sessions and detect bugs and UX issues.
lucent.industry_sub_vertical: Product analytics & automated bug detection for SaaS teams
lucent.what_they_sell: AI product manager tool that watches user sessions and automatically detects bugs and UX issues — sold as horizontal productivity SaaS to product teams across industries
lucent.ai_play: AI replaces manual session review and bug detection by automatically analyzing user behavior patterns to surface product issues

lucid.name: Lucid
lucid.description:
interactive video models

We are building universe simulations powered by interactive video models.

We train video models that simulate hyper-realistic environments with immersive control, replacing hard-coded game or physics engines with dynamic neural networks.

We built the fastest action-conditioned diffusion video model (running at 20+fps on a 4090 gaming gpu) to simulate minecraft. It is 5x faster than other minecraft World Models and was trained with 100x less resources. Our unique insight was relying on aggressive compression in our tokenizer (128x versus the traditional 8x), and because attention scales quadratically with # of tokens our model can run blindingly faster.

Now we’re training a hyper realistic world model!
lucid.industry_sub_vertical: Interactive video simulation & neural world models for consumer entertainment
lucid.what_they_sell: Interactive video models that simulate hyper-realistic environments in real-time, replacing traditional game engines and physics simulators with neural networks. Deployed as inference infrastructure for interactive experiences (games, simulations, virtual worlds).
lucid.ai_play: Action-conditioned diffusion video models trained on massive video datasets, optimized for real-time inference (20+ fps on consumer GPUs). AI replaces hard-coded physics/rendering engines with learned neural simulations. Aggressive tokenizer compression (128x) enables quadratic attention scaling improvements, making frontier video models practical for interactive use.

lucidic-ai.name: Lucidic AI
lucidic-ai.description:
Reimagining how Machines Learn

Lucidic emulates model training without changing model weights. The last decade made models intelligent, but intelligence is not the same as experience. Humans do not get better by memorizing thousands of examples; we build learning systems around ourselves: skills, memories, critique, practice, tools, and guidance. And every person learns differently because every task is different. Lucidic brings that idea to AI agents by training a custom learning system for each agent, so it learns what to remember, what skills to build, when to ask for help, and how to improve from experience. The model provides the intelligence, Lucidic gives it a way to learn.
lucidic-ai.industry_sub_vertical: Agent learning system & autonomous improvement infrastructure
lucidic-ai.what_they_sell: A learning system layer that sits between agents and foundation models, enabling agents to build custom memory, skills, critique mechanisms, and practice loops without retraining model weights. Delivered as API/SaaS for developers building agentic applications.
lucidic-ai.ai_play: Transforms static model inference into adaptive agent behavior by adding a learnable harness around the model. Instead of fine-tuning weights, Lucidic trains a lightweight learning system (memory selection, skill routing, help-seeking heuristics, improvement feedback loops) that makes agents improve from experience, task-specific, without model updates. Solves the 'experience gap' — models have intelligence but agents lack the learning infrastructure humans use to compound expertise.

lucis.name: Lucis

lucis.what_they_sell: Consumer SaaS subscription: AI-powered blood test interpretation and personalized health insights platform. Users order blood tests, receive AI-analyzed results with actionable recommendations tied to longevity and preventive health goals.
lucis.ai_play: AI transforms raw blood biomarker data into personalized, medically-grounded health narratives and recommendations. Uses medical knowledge retrieval and pattern matching across user's longitudinal health data to surface actionable insights that traditional lab reports don't provide. AI acts as a personal health advisor, not just a test interpreter.

Lumari is the world's first AI-powered procurement automation platform purpose-built for direct materials and supply chain execution. 

Backed by Y Combinator, Lumari is a well-funded startup that deploys 100s of always-on AI agents that run sourcing workflows, manage RFQs, expedite purchase orders, and coordinate supplier communication end-to-end -- compressing cycle times and giving teams full visibility into active orders, RFQs, and supplier performance.

Founded by engineers from Google, Tesla, Amazon, and Stripe who have built and scaled supply chain systems serving millions of users. 

Built to operate directly on top of existing tools and ERP systems, Lumari helps procurement teams move faster, eliminate operational bottlenecks, and build more resilient supply chains. No rip-and-replace, no supplier onboarding. Lumari handles the manual chase: quote follow-ups, PO confirmations, delivery status updates, and risk escalation.

Lumari helps companies from Fortune 500s to fast-growing startups automate work from sourcing to delivery, streamline supplier communication and order management, and bring full visibility to their procurement operations.

To learn more check out https://lumari.io/
lumari.industry_sub_vertical: Procurement and supply chain execution automation for direct materials sourcing, RFQ management, and purchase order coordination
lumari.what_they_sell: End-user-facing SaaS platform deploying autonomous AI agents that automate procurement workflows (RFQ management, PO execution, supplier communication, order tracking, risk escalation) for enterprise procurement teams. Agents integrate with existing ERPs and tools without rip-and-replace.
lumari.ai_play: AI agents replace manual procurement chase work (quote follow-ups, confirmations, status updates, escalations) by orchestrating multi-step workflows across suppliers, ERPs, and internal systems. Agents learn supplier communication patterns and procurement rules, executing end-to-end sourcing-to-delivery cycles autonomously.

luminal.name: Luminal
luminal.one_liner: Making AI run fast on any hardware.

Making AI run fast on any hardware.

Luminal builds an ML framework and compiler that generates GPU code.
Our stack 10x's model speed while simplifying deployment and cutting idle GPU costs

Discord: https://discord.gg/APjuwHAbGy

luminal.what_they_sell: ML framework and compiler that generates optimized GPU code for inference workloads. Enables 10x speedup in model execution while reducing idle GPU costs and simplifying deployment across heterogeneous hardware.
luminal.ai_play: Luminal's compiler stack optimizes AI model inference by generating hardware-specific GPU code, eliminating inefficiencies in standard frameworks. This allows enterprises and developers to run frontier models faster and cheaper on existing hardware without cloud lock-in or expensive GPU upgrades.

lumius.name: Lumius
lumius.one_liner: Fast, smart, accessible 3D ultrasound for everyone
lumius.description:
Fast, smart, accessible 3D ultrasound for everyone

Ultrasound today is still mostly 2D. Clinicians have to imagine the 3D anatomy in their head while also moving the probe at the same time. This makes procedures like vascular access hard to learn and perform consistently, especially for beginners. ~50% fail on their first attempt. Hospitals also spend millions each year on 2D ultrasound training. Meanwhile, existing 3D ultrasound devices can cost >10× as much.

Lumius is building fast, smart, and accessible 3D ultrasound systems to eliminate this 2D guesswork. Our technology shows a clear, real-time 3D view of what’s inside the body. It works over a large volume, not just a thin slice. The device is also affordable, compact, and portable.

We are starting with vascular access, especially central line. Future use cases include blood clot detection, tumor diagnosis, and biopsy guidance. Our long-term vision is a universal 3D ultrasound platform that brings easy-to-use, real-time imaging to a wide range of clinical and eventually consumer applications.
lumius.industry_sub_vertical: 3D ultrasound imaging devices for vascular access and procedural guidance
lumius.phenotype_primary_label: Vertical AI workflow agent (AI department for X)
lumius.what_they_sell: Physical 3D ultrasound hardware devices with AI-powered imaging software for hospitals and clinicians
lumius.ai_play: AI enables fast 3D reconstruction and real-time volumetric visualization from ultrasound sensor data, making the device affordable and accessible compared to traditional 3D ultrasound systems

lunabill.name: LunaBill
lunabill.one_liner: AI Voice callers for healthcare billing teams
lunabill.description:
AI Voice callers for healthcare billing teams

LunaBill is building AI Voice callers for healthcare billing teams. Insurance claim follow-up calls account for the 80% of the daily workload of a healthcare billing team, with each call averaging 30 minutes.

Since our launch in July we are now at $764K in contracted ARR, of which $428K is live revenue and the rest will go live by January 2026. Our customers see a 10x increase in claims followed up per biller in the first week and we have converted 100% of pilots to paying customers. We have automated 50,000+ calls and signed partnerships with top healthcare leaders like UC health systems, Mayo, Experian Health and more.

The founders have known each other for over a year. Suhail is a 2x founder, with 3+ years of experience building in healthcare including operating a medical billing company with 200+ healthcare clients. David founded Skiesoft, Taiwan’s biggest healthcare AI scribe company, used by 120k+ healthcare professionals. He also worked as a data scientist at UCSF, building models to audit medical-coding accuracy. Yash was a researcher at various hospital systems including Mayo Clinic.
lunabill.industry_sub_vertical: Healthcare revenue cycle / insurance claim follow-up automation
lunabill.what_they_sell: AI voice agents that autonomously conduct insurance claim follow-up calls on behalf of healthcare billing teams, integrated into existing revenue cycle workflows. Customers (healthcare providers, billing operations) deploy agents to replace manual call labor.
lunabill.ai_play: AI voice agents autonomously execute claim follow-up calls (30-min manual tasks) at 10x throughput per biller. Agents handle insurance verification, claim status inquiry, and escalation routing without human intervention. Core differentiation: domain expertise (founders' healthcare billing ops background) + voice quality + integration with billing systems.

Lunavo is the AI assistant for carriers.

Lunavo runs end-to-end backoffice operations, handling repetitive tasks, resolving issues autonomously, and escalating only what matters.

Lunavo helps carriers scale operations without scaling headcount.

lunavo.what_they_sell: End-user-facing SaaS product deploying autonomous AI agents to automate carrier backoffice operations (dispatch, billing, compliance, issue resolution, data processing).
