lunavo.ai_play: AI agents replace manual backoffice labor by understanding carrier workflows, monitoring incoming data/requests, autonomously resolving issues, and escalating only exceptions. Enables carriers to scale operations without proportional headcount growth.

AI answers questions about past meetings and synthesizes cross-meeting insights.

macadamia.name: Macadamia

magnetic.name: Magnetic
magnetic.one_liner: AI Tax Preparer for CPA firms
magnetic.description:
AI Tax Preparer for CPA firms

Magnetic scans client documents - from handwritten charity notes to excel spreadsheet Schedule Cs to multi-state K-1s - and enters them into tax software automatically, saving hours of tedious data entry. 

The accounting profession is facing a massive talent shortage, as graduates choose different professions and the old guard begins to retire. As a result, CPA and tax preparation firms are awash in clientele, but unable to keep up. At many firms, phones go unanswered, clients are "fired", and websites are taken down, as the existing workforce tries to handle the grueling 80 hour+ weeks necessary to push through tax season to the April 15th deadline.

We built this because a former colleague who owns her own tax firm asked us to automate her workload, and we quickly realized the massive opportunity. Thomas brings deep domain expertise as the former Head of Product at Keeper (YC W19), where he built tax engine automation systems and an OCR form scanning system that outperformed everything else on the market. At Keeper, he leveraged early access to OpenAI's LLMs (well before ChatGPT) to build systems that automated the entire tax filing process, allowing a tiny team of CPAs to process thousands of returns with near zero busy work. Patrick was the first engineer at FunCraft, shipping multiple mobile games with 1M+ downloads and building scalable shared codebases. We've worked together since 2017, including co-leading multiple teams at Zynga as PM & Tech Lead respectively.

The opportunity is massive - there are 80M US personal tax returns filed via professionals annually, in a $2B outsourcing market where individual CPA firms currently pay $100k-$1M per year for inferior services. We're positioned to capture significant market share by offering better accuracy & document coverage, instant processing, and superior user experience.

We've built this kind of software before, we've worked together for years (and even lived together),…

magnetic.what_they_sell: SaaS platform that automates tax document intake and data entry for CPA firms. Scans handwritten notes, spreadsheets, K-1s, and other client documents; extracts structured data via OCR + LLM; and auto-populates tax software, eliminating manual data entry during tax season.
magnetic.ai_play: AI agents (OCR + LLM-powered document parsing) replace the tedious, error-prone manual data entry step that currently consumes 80+ hour weeks during tax season. Reduces busy work, increases throughput per CPA, and allows firms to serve more clients without hiring.

Build internal agents to automate back office work with one prompt

Mantle connects to all your tools: your CRM, Mail, Calendar, Payments, Product Analytics, and more. With just one prompt, you can create agents that handle back office work for you.

Since fusion does not use highly radioactive fuels or materials – unlike fission – we sidestep the vast majority of regulatory challenges and safety risks associated with nuclear energy. miniswap.name: Miniswap
miniswap.description:
The Marketplace for Complex Hobbies

Miniswap a marketplace for complex hobbies, starting with Warhammer.

In hobbies as complex as Warhammer, finding what you want on general marketplaces is a huge pain. Filters don't work, free-form listings mean that products are regularly misidentified, and piles of counterfeit junk crowd search results. 

Miniswap saves hobbyists from this chaos with its catalogue of more than 20,000 unique miniatures. Sellers match their listings against Miniswap's catalogue giving buyers more information and structure as they shop.

The global market for tabletop games is estimated to be worth $20B in 2025 and Warhammer alone is projected to grow to $3B by 2030. By capturing the market in this untapped niche, Miniswap is strongly positioned to bringing greater transparency, simplicity, and connectivity into adjacent verticals.

Miniswap's founding team merges deep domain knowledge with elite programming expertise and years of experience in business consulting and startups. Co-founders Zak and Will met while studying together at Cambridge, bonded over their love of Warhammer and early modern history. They have been best friends ever since.
miniswap.industry_sub_vertical: Tabletop gaming collectibles & miniatures peer-to-peer marketplace
miniswap.what_they_sell: Two-sided marketplace for Warhammer miniatures and complex hobby collectibles. Sellers list items matched against Miniswap's curated 20K+ item catalogue; buyers search with structured, verified product data instead of free-form listings.
miniswap.ai_play: AI-powered product matching and catalogue standardization. Sellers' unstructured listings are automatically matched/normalized against the canonical Miniswap catalogue, eliminating misidentification, counterfeits, and search chaos. AI improves matching accuracy, reduces friction for both sides, and builds network effects through better discovery and trust.

minro.name: Minro
minro.one_liner: Identify churn risk and stay close to users at scale
minro.description:
Identify churn risk and stay close to users at scale

Minro helps companies stay close to their users as they scale.

Today, most startups have thousands of product events flowing through tools like PostHog, but still have no real understanding of who their users actually are, which users are quietly about to churn, or what outreach actually brings them back. Founders care deeply about their users, but staying close to them becomes operationally impossible very quickly.

Minro plugs directly into a company’s analytics stack and turns product activity into living customer intelligence. We enrich every user with context like their company, role, LinkedIn/GitHub/Twitter, background, and likely use case, currently matching users to the correct online identity with ~80% accuracy starting from just name + email.

We then identify which users are most likely to churn based on behavioral patterns, persona similarity, and historical retention signals, and help founders proactively reach out before those users disappear. Minro drafts highly contextual founder-style outreach, tracks which conversations actually convert into retention, and continuously improves the system over time.

The result is a customer intelligence and retention layer that helps companies understand their users better, build stronger relationships, and reduce churn before it happens.
minro.industry_sub_vertical: SaaS churn prediction and retention automation for product-led growth companies
minro.what_they_sell: SaaS platform that integrates with analytics stacks (PostHog, etc.) to automatically identify at-risk users, enrich them with contextual identity/company/role data, predict churn likelihood, and autonomously draft and execute founder-style retention outreach at scale.
minro.ai_play: AI agents replace manual customer success workflows: (1) entity resolution (name+email → LinkedIn/GitHub/Twitter identity with ~80% accuracy), (2) behavioral churn prediction (pattern matching + persona similarity + historical signals), (3) autonomous outreach generation (contextual, founder-voice messaging), (4) closed-loop learning (tracking conversion, iterating on messaging). Transforms raw product events into actionable customer intelligence and removes the manual work of identifying and reaching out to at-risk users.

misprint.name: Misprint
misprint.one_liner: Misprint is building Robinhood for Pokemon cards
misprint.description:
Misprint is building Robinhood for Pokemon cards

Misprint is an all-in-one marketplace that solves the biggest pain point in the collectibles world: opaque pricing. Collectors, investors, and hobbyists currently rely on scattered data from auction houses, online forums, and reseller platforms, making it difficult to know the true value of their items. Misprint streamlines the process by combining accurate pricing analytics with a seamless buy/sell marketplace, making it easier than ever to understand and monetize collectible assets.

Existing marketplaces lack robust, real-time analytics because accurate valuations require deep expertise in both the collectibles domain and advanced pricing algorithms. Misprint’s unique blend of insider trading card knowledge and machine learning allows us to fill this gap.

Building these pricing models requires extensive data infrastructure, deep domain expertise, and cutting-edge ML. Recent surges in the trading card market show that collectors crave transparent valuations.

The global collectibles market is worth tens of billions of dollars. Eva has experienced the scale of this industry firsthand, generating $500k ARR within three months of taking her Pokemon card-selling side hustle full-time. With additional segments like sports cards, comics, and emerging collectible categories, the growth runway is immense.

Co-founders Eva and Jon have been best friends since Exeter, combining finance expertise, a passion for collectibles, and mathematical rigor. By merging Goldman Sachs-level financial analytics with top-tier mathematical talent, Misprint is uniquely positioned to become the go-to platform for fair, transparent pricing in the collectibles space.
misprint.industry_sub_vertical: Collectibles marketplace with ML-powered valuation analytics for trading card investors
misprint.what_they_sell: Two-sided marketplace for buying/selling collectibles (Pokemon cards, sports cards, comics) with real-time pricing analytics and transparent valuations powered by ML models trained on auction house data, reseller platforms, and trading history.
misprint.ai_play: ML-driven pricing models that aggregate fragmented market data (auction houses, forums, resellers) to compute accurate, real-time valuations. AI replaces opaque manual pricing with algorithmic transparency, enabling collectors to make informed buy/sell decisions and reducing information asymmetry. Pricing models are the core defensibility — trained on domain-specific collectibles data and continuously refined with transaction data from the marketplace itself.

In the next 10 years, with more AI agents spawning and trying to get PMF, developing an agent that actually works for users is critical. Everyone has access to the same models, thus the ones that win on a product level will be the ones who learn fastest from real usage. Moda is that learning layer.

modelence.name: Modelence
modelence.one_liner: The full-stack platform for agentic development
modelence.description:
The full-stack platform for agentic development

You built the demo in a weekend. Now you need auth, a prod-grade database, real-time events, AI observability, cron jobs, email, monitoring… and you needed them yesterday.

We spent a decade at our previous startup, building a platform while scaling to millions of users and customers like Meta & Netflix. Now we put that into an open-source framework, so others wouldn’t have to do the same from scratch.

Modelence is a batteries-included production ready platform for agentic development that abstracts away boilerplate so you can just focus on building your product logic and deploy it to production without worrying about infrastructure.

Shipping production apps is much harder than building a prototype that runs locally and 95% of all production apps share the same building blocks. We did a massive amount of work on our previous platforms that was not specific to our product, and we’ve created Modelence to abstract that away:
- Authentication
- Database setup
- Hosting / CDN
- AI integration (LLM observability, prompts)
- Real-time events
- Cron jobs
- Email service
- Monitoring
- Analytics
- Admin dashboards

Andrej Karpathy recently posted about this same exact problem:
https://x.com/karpathy/status/1905051558783418370

and explained it further in his YC AI Startup School talk:
https://youtu.be/LCEmiRjPEtQ?feature=shared&t=1940
modelence.industry_sub_vertical: Agent development platform with integrated observability, hosting, and infrastructure abstractions
modelence.what_they_sell: Open-source batteries-included platform for agentic development that bundles auth, database, hosting, LLM observability, real-time events, cron, email, monitoring, analytics, and admin dashboards into a single framework. Monetized via open-source core + commercial SaaS hosting/managed service layer.
modelence.ai_play: Abstracts away non-product infrastructure boilerplate (auth, databases, hosting, monitoring) so AI/agentic app developers can focus purely on agent logic and LLM integration. Includes native LLM observability and prompt management, reducing friction for teams shipping production agentic systems.

morphoai.name: MorphoAI
morphoai.one_liner: Software tool for designing robots and machines
morphoai.description:
Software tool for designing robots and machines

We're building an AI powered platform for engineers that are building new robots and machines. 

We allow users to invent and modify machine designs in a matter of minutes, not years. Ayna and Andy, the co-founders, met during their time at Harvard and started this in 2024 as their programs were wrapping up. We're commercializing 10+ years research done by our team at Harvard and MIT on this space. Our team wrote the very first papers on applying GenAI and optimization algorithms to compose robots from parts and applying computational design to fine tune machine designs. We're bringing in our deep knowledge of modifying equipment and integrating it into factories keenly understanding what makes hardware hard. 

We take in parts under consideration, constraints and tasks at hand and our algorithm formulates and fine tunes from 100s of possible design options. All in a few clicks, so engineers can push hardware to market faster and companies can benefit from the inventions being done by their R&D teams. We already have two paying customers in the OEM and system integrator spaces. 

We are venture backed and supported by a GBP 2.5MM grant by ARIA, the UK Government's invention agency.

morphoai.ai_play: AI dramatically compresses R&D cycles for hardware design. moss.name: Moss
moss.one_liner: Real-time semantic search for Conversational AI
moss.description:
Real-time semantic search for Conversational AI

Moss is building the real-time semantic search runtime for conversational and multimodal AI. Our system enables voice agents, copilots, and chat interfaces to retrieve, reason, and respond in sub-10 ms, delivering the responsiveness that makes AI interactions feel truly natural.

If you’ve ever built a conversational or voice AI product, you’ve felt the lag. That moment when an agent pauses and the illusion of intelligence breaks. The bottleneck is almost always retrieval. Each query hops across networks and databases, adding delay and cost. Moss eliminates that gap by keeping retrieval close to where the agent runs.

Moss runs natively across browsers, mobile devices, and servers with an optimized vector index built in Rust and WebAssembly. It enables teams to build AI products that feel instant, contextual, and adaptive. The experiences that sustain engagement and unlock new kinds of interaction. For our customers, this translates into tangible business value: stronger user retention, higher conversion, and entirely new product categories made possible by real-time understanding. Moss is already powering production pilots across voice AI and developer platforms, achieving sub-10 ms retrieval and 70–90% token savings compared to traditional pipelines.
moss.industry_sub_vertical: Real-time semantic search & vector retrieval for conversational AI agents
moss.what_they_sell: Real-time semantic search runtime (vector index + retrieval engine) deployed natively on browsers, mobile, and servers. Enables sub-10ms retrieval for voice agents, copilots, and chat interfaces via optimized Rust/WebAssembly implementation.
moss.ai_play: Solves the 'retrieval latency' bottleneck in conversational AI by moving semantic search close to the agent runtime, eliminating network hops and database round-trips. Reduces token consumption (70–90% savings) and enables sub-10ms response times that preserve the illusion of natural, real-time interaction.

mount.name: Mount
mount.description:
The AI Insurance Carrier

TLDR: Mount is building the AI insurance carrier, starting with liability coverage for deployed AI agents. As everyone moves AI Agents into production and gives them more responsibility, we help businesses insure and secure them.

Whenever responsibility shifts from human operators to autonomous systems, so too does the liability that accompanies it. The systems also introduce new risks: agentic software failures, prompt injection attacks, autonomous workflow errors, data leaks, and more.

Legacy insurance was not built for this. Existing policies are often silent, ambiguous, or exclude autonomous software, and traditional insurers lack the data and technical capability to assess deployed AI Systems.

Our first product, the Mount AI Liability Policy, is built for mid-market and enterprise companies deploying autonomous AI agents in real business processes. We scan and red-team AI deployments, quantify operational risk, help fix vulnerabilities, and insure the residual risk with purpose-built AI liability coverage.

Mount is best thought of as a highly automated version of today's commercial insurance carriers, which run on manual workflows, layers of intermediaries, and tens of thousands of employees. AI enables automation of underwriting, pricing, policy issuance, claims, fraud detection, customer support, and distribution. We believe that the best way to use this opportunity is to rebuild those processes from the ground up.

multifactor.one_liner: Zero-trust authentication, authorization, and auditing for AI agents

Zero-trust authentication, authorization, and auditing for AI agents

The agentic era is here, but its foundation is dangerously insecure. A growing number of high-profile "AI agent gone rogue" security incidents make headlines each week.

As enterprise adoption of agentic software has far outpaced the development of applicable cybersecurity solutions, CISOs have loudly voiced a growing need for verifiable, fine-grained security controls on complex multi-agent systems. That's why we built Multifactor.

Multifactor offers best-in-class authentication, authorization, and auditing technologies for agentic systems, allowing users to securely and revocably share online accounts with agents while maintaining fine-grained permissions and a detailed event history. We are doing for AI security what Cloudflare did for web security, Okta did for identity security, and Wiz did for cloud security: defining the category.

A world-class "account manager" that allows agents to securely use online accounts on your behalf is just the start—our early enterprise partners include companies using AI agents to manage $7.5+ billion manufacturing supply chains, where the consequences for lapses in security are severe. Our patented AI security technology seamlessly integrates with existing agentic software to thwart attacks like prompt injection, so CISOs and end users alike can breathe a sigh of relief, without slowing the pace of AI adoption.

multifactor.what_they_sell: Zero-trust authentication, authorization, and auditing infrastructure for AI agents. Hardware + SaaS platform that enables enterprises to securely delegate online account access to agents with fine-grained permissions, revocable credentials, and comprehensive audit trails.
multifactor.ai_play: Multifactor solves the critical security gap in agentic systems by providing verifiable controls that prevent agent misuse, prompt injection attacks, and unauthorized actions. They act as a security layer between agents and sensitive systems/accounts, allowing enterprises to adopt AI agents at scale without sacrificing control or compliance.

ndea-com.name: Ndea
ndea-com.description:
Building AGI that can innovate.

Ndea is building frontier AI systems that blend intuitive pattern recognition and formal reasoning into a unified architecture.

# AI for Scientific Advancement

Unlike all life before us, humanity's ascent is a story of ingenuity, not just biological evolution. Our progress has been driven by the curiosity to acquire knowledge, the ability to pass it on, and an intrinsic drive to innovate. We build technology which gives us leverage beyond our biology.

We stand at the top of a knowledge and technology colossus that we collectively created over the past ten thousand generations. Scientific progress has helped us overcome burdens that long defined human life — famines, plagues, and widespread illiteracy. Science will continue to redefine the boundaries of the human condition.

Today, the acceleration of scientific progress hinges on one factor: AI capable of independent invention and discovery. This capacity is the gateway to advancements beyond our wildest imagination.

# A New Research Lab

We're starting Ndea — an AI research and science lab. The name - like 'idea' with an 'n' - is inspired by the Greek concepts ennoia (intuitive understanding) and dianoia (logical reasoning), capturing our first goal to merge deep learning with program synthesis.

Ndea is entirely focused on developing and operationalizing AGI to realize unprecedented scientific progress in our lifetime for the benefit of all current and future generations.

Building AGI alone is a monumental undertaking, but our mission is even bigger. We're creating a factory for rapid scientific advancement — a factory capable of inventing and commercializing N ideas.

From our vantage point today, we see many 'known' frontiers like self-driving vehicles, drug discovery, sustainable energy, robotics, and space exploration. While AGI will benefit all of these, the most exciting adventure lies in the 'unknown'. AGI promises discoveries and progress we cannot im…

They are developing the AI capabilities themselves and plan to operationalize AGI to invent and commercialize breakthrough discoveries across multiple domains (drug discovery, sustainable energy, robotics, space exploration, and unknown frontiers).
ndea-com.ai_play: Building AGI from scratch by merging deep learning with program synthesis into a unified architecture capable of independent invention. The AI IS the product — a research entity that can autonomously advance science beyond human-only capabilities.

nessie.name: Nessie
nessie.one_liner: A shared context layer for you, your team, and your agents.
nessie.description:
A shared context layer for you, your team, and your agents.

Knowledge work is being restructured by AI. Strategy happens in Claude. Research happens in ChatGPT. Building happens in Claude Code. The people defining the next decade of work are already thinking with AI every day. But none of that thinking compounds. Every session starts from zero. The reasoning behind decisions, the context behind strategies, the evolution of ideas across hundreds of conversations - all of it evaporates.

Nessie is the infrastructure that makes it permanent. We auto-sync AI conversations across every major provider - ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Perplexity, Claude Code, OpenClaw, Codex, and more - and structure them into queryable, trustworthy context available to both humans and agents. No browser extension. No manual capture. Your thinking flows in automatically and compounds over time.

Today, Nessie is the memory layer that makes every AI interaction smarter - grounded in your actual reasoning, not the median. Your agents start with your accumulated thinking instead of a blank slate. Your decisions have provenance, traceable back to the conversation where the thinking happened.

Where we are going: the AI-native organization of the near future is a small team running thousands of agents. Those agents are powerful but amnesiac - they make decisions, form hypotheses, discover patterns, and forget everything between sessions. The organization's collective intelligence exists nowhere. There is no layer that integrates what the organization knows, what it has decided, and how its thinking has evolved. Nessie is that layer. Not another workspace. Not another wiki. The connective tissue that makes AI-native organizations possible.

Science has journals. Law has case law. Software has git. AI-native knowledge work has nothing. We are building the infrastructure for cumulative thinking in the AI era.

We are two Yale CS grads and former Amazon engineers. Backed by BoxGroup, Pioneer F…

Essentially a memory and knowledge backbone for AI-native teams.
nessie.ai_play: Solves the 'context explosion' and 'agent amnesia' problem: AI agents and humans lose reasoning context between sessions. Nessie captures, structures, and retrieves accumulated thinking across all AI interactions, enabling agents to start with organizational knowledge instead of a blank slate. Transforms fragmented conversations into a computable, trustworthy knowledge layer.

octapulse.one_liner: CV and robotics to automate quality inspection in fish farms
octapulse.description:
CV and robotics to automate quality inspection in fish farms

OctaPulse uses AI vision to automate hatchery QA for fish farms, starting with broodstock phenotyping and juvenile deformity inspection. We cut inspection time from about 5 minutes to under 30 seconds per fish, with more than 90 percent accuracy, so farms advance only high quality fish and waste less feed and labor. Our goal is to bring automation across the entire fish production lifecycle for the $300B aquaculture industry.

Aquaculture is the fastest growing food sector, and has already surpassed commercial fishing for production of seafood. Yet two of the most critical QA and QC steps in fish production are still done by hand: phenotyping and deformity inspection. These processes are slow, error prone, and despised by technicians but vital for the success of the farm, so much so that farms spend >$200K a year on trained technicians and geneticists to operate. We’ve built an AI vision platform for vertically integrated finfish farms that drops into existing workflows starting in the hatchery, uses off the shelf cameras, standardizes these QA steps, and creates a proprietary multi species dataset that becomes the brain for future autonomous aquafarms. Phenotyping is the start, but the platform is designed to be a drop in solution that can easily expand into feeding, health monitoring, and processing so we can solve production problems across the lifecycle.

 We signed a 6-figure paid pilot with the largest trout producer in the United States, are deploying into 2 more farms early 2026, and trained models above 90 percent accuracy while cutting inspection time from 5 minutes to under 30 seconds. Each deployment adds labeled images to our dataset and improves cross species generalization.
octapulse.industry_sub_vertical: Aquaculture hatchery QA automation (broodstock phenotyping and deformity inspection)

octapulse.what_they_sell: CV + robotics hardware/software system that drops into fish farm hatcheries to automate phenotyping and deformity inspection; platform designed to expand into feeding, health monitoring, and processing across the aquaculture production lifecycle
octapulse.ai_play: Vision models trained on proprietary multi-species fish dataset for QA automation; each deployment adds labeled images to improve cross-species generalization and enable future autonomous aquafarm operations

We started trading prediction markets ourselves but couldn't backtest our strategies because the tooling for this emerging asset class didn't exist. The deeper we went, the more we saw that fragmentation between prediction markets and lack of clean data was going to be a big problem.

We launched a prosumer tier and grew to several thousand dollars in MRR within months. Now we're bringing it to institutions, building tooling with the rigor and depth serious desks demand. 

They're the fastest growing asset class in finance, and CFTC applications for new exchanges keep climbing. Each new venue makes the market bigger, the fragmentation worse, and the unified data layer more valuable. It doesn't exist yet. We're building it.

oncactus.name: Cactus
oncactus.one_liner: All-In-One AI Growth Partner. Built for Trades.
oncactus.description:
All-In-One AI Growth Partner. Built for Trades.

HVAC, plumbing, roofing, and electrical companies spend $3K–$25K every month making the phone ring - then lose 10–20% of those leads to slow response times, missed calls, and zero follow-up. The revenue was already there. It just walked out the back door.

Cactus closes that gap on both sides.

Inbound: Every call answered in under 60 seconds, 24/7 qualified and booked directly into Housecall Pro, Jobber, FieldEdge, or ServiceTitan. No voicemails. No missed jobs.

Outbound: Warm leads, dormant customers, and unworked estimates get proactively contacted - driving repeat jobs, cross-sells, upsells, and referrals without adding headcount.

The result: 20–30% more jobs from the ad budget you're already spending.

What that looks like in practice:

→ Roofing company, NC | $299K collected in 10 weeks. $1.41M pipeline created. 199× ROI. $48K of that revenue came in after hours — while the office was closed.

→ Plumbing & HVAC company, UT | $180K confirmed revenue in 4 months. 90× ROI. 58% of captured leads came after hours — jobs that would have gone to voicemail now go straight into the CRM.

→ General contracting company | Grew from 11 jobs/month to 72 in a single month — 555% growth. $2.09M invoiced. $1.82M collected. Zero new hires.

→ Roofing & siding company | $228K pipeline in 75 days. 92% of calls converted to hot leads. $804K in net sales during the Cactus period. 49 spam calls filtered automatically — hours of staff time saved.

→ Commercial signage company | $398K pipeline generated in 10 weeks. 111× ROI on $3,597 invested. Grew from 0% to 30% share of total company pipeline in a single month.

If we don't add revenue, we don't stay. That's the only way this works.

The $150B home services industry is still running on voicemail and spreadsheets. We're building the system that changes that - one answered call at a time.

Captures 10–20% of lost leads (voicemail, slow response, no follow-up) and drives 20–30% incremental revenue from existing ad spend. Integrates with home-services-specific CRMs to eliminate manual data entry and ensure seamless handoff to field teams.

ondeck-ai.name: OnDeck AI
ondeck-ai.one_liner: Analyze any footage, without training a model
ondeck-ai.description:
Analyze any footage, without training a model

OnDeck is the infrastructure layer that makes Vision Language Models accessible and scalable for enterprise. We let organizations instantly find any object, behavior or event, in any footage, without needing to train a model or collect any training data.

The Pain: Creating vision models usually takes months: collecting training data, training, then deployment.  Worse yet: 
+ it’s often impossible to get enough data for a specific task, and 
+ even the best cv models struggle to generalize across diverse camera setups, workflows and environments. 

To overcome these blockers, we bet early on the power of VLMs and built a vision engine that can generalize across any task and doesn’t need any training data. We published a NeurIPS workshop paper showing our new methods with VLMs beat traditional CV even at niche tasks.

Our current customers include:
- National Defense Organizations
- Robotics Research
- Security cameras
- Behaviour analysis for port monitoring
- Off-shore oil & gas monitoring
ondeck-ai.industry_sub_vertical: Vision Language Model infrastructure for enterprise video analysis and object/behavior detection
ondeck-ai.what_they_sell: Infrastructure API/SDK that wraps Vision Language Models to enable enterprises to query any video footage for objects, behaviors, and events without training custom models. Deployed as SaaS or on-prem; handles camera diversity, workflow generalization, and inference optimization.
ondeck-ai.ai_play: VLM-as-a-service abstraction layer. Replaces months of traditional CV model training (data collection, labeling, training, deployment) with zero-shot VLM inference. Solves the 'context explosion' problem in video: enterprises have massive footage archives but can't efficiently search/analyze without custom models. OnDeck compresses video into queryable semantic context via VLM embeddings, enabling agents and human analysts to find patterns instantly.

one-robot.name: One Robot
one-robot.one_liner: World models for robot evals and training.
one-robot.description:
World models for robot evals and training.

One Robot builds simulation environments that are realistic to see and realistic to interact with, so robotics teams can train and evaluate robot policies without being bottlenecked by robot time.

Today, improving a VLA often means more real-world hours: setting up the scene, running trials, resetting, and repeating. This loop is slow, expensive, and hard to scale. For example, material handling and manufacturing assembly tasks, models need far more training and evaluation data than teams can collect in the real world.

We use task-specific data to build world model-based simulation environments for hard manipulation tasks (for example, textiles and box folding). These environments help teams run more training and evals, find failure modes faster, and accelerate iteration on action policies with less dependence on real-world data collection and robot availability.

opusense-ai.name: Opusense AI
opusense-ai.description:
AI for Field Inspection Reports

Opusense AI automates field report writing for construction field inspectors. Instead of typing up notes at the end of the day, inspectors can now walk a site, speak observations aloud, snap photos, and let our AI assistant generate a detailed, organized report on-site and in real time.

Combined, the founding team has over 15 years in the construction industry. Writing up these field reports used to take up at least 20% of the week. With Opusense, we cut that time by 5x. Our team combines deep construction experience with technical expertise, Roya has a PhD in civil engineering, and Michael has worked at multiple construction tech startups.

Why hasn’t this been done before? Construction is slow to adopt new tech, and reporting is messy, photos, voice notes, and field notes all live in silos. Turning that into a clear, structured report requires real insight into how inspectors work and what clients need. Only now, with advances in AI, can we process unstructured data adequately to generate high-quality reports in real time.

The opportunity is massive. Every inspection firm and contractor is struggling with documentation. Manual reports slow them down, create inconsistencies, and delay handoffs. We believe AI can do this better, and Opusense is proving it.
opusense-ai.industry_sub_vertical: Construction field inspection report automation and defect documentation
opusense-ai.what_they_sell: SaaS platform that automates field inspection report generation for construction inspectors. Inspectors capture voice notes, photos, and field observations on-site; AI processes multimodal input and generates structured, organized reports in real-time without manual typing.
opusense-ai.ai_play: AI replaces the manual, time-intensive report-writing workflow (20% of inspector week → 5x faster). Multimodal AI (speech-to-text, image analysis, context understanding) converts unstructured field data (voice, photos, notes) into domain-compliant, structured inspection reports. Deep construction domain knowledge embedded in prompt/output schema ensures reports meet client/regulatory standards.

orange-slice.name: Orange Slice
orange-slice.description:
Agentic sales enrichment spreadsheet

Orange Slice is a spreadsheet where every column is TypeScript—and AI writes it for you. Describe what you want in chat ("find the CEO's LinkedIn and get their email"), and we generate the code, create the columns, and run it across thousands of rows. Our fully-typed SDK has 100+ enrichments built in: LinkedIn, contact info, company data, web scraping, AI research. Columns automatically execute in dependency order. No workflow builders—just describe it or code it.
orange-slice.industry_sub_vertical: Sales operations data enrichment for AI agents
orange-slice.what_they_sell: Spreadsheet interface where columns are executable TypeScript functions. Users describe enrichment tasks in natural language ("find CEO LinkedIn and email"), and AI generates typed code that runs across thousands of rows. Built-in SDK with 100+ enrichment sources (LinkedIn, contact databases, web scraping, company data APIs).
orange-slice.ai_play: AI-generated code generation + agentic execution. Replaces manual data enrichment workflows and custom scripting by letting sales teams describe what data they need and having AI write the integration logic. Dependency-aware column execution means agents orchestrate multi-step enrichment pipelines autonomously.

orbital-operations.name: Orbital Operations
orbital-operations.one_liner: High Thrust Space Vehicles for Satellite Defense
orbital-operations.description:
High Thrust Space Vehicles for Satellite Defense

Orbital Operations is developing a high thrust, reusable space vehicle for satellite defense. We protect critical satellites, like GPS and Military communication satellites, from adversarial threats, like China and Russia.

Our vehicle will use the exact same propulsion systems that launch vehicles have used for decades by implementing a cryogenic management system. This will give us over 100x the thrust or current in-space propulsion.

Ross and I have over 15 years of combined aerospace experience across NASA, Aerojet Rocketdyne, SpaceX, Blue Origin, and Relativity Space. We’ve worked side by side for more than 3.5 years developing propulsion systems, turbomachinery, and building our own respective engineering teams.

We are currently working on the first demo of our unique cryo management system and intend to launch an operational vehicle by 2027.
orbital-operations.industry_sub_vertical: Satellite defense and orbital maneuvering vehicles
orbital-operations.what_they_sell: High-thrust, reusable space vehicles for satellite defense and orbital maneuvering. Core product is the vehicle hardware with advanced cryogenic propulsion management enabling 100x+ thrust improvement over existing in-space propulsion systems.
orbital-operations.ai_play: AI accelerates propulsion system design optimization, cryogenic thermal management automation, autonomous vehicle control for satellite defense maneuvers, and manufacturing precision for complex turbomachinery. AI is an enabler of the physical system's performance and autonomy, not the primary product.

orchid-ai.name: Orchid
orchid-ai.one_liner: A personal EA in your iMessage
orchid-ai.description:
A personal EA in your iMessage

Orchid is an executive assistant that lives in iMessage. It texts you your day each morning, drafts your replies, and books your meetings. You approve, it handles the rest.

If you've ever wished for a world-class EA, come talk to us.
orchid-ai.industry_sub_vertical: Executive calendar & meeting automation for C-suite productivity
orchid-ai.what_they_sell: An AI executive assistant accessible via iMessage that automates daily EA tasks: morning briefings, email/message drafting, meeting scheduling, and calendar management. Seat-based SaaS subscription targeting busy executives and high-bandwidth professionals.
orchid-ai.ai_play: AI agent replaces manual EA labor for routine communication and scheduling tasks. Core value: autonomous task execution (drafting, booking) with human approval loop, delivered through familiar messaging interface (iMessage) to reduce friction and increase adoption.

origami-robotics.name: Origami Robotics
origami-robotics.description:
Manipulate Anything Robot

We are building a "manipulate anything" model with the robot hardware that embodies it. We designed a hand-based data-collection device and a high DOF, direct drive robotic hand that match each other exactly, enabling us to eliminate embodiment gap and collect real-world data and deploy it directly. We want to scale real world manipulation data by deploying our devices "in the wild" like manufacturing factories, logistic centers to collect Tesla like data, use these data to train our model and then provide automation solutions to these industries.
origami-robotics.industry_sub_vertical: Robotic manipulation hardware and foundation models for factory and logistics automation deployment
origami-robotics.what_they_sell: High-DOF robotic hand hardware paired with matching teleoperation data-collection device, plus manipulation foundation models trained on real-world deployment data. Sell automation solutions (likely hardware + software subscription) to manufacturing and logistics customers.
origami-robotics.ai_play: Eliminates embodiment gap by designing identical hardware for data collection and deployment. Collects 'Tesla-like' real-world manipulation data at scale by deploying teleoperation devices in factories/warehouses, trains foundation models on this data, then deploys trained models on matching robotic hands for autonomous manipulation tasks.

origin-bio.name: Origin
origin-bio.one_liner: AI and Data for Cancer Therapeutics
origin-bio.description:
AI and Data for Cancer Therapeutics

Creating the largest patient-derived cancer single-cell dataset for licensing to pharmaceutical and AI companies. These datasets are unique as they screen the effects of various drugs and genetic medicines under the control of our DNA switches.
origin-bio.industry_sub_vertical: Patient-derived cancer cell dataset licensing for drug discovery and AI model training
origin-bio.what_they_sell: Licenses to proprietary patient-derived cancer single-cell datasets with drug screening results and genetic medicine effects
origin-bio.ai_play: Creates unique wet-lab-generated datasets (not synthetic) that combine patient-derived cancer cells, drug screening, and DNA switch-controlled genetic medicine effects for pharma R&D and AI training

ornadyne.name: Ornadyne
ornadyne.one_liner: We're building robot birds for surveillance.
ornadyne.description:
We're building robot birds for surveillance.

Ornadyne builds flapping-wing drones for reconnaissance that look, fly, and sound like birds.

Today’s drones are easy to detect acoustically, visually, and electronically. As counter-UAS systems improve, traditional quadcopters and fixed-wing UAS systems are becoming increasingly ineffective for close-range surveillance.  

Flapping-wing aircraft have existed for years, but have lacked the performance, endurance, and control required for real-world deployment. We’re changing that by engineering a high-performance, stealth-optimized system built from first principles for efficiency, autonomy, and reliable field use.

The final frontier of surveillance won’t look like machines; it will look like wildlife already in the sky. 

Maybe birds aren't real?
ornadyne.industry_sub_vertical: Covert surveillance drones for military reconnaissance
ornadyne.what_they_sell: Flapping-wing drones (ornithopters) designed for covert reconnaissance that mimic bird flight patterns, acoustics, and appearance to evade detection by counter-UAS systems
ornadyne.ai_play: AI enables autonomous flight control of complex biomimetic flapping-wing dynamics, real-time stealth optimization (visual/acoustic signature management), and adaptive navigation for surveillance missions in contested environments where traditional drones are easily detected

orthogonal.name: Orthogonal
orthogonal.description:
Agentic Payments for APIs

APIs weren't built for agents. Orthogonal fixes that. We enable agentic payments so any agent can instantly discover, access, and pay for hundreds of APIs. No subscriptions, no sales calls, just pay per use. API providers list once and get paid every time an agent calls their API.
orthogonal.what_they_sell: Payment settlement and API discovery infrastructure for agent builders; enables agents to instantly access and pay-per-use for hundreds of APIs without subscriptions or sales calls
orthogonal.ai_play: Infrastructure layer that makes APIs agent-accessible by handling autonomous payment, discovery, and settlement—solving the agent-to-API integration and billing problem

osmosis.name: Osmosis
osmosis.description:
Reinforcement Learning (RL) for AI Agents

Osmosis is a post-training platform that helps companies fine-tune language models using reinforcement learning. We work with fast-growing AI companies to train task/domain-specific models that beat foundation models on performance, cost, and latency. Our platform handles compute orchestration, reward modeling, and training run observability as a CLI-based product usable by developers and agents.
osmosis.industry_sub_vertical: AI model post-training and reinforcement learning infrastructure for agent fine-tuning
osmosis.what_they_sell: CLI-based post-training platform that orchestrates reinforcement learning workflows for fine-tuning language models. Handles compute orchestration, reward model training, and training run observability. Enables AI companies to create task/domain-specific models optimized for performance, cost, and latency.
osmosis.ai_play: RL infrastructure that replaces manual model training and optimization workflows. Abstracts away compute complexity and reward signal design, allowing developers and agents to autonomously run training experiments. Enables downstream AI products (agents, copilots, vertical workflows) to use cheaper, faster, domain-optimized models instead of frontier foundation models.

outlit.name: Outlit
outlit.description:
Customer Context for Agents

Outlit turns every customer-facing tool in your stack, like Stripe, Granola, PostHog, Slack, Gmail, Pylon, and more, into one complete, queryable customer profile.

We resolve fragmented identity across mismatched records, extract structured facts and signals from unstructured interactions, and expose the result through CLI, MCP, and API. 

So every person and agent in your company has the full context on every customer to work from.
outlit.industry_sub_vertical: Customer data aggregation & identity resolution for agent context
outlit.what_they_sell: API/CLI/MCP service that aggregates fragmented customer data from SaaS tools (Stripe, PostHog, Slack, Gmail, etc.), resolves identity conflicts, extracts structured signals from unstructured interactions, and exposes a unified, queryable customer profile for agents and internal tools.
outlit.ai_play: Solves the 'context explosion' problem for agentic workflows: agents need rich customer context to execute tasks (support, sales, billing) but can't ingest raw, verbose data from 10+ disconnected sources due to token limits and latency. Outlit compresses and structures fragmented customer signals into token-efficient, semantically dense profiles that agents can query in real-time.

outrove.name: Outrove
outrove.description:
Ultra-realistic AI Recruiter

Outrove is the world’s most realistic AI recruiter, with a human-appearing interview agent that has both video and audio and can join Google Meet calls.
outrove.industry_sub_vertical: AI-powered candidate screening and interview automation for recruiting teams
outrove.what_they_sell: An autonomous AI recruiter agent that conducts video/audio interviews, screens candidates, and integrates into existing hiring workflows (Google Meet, ATS). Replaces manual first-round screening and initial candidate evaluation.
outrove.ai_play: Multimodal agentic AI (video + audio + real-time conversation) that mimics human recruiter behavior, reducing time-to-hire and screening costs while maintaining candidate experience quality. AI agent autonomously conducts interviews, evaluates responses, and surfaces qualified candidates.

outship.name: Outship
outship.one_liner: Hire amazing engineers by seeing how they use AI
outship.description:
Hire amazing engineers by seeing how they use AI

Software engineering is being rewritten in real time, and hiring is getting pulled along for the ride. 

With tools like Claude Code and Cursor, being able to ship is the new baseline. The signal for finding extraordinary engineers is the process: how candidates break down work, steer the agent, make tradeoffs, and recover when things break. 

Outship is a recruiting tool that allows you to capture and analyze that process alongside the final code so you can hire with confidence.

Candidates work in a cloud workspace that's ready to code. We handle the environment setup and secret management to give you a level testing ground.
outship.industry_sub_vertical: Engineering talent assessment and hiring workflow automation
outship.what_they_sell: SaaS platform that captures and analyzes how engineering candidates interact with AI coding agents (Claude, Cursor) during live coding assessments. Provides recruiters/hiring teams with structured data on candidate problem-solving process, agent steering, error recovery, and decision-making — not just final code output.
outship.ai_play: Uses AI observability and evaluation to replace traditional coding interviews. The platform instruments agent-candidate interactions to extract hiring signals (process quality, agent collaboration patterns, debugging approach) that are invisible in standard take-home or whiteboard assessments. AI agents become the testing harness; human evaluators assess the interaction trace.

overdrive-health.name: Overdrive Health
overdrive-health.description:

Overdrive Health offers AI powered medical billing services, helping providers get paid more money in less time. Our technology enables us to provide the best quality insurance and patient billing services for a fraction of the usual cost

overshoot.name: Overshoot
overshoot.one_liner: AI Infra for real-time vision applications
overshoot.description:
AI Infra for real-time vision applications

Overshoot makes it easy for developers to build and run real-time vision applications.

AI can see and understand the physical world. This unlocks new applications in physical security, safety, gaming, robotics and general consumer products. Soon, video agents will watch your home and your pet when you’re away. 

However, existing platforms make it painful for developers to build these real-time applications. Slow inference. Limited model availability. Break at scale. 

Overshoot solves this.

Today, 300+ developers connect live video feeds to the largest collection of Vision Language Models with 3 lines of code. And get responses in less than 200ms. 10x faster than any existing inference platform. Zero infra headache. 

Our moat is focus. Image and Video are fundamentally different modalities from text. By focusing on them, we are able to make strong technical leaps from codec, streaming protocols to inference engines.

Younes and Zakaria are cousins. Zakaria graduated top of his class at LSE and MIT, and later built low-latency high-throughput pricing systems (surge) at Uber and inference engines at Meta. He previously built and sold a software product and won several prominent AI hackathons. Younes was a founding engineer at Cosmonio (later acquired by Intel). He built a training and serving Computer Vision platform from scratch. He witnessed firsthand customers abandoning traditional Computer Vision because it lacked the “general” intelligence LLMs have today. Together we’ve shipped large-scale systems and know where they break.
overshoot.industry_sub_vertical: Real-time vision inference platform for developers building physical AI applications
overshoot.phenotype_primary_label: Vertical AI workflow agent (AI department for X)
overshoot.what_they_sell: Developer infrastructure platform providing API access to Vision Language Models with sub-200ms latency for real-time video applications. Developers integrate with 3 lines of code to connect live video feeds to VLMs for security, robotics, gaming, and consumer products.
overshoot.ai_play: Specialized inference infrastructure optimized for image/video modalities through custom codec, streaming protocols, and inference engines. Technical moat from modality-specific optimization (vision vs text) enabling 10x faster performance than general-purpose platforms.

overstand-labs.name: Overstand Labs
overstand-labs.one_liner: Navigate any set of data - no matter how large - in minutes.
overstand-labs.description:
Navigate any set of data - no matter how large - in minutes.

Overstand is a data lab that allows our customers to navigate any set of data in just a few minutes.

*Enterprise*: For enterprises, we we unify Slack, email, calls, and operational data, then surface the signals that matter — customer needs, risks, and revenue opportunities hidden in everyday conversations.

*Legal Firms*: For legal firms, we help them really quickly understand their entire discovery corpus (either before, or after document review), and quickly build out an initial case assessment and facts.

Instead of waiting on reports or manual analysis, teams get immediate, evidence-backed answers from the data they already have. Overstand delivers clarity and leverage as your business scales.
overstand-labs.industry_sub_vertical: Enterprise data discovery & legal discovery corpus analysis via conversational AI
overstand-labs.what_they_sell: SaaS platform that ingests enterprise data (Slack, email, calls, operational logs, legal discovery corpora) and surfaces actionable signals via conversational AI interface. Customers query large datasets in minutes instead of waiting for manual analysis or reports.
overstand-labs.ai_play: AI-powered semantic search and synthesis layer that compresses verbose, unstructured enterprise/legal data into structured, evidence-backed answers. Solves the 'context explosion' problem: legal teams and enterprises have massive discovery/operational datasets but can't manually parse them. Conversational interface + RAG + signal extraction replaces manual document review and report generation.

oximy.name: Oximy
oximy.one_liner: See and control all AI activity across your enterprise
oximy.description:

oximy.what_they_sell: Enterprise observability and governance platform that provides visibility into AI usage, spend control, and adoption tracking across all AI tools in an organization
oximy.ai_play: Infrastructure SaaS that aggregates and monitors AI activity across enterprise tools, enabling security, finance, and transformation teams to manage AI at scale

oxus.name: Oxus

pairio.name: Pairio
pairio.description:

pairio.phenotype_primary_label: Vertical AI workflow agent (AI department for X)

pally.name: Pally
pally.description:
Intelligent Unified Inbox + Personal CRM

We spend our lives in messaging apps. Slack. iMessage. WhatsApp. We face a constant stream of information, introductions, and things we need to do.

What if you could bring together every message, from every platform, in a Superhuman-like experience, with AI agents that automatically complete your action items?

pally.what_they_sell: Unified inbox SaaS that aggregates messages from Slack, iMessage, WhatsApp, and other platforms into a single interface with AI agents that automatically parse, prioritize, and execute action items.

palus-finance.name: Palus Finance
palus-finance.one_liner: 40% higher yields on company cash, in under 5 minutes.
palus-finance.description:
40% higher yields on company cash, in under 5 minutes.

panacea.name: Panacea

AI-Native FDA Regulatory Services

Panacea provides AI-native FDA regulatory services for Biotechs and Medical Device companies. panacea.what_they_sell: Managed FDA regulatory consulting services paired with AI platform, covering all major regulatory pathways (IND, NDA, BLA, ODD, Pre-Subs, 510(k), De Novo, PMA, IDE, BDD) with fixed, outcome-based pricing
panacea.ai_play: AI platform augments experienced ex-FDA consultants to accelerate regulatory strategy, document preparation, and milestone achievement; outcome-based pricing model aligns incentives with client success

Hardware (AR glasses) captures visual/spatial context; software (Chat app) synthesizes understanding. AI continuously updates its model of user preferences and intent, enabling anticipatory assistance rather than query-response.

piggy-robotics.name: Piggy Robotics
piggy-robotics.one_liner: Humanoid robots that do your chores for the price of an iPhone!
piggy-robotics.description:
Humanoid robots that do your chores for the price of an iPhone!

We build humanoid robots that do your chores at iPhone prices. Just like the millions of cars generating data for self-driving, we need millions of humanoids generating real-world data for general-purpose robotics. Humanoid companies today can only manufacture hundreds a year because motors are expensive and slow to assemble. We use artificial muscles. Each muscle is just a tube wrapped in braided fibre, and the whole robot is powered by a single pump — which means we can mass-produce humanoids by the millions. Our design is built for that scale from day one and is cheap enough to enter billions of homes.
piggy-robotics.industry_sub_vertical: Consumer humanoid robotics for home automation and task execution
piggy-robotics.what_they_sell: Mass-produced humanoid robots with artificial muscle actuation designed for consumer home automation tasks (chores, assistance). Hardware product with embedded AI control and learning capabilities.
piggy-robotics.ai_play: AI enables autonomous task execution, real-world data generation at scale for improving general-purpose robotics, and adaptive learning from millions of deployed units. Hardware-AI co-design: artificial muscle architecture optimized for AI-driven control and efficient manufacturing at scale.

pinch.name: Pinch
pinch.one_liner: Real-time AI Voice Translation for Developers
pinch.description:
Real-time AI Voice Translation for Developers

Robust live speech translation models with 50+ languages and simple integration
pinch.industry_sub_vertical: Real-time speech translation API for multilingual voice applications
pinch.what_they_sell: API/SDK for real-time speech-to-speech translation across 50+ languages. Developers integrate into voice apps, call centers, or communication platforms to enable live multilingual conversations without building custom ML pipelines.
pinch.ai_play: Abstracts away frontier speech translation models (ASR, translation, TTS) behind a simple developer API. Handles real-time inference optimization, latency reduction, and language routing. Enables developers to add voice translation as a feature without ML expertise.

pingo-ai.name: Pingo AI
pingo-ai.one_liner: AI companion that helps you learn languages
pingo-ai.description:
AI companion that helps you learn languages

Pingo AI is an AI language learning app that helps users build fluency through speaking. It immerses learners in realistic dialogues and personalized lessons with an AI tutor who sounds like a native speaker. Our goal is to make learning languages as simple as daily conversations with Pingo — a companion who understands your goals, remembers your progress, and keeps you motivated.
pingo-ai.what_they_sell: Subscription SaaS app: AI-powered language learning companion offering immersive dialogues, personalized lessons, and native-speaker-quality speech interaction. Freemium or premium tier model targeting individual language learners.
pingo-ai.ai_play: AI tutor replaces traditional language learning apps by providing real-time conversational practice with native-speaker audio synthesis, adaptive lesson personalization based on learner progress, and persistent memory of user goals and proficiency. Core differentiation is speech quality, dialogue realism, and personalization vs. static flashcard/grammar tools.

pirislabs.name: Piris Labs
pirislabs.description:
Inference at Light Speed

Piris Labs offers a full-stack inference service that eliminates the AI data movement bottleneck. By pairing proprietary photonic hardware with a vertically optimized software stack, we minimize the "memory wall" associated with expensive GPUs. This allows us to deliver the same performance as traditional clusters at a fraction of the cost. Our technology improves effective FLOP utilization and reduces latency, finally making the unit economics of trillion-parameter models sustainable. Founded by a team of MIT physicists and Meta AI experts.
pirislabs.industry_sub_vertical: Photonic hardware + software stack for LLM inference serving and cost optimization
pirislabs.phenotype_primary_label: Vertical AI workflow agent (AI department for X)
pirislabs.what_they_sell: Full-stack inference service combining proprietary photonic hardware with optimized software for serving large language models
pirislabs.ai_play: Novel photonic hardware architecture that solves the memory wall problem in GPU-based inference, enabling sustainable unit economics for trillion-parameter models through improved latency and utilization

pixley-ai.name: Pixley AI
pixley-ai.one_liner: The first platform where parents & kids can co-create AI cartoon shows
pixley-ai.description:
The first platform where parents & kids can co-create AI cartoon shows

Pixley is the first platform where kids can turn their drawings and ideas into fully animated cartoons in minutes. In just 3 weeks after launch, over 1000 families across 75 countries have already started creating stories.

We’re starting with a clear wedge: personalized kids’ entertainment. Parents are tired of overstimulating, low-value content from YouTube and Netflix. Pixley gives them safe and personalized stories that encourage learning and imagination.

But kids’ cartoons are just the beginning. As video generation improves, all video content will shift from manual production to being personalized and generated. Our long-term goal is to build the AI Netflix: a platform where shows and movies aren’t recommended, but instead generated around each viewer’s interests and habits.

We’re 19 year old CS dropouts who’ve known each other since elementary school and won 4 hackathons at 15. After seeing AI flood the internet with low-quality content, we created Pixley – a safe, personalized way for kids to turn their ideas into animated stories.
pixley-ai.industry_sub_vertical: AI-powered animated video creation for kids' personalized entertainment
pixley-ai.what_they_sell: A freemium platform enabling kids and parents to co-create animated cartoon shows by uploading drawings and story ideas, which AI transforms into fully animated videos in minutes. Monetized via subscription tiers for premium features (longer videos, advanced customization, ad-free viewing).
pixley-ai.ai_play: Generative video AI (text-to-video, image-to-animation) transforms user-provided drawings and narratives into polished animated content without manual production. AI handles animation generation, character consistency, and scene composition. Long-term vision: personalized video generation at Netflix scale.

plan0-ai.name: PLAN0 AI
plan0-ai.one_liner: AI powered construction cost estimation & analytics.
plan0-ai.description:
AI powered construction cost estimation & analytics.

PLAN0 is building the Bloomberg of construction for real estate developers, investors, and general contractors — $20B of projects are already running through the platform.

We analyze architectural plans using computer vision AI models to generate detailed cost estimates and analytics in minutes. Through industry partnerships, the platform is also building a database of historical and real-time localized project cost data that power its analytics. Using quant finance inspired ML models, it can decompose construction costs in market observable factors to predict all local trade level costs up to 24 months out with high accuracy.
plan0-ai.industry_sub_vertical: AI-powered construction cost estimation, forecasting & market intelligence for developers and contractors
plan0-ai.phenotype_primary_label: Vertical AI workflow agent (AI department for X)
plan0-ai.what_they_sell: Vertical SaaS platform that automates construction cost estimation and provides cost analytics/forecasting for real estate developers, general contractors, and investors
plan0-ai.ai_play: CV-based plan analysis + quant-finance-inspired ML models for cost decomposition and 24-month forward prediction of trade-level costs

play-health.name: Play Health
play-health.description:
Perimenopause Care Platform

Play Health is building a perimenopause care platform to provide women and their providers with the tools they need to relieve symptoms fast. It is led by technical, second-time, YC-backed founders Andrea Mazzocchi, PhD and Ian Miller, with an exit and a unicorn between them.

Over 30 million women in the U.S. are experiencing perimenopause symptoms, spending an estimated $15B+ annually on symptom management.  Despite this most only receive generic solutions and struggle to find effective symptom relief.

We're bringing evidence-based perimenopause care to women through partnerships with medical practices and employer and health benefits programs. Our platform integrates personalized symptom, medication, and lifestyle data to generate AI-powered insights and  clinical protocols, enabling providers to deliver specialized care.

Every clinical interaction enriches our longitudinal dataset allowing us to create better outcomes for patients, deeper insights for providers, and expand into women’s health broadly. This also enables us to partner with pharma and biotech companies developing therapeutics and diagnostics for women's health.
play-health.industry_sub_vertical: Women's health specialty practice operations & perimenopause clinical care delivery
play-health.what_they_sell: SaaS platform for medical practices and employer health programs that automates perimenopause care delivery: AI-powered symptom assessment, personalized medication/lifestyle recommendations, clinical protocol generation, and longitudinal patient data synthesis.
play-health.ai_play: AI ingests patient symptom, medication, and lifestyle data to generate personalized clinical insights and evidence-based care protocols. Longitudinal dataset becomes proprietary domain ontology for perimenopause care, enabling continuous model improvement and expansion into adjacent women's health verticals.

playablai.name: Playabl.ai
playablai.description:
TikTok for User-generated Games

Playabl is the TikTok for user-generated games, where anyone can play, create, publish, and monetize games.

[May 31st Update] We launched 5 days ago. 1m organic plays on 3k user-generated games at playabl.ai.
playablai.industry_sub_vertical: User-generated game creation, publishing, and monetization platform
playablai.what_they_sell: Consumer platform where end-users play, create, publish, and monetize user-generated games in a social feed format
playablai.ai_play: AI lowers the barrier to game creation, allowing anyone to generate playable games without technical skills, similar to how TikTok democratized video creation

playgent.name: Playgent
playgent.description:
Sandboxes for AI agents

When enterprise agents fail in production, the conditions that caused the failure are critical: user state, data, tool calls, and context. Without a way to recreate these conditions, teams can't fix what broke.

Playgent provides infrastructure to create high-fidelity sandbox environments for AI agents. Our environments come packaged as a single MCP url where tool calls are mocked, authentication is abstracted away, and test data can be initialized via natural language or JSON specifications.

Teams can use Playgent to reproduce production failures in safe, scoped environments that accurately reconstruct state. Finally, export runs as OTel traces from Playgent's environment to plug directly into your observability tools or RL pipelines.
playgent.industry_sub_vertical: AI agent sandbox & debugging infrastructure for production failure reproduction
playgent.what_they_sell: Infrastructure (SaaS + API) providing high-fidelity sandbox environments for AI agents. Environments abstract authentication, mock tool calls, initialize test data via natural language or JSON, and export runs as OTel traces for observability and RL training pipelines.
playgent.ai_play: Enables teams to reproduce production agent failures in safe, scoped environments by reconstructing exact user state, data, and context. Bridges the gap between production incidents and testable, debuggable scenarios—critical for agent reliability and continuous improvement via RL.

plena-health.name: Plena Health
plena-health.one_liner: Plena is the AI operating system for specialty medical practices
plena-health.description:
Plena is the AI operating system for specialty medical practices

Plena is the AI operating system for specialty medical practices. We automate the administrative workflows that keep clinics running — referrals, fax intake, scheduling, procedure compliance, and collections — end to end, across all the systems a practice already uses. Unlike point solutions that cover a slice of the problem, Plena becomes the operating layer across the entire practice, connecting the systems, teams, and workflows that keep it running. In 10 months we've grown 17x and crossed seven figures in committed ARR across six specialties and eight states, with 80% of growth through word of mouth.
plena-health.industry_sub_vertical: Specialty medical practice administrative automation (referrals, intake, scheduling, compliance, collections)
plena-health.what_they_sell: AI operating system SaaS platform that automates administrative workflows for specialty medical practices, integrating across existing practice management, EHR, and billing systems
plena-health.ai_play: Vertical AI SaaS automating the complete administrative operating layer for specialty practices—replacing point solutions with an integrated AI orchestration layer that handles referrals, intake, scheduling, compliance, and collections end-to-end

pleom.name: Pleom

Automatic insights on all your company data. Speed up business workflows to visualizations with a 0 learning curve.

Open-source agents to build predictive ML models from a prompt

Plexe builds predictive ML models from a problem description. It connects to data sources, conducts experiments, evaluates and deploys the models to an API endpoint.

pollen.name: Pollen
pollen.one_liner: AI agents that automate customer success
pollen.description:
AI agents that automate customer success

Pollen is building AI agents that autonomously improve retention. Pollen monitors every customer account to detect back-tested churn and upsell signals by connecting to your communications, support tickets, product usage, and CRM. Then, Pollen tells your team exactly which accounts need attention today and decides what to do next.

pollen.ai_play: Multi-source signal aggregation (CRM, support tickets, product telemetry, communications) + backtested churn/upsell prediction models + autonomous account prioritization and next-action recommendations

pollinate.name: Pollinate
pollinate.one_liner: AI Agents for the supply chain.
pollinate.description:
AI Agents for the supply chain.

Supply chains still run on spreadsheets and inboxes because ERPs are rigid and the data is messy. We're solving this problem by building an ontology where agents can operate and provide outcomes for our customers.

We start with procurement, by automating three-way match: extracting supplier invoices from email and matching them to the correct PO and receipt across ERPs.

Learn more at pollinate.tech
pollinate.industry_sub_vertical: Procurement invoice-to-PO matching and three-way reconciliation across multi-ERP supply chains
pollinate.phenotype_primary_label: Vertical AI workflow agent (AI department for X)

polymath.name: Polymath
polymath.one_liner: Simulation environments to train & evaluate long-horizon AI agents
polymath.description:
Simulation environments to train & evaluate long-horizon AI agents

We’re heading towards a future where AI agents will be able to perform useful work over long horizons, with little or no human supervision. To increase the reliability, performance, and safety of autonomous agents, they must be trained in simulation environments that reflect the real world. Polymath builds simulated worlds for agents to practice and learn through experience.

We're a team of researchers and engineers from UC Berkeley, Hume AI, Plaid, and Amazon. We have years of experience post-training frontier models in industry, and building large scale data systems. Polymath is backed by Y Combinator.
polymath.what_they_sell: Simulation environment infrastructure for training and evaluating long-horizon AI agents
polymath.ai_play: Provides realistic simulated worlds where autonomous agents can be trained and tested at scale before deployment, addressing the reliability and safety challenges of long-horizon agent systems

polymorph.name: Polymorph
polymorph.one_liner: Personalization infra that improves retention, LTV, and CAC
polymorph.description:
Personalization infra that improves retention, LTV, and CAC

Polymorph is personalization infra that lets developers use AI to personalize their apps, improving conversion, LTV, and CAC for consumer and self-serve apps.

This infra is used to personalize user experiences and notifications, which takes whole orgs years to build at companies like Facebook, TikTok, and Google.

They already support over 3.5M users across our customers, with some seeing 3.6x increases in conversion rates after using Polymorph.

Users are unique and special, make them feel like it~

The team has extensive experience in the space, having been in senior engineering leadership at Meta Ads, building out large-scale ML infrastructure at Scale AI, and iterating quickly and securely at startups like Gusto, Opal, and Nira.

pops.name: Pops
pops.one_liner: Create & play AI games with friends

Create & play AI games with friends

Pops lets people play, remix, and share AI games with friends.

Discover an infinite feed of games, challenges, quizzes, and other fun interactive experiences made by others. Every play instantly becomes a funny gameplay/reaction video you can send to friends, post online, or use to challenge someone to beat your score.

For creators, Pops makes it easier than ever to bring ideas to life and get them played. Instead of learning complex game engines, writing code, or fighting for distribution, anyone can create or remix a playable game in seconds. Bring your ideas, and Pops brings the audience.

pops.what_they_sell: Consumer social gaming platform where users create, remix, play, and share AI-generated games. Infinite feed of interactive experiences (games, challenges, quizzes) with automatic gameplay video generation for social sharing. No-code game creation tool that lets anyone build playable games in seconds.

AI likely powers game generation, mechanics creation, asset generation, and possibly gameplay video capture/editing for social sharing. Transforms game creation from months-long technical process to instant creative expression.

powermatrix.name: PowerMatrix
powermatrix.one_liner: Efficient and compact power supply for AI hardware
powermatrix.description:
Efficient and compact power supply for AI hardware

PowerMatrix provides the MOST efficient and compact next-generation high-performance power supplies for emerging technologies, such as GPUs, xPUs, AI server, datacenters, drones, EV, aerospace, etc. 

Based on patented circuit topology, embedded packaging, and novel magnetics, our power supply systems can reduce energy loss by up to 50%. 

We have developed several prototypes and are collaborating with world-leading customers.

prana-health.name: Prana
prana-health.one_liner: An AI primary care doctor in your pocket
prana-health.description:
An AI primary care doctor in your pocket

Prana replaces the reactive, 15-minute annual physical with continuous, proactive care. We connect to your medical records and wearables to watch for "clinical drift," catching subtle declines in health that human doctors miss between visits.

Most AI health apps are just chatbots. Prana is a full-stack medical provider. Our AI acts as a always-on physician that watches your data, explains your labs, and manages your prescriptions.

Safety & Scale: We automate 90% of the "grunt work" (history taking, logistics, triage) so our human doctors can focus purely on high-leverage decisions. This allows us to offer 24/7 physician care for a fraction of the cost of traditional care.

The Team:
 - Meer Patel (CEO): JHU BME. Deferred Brown Medical School to build Prana because code scales better than appointments.
- Vishvam Rawal (CTO): Ex-Quant. Building high-frequency data infrastructure for health signals.
- Sanjit Menon (CHO): Graduating MD Candidate. Deep clinical expertise to ensure our models practice good medicine.

Traction: Live in beta with early users.
