prox.name: Prox
prox.one_liner: AI technical support for complex physical products
prox.description:
AI technical support for complex physical products

Every product ever sold needs support at some point. That support falls into one of two buckets.

Bucket 1: Simple stuff. T-shirts, screen protectors, keyboards. You buy it, it shows up, maybe you ask “where's my order?” once. This is solved. Zendesk and a hundred other horizontal companies solved it.

Bucket 2: Hard stuff. $20,000 industrial heaters. HVAC systems. CNC machines. Car parts. Products where buying wrong means your building doesn't have heat or your manufacturing line is down. Support for these products can only be performed by highly trained domain specialists and there aren't enough of them.

If you're selling EV charging stations, your support person needs to be a certified electrician who understands local power grids, installation codes, and compatibility matrices. You can't hire this off the street. You can't outsource it overseas.

You'd think LLMs would have solved this by now. They haven't. Three years into the LLM era, penetration in this industry is very low & the reason is twofold.

First, off-the-shelf models don't actually understand these products. The knowledge lives in 48-page technical manuals buried on some manufacturer's website in terrible formatting — wiring schematics, compatibility matrices, installation diagrams that can only make sense visually. A general-purpose LLM can't draw you the diagram showing how to connect terminal A to terminal B. It doesn't have the spatial understanding or the product-specific reasoning to be a real technical advisor. So companies still rely entirely on human experts.

Second, even if the models were good enough, there are no harnesses to make them useful in the business.

No engine to capture deep technical knowledge about complex physical products and keep it updated. No way for a company to offload tribal knowledge from their senior technicians into a system. No way to see what questions customers are actually asking and feed that…
prox.industry_sub_vertical: Technical support agent platform for complex physical product manufacturers
prox.what_they_sell: End-user-facing SaaS platform that deploys multimodal AI agents to automate technical support for complex physical products. Agents ingest technical manuals, schematics, CAD models, and field videos; answer customer questions via voice/chat; generate visual diagrams and wiring instructions; and learn from support interactions to continuously improve the knowledge base.
prox.ai_play: AI replaces highly trained domain specialists (electricians, HVAC technicians, field engineers) by building deep product-specific knowledge graphs from unstructured technical documentation and multimodal inputs. Agents provide real-time troubleshooting, visual guidance, and voice support at scale, reducing dependency on scarce expert labor.

rebulk.one_liner: Accurately measure and monitor bulk inventory
rebulk.description:
Accurately measure and monitor bulk inventory

Rebulk accurately measures and monitors bulk inventory like piles of feed, sand, and other assets that do not fit into boxes and barcodes using cameras, LiDAR, and computer vision.

Most bulk inventory is still managed with rough estimates, manual checks, delayed updates, and too much guesswork. Because it lives in piles, bays, yards, and truck beds instead of boxes with barcodes, it is much harder to track accurately. When teams do not know what is actually on site, it leads to shrink, stockouts, bad planning, and unnecessary fire drills.

We’ve lived this problem, and we know how to solve it. Warren saw it firsthand as a Product Manager at Milk Moovement, a $20M Series A AgTech startup, working closely with feed suppliers and farm managers. Cole was engineer #3 at Tropic, scaling it from seed to Series B, and later led engineering at an AI startup.

We’ve built an integrated hardware and software platform and is working with one of the largest agricultural company in North America and Charm Industrial. As industries demand real-time visibility into the physical world, RebuIk is positioned to become the operating system for bulk assets from inventory tracking to procurement and logistics.

Customers configure rather than write code, so integrations are both much faster to launch and far more consistent across customers.

rejot.what_they_sell: Fragno: an open-source framework that converts complex API integrations into drop-in full-stack libraries. API providers package backend endpoints, data storage patterns, and frontend utilities into reusable building blocks that customers can configure rather than code.

replicas.name: Replicas

replicas.description:
Run any coding agent harness in the cloud

Replicas is a background coding agent that allows you to delegate tasks to Claude Code or Codex from Slack, Linear, GitHub, and more. Each task works inside of a sandboxed virtual machine, allowing teams to heavily parallelize work and burn through tickets.

Replicas agents output higher quality PRs via feedback loops - each task automatically is notified and fixes CI failures and reads all code reviews. With Environments, engineering teams can configure agents to run their entire codebase locally, verify its work, and provide preview URLs.

ressl-ai.name: Ressl AI
ressl-ai.description:
AI Workers for Field Services

We automate the back office so field crews can focus on the actual work.

Trades businesses (HVAC, plumbing, electrical, collision repair, roofing) run on legacy software and "glue" employees: people whose entire job is clicking through systems, copy-pasting between tools, and managing inbound volume across channels. A collision shop has one person generating estimates in CCCOne, another chasing parts vendors, another answering calls and Yelp messages, another doing invoices in QuickBooks. None of that requires a human.

We build proactive background agents that run these operations autonomously -- quoting, estimating, procurement, insurance coordination, scheduling, follow-ups -- on top of the software these businesses already own. 

We started as an AI consulting firm talking to businesses across every industry. After a month, the pattern was obvious - trades and field services had the most "glue work" and the least tech sophistication to solve it themselves. Every shop we walked into had 2–4 people doing work that software should be delivering as an outcome, not just enabling.

Our GTM is direct to operators and through PE-backed roll-ups, who are actively looking for margin improvements across their portfolio companies. If this is of interest, please reach out arushi@ressl.ai
ressl-ai.industry_sub_vertical: Field service back-office automation for trades (HVAC, plumbing, electrical, collision repair, roofing) — quoting, estimating, procurement, insurance coordination, scheduling

ressl-ai.ai_play: Replaces 2-4 'glue work' employees per shop with proactive agents that orchestrate workflows across fragmented tools (CCCOne, QuickBooks, vendor systems, communication channels) autonomously

revise-robotics.one_liner: Automating refurbishment of $1T in consumer electronics
revise-robotics.description:
Automating refurbishment of $1T in consumer electronics

E-waste recycling facilities spend most of their time and effort sifting through discarded electronics, searching for valuable devices, refurbishing them, and reselling them in second-hand markets.

Our first product is an AI-enabled robotic system that integrates with these facilities to assess and refurbish hundreds of laptops a day without any human intervention. The system tests laptops, wipes their hard drives, photographs them, and posts them on online marketplaces for resale, regardless of model, manufacturer, or operating system.
revise-robotics.industry_sub_vertical: E-waste recycling and consumer electronics refurbishment automation
revise-robotics.what_they_sell: An AI-enabled robotic system deployed into e-waste recycling facilities that autonomously assesses, tests, refurbishes, and prepares consumer electronics (laptops, etc.) for resale. The system integrates vision, mechanical automation, and workflow orchestration to handle hundreds of units per day across heterogeneous device types without human intervention.
revise-robotics.ai_play: AI vision and control layer enables the robotic system to: (1) identify and classify devices by model/condition via computer vision; (2) autonomously execute multi-step refurbishment workflows (testing, data wiping, photography, listing); (3) adapt to device variability without manual reconfiguration. AI transforms manual, labor-intensive refurbishment into autonomous, scalable hardware-software system. The physical robot is the delivery mechanism; AI is the intelligence that makes it work across device diversity.

rex-inc.name: Rex
rex-inc.one_liner: AI Operations Partner for Enterprise Order to Cash
rex-inc.description:
AI Operations Partner for Enterprise Order to Cash

Rex is an AI-native service for order to cash. We replace people-heavy operations with AI agents that continuously manage invoices, customers and exceptions.

Order to cash is a $60B outsourced function because the work is too messy for traditional automation. Every customer has different context, exceptions do not follow clean rules, and the next step is often buried in emails, portals, handoffs, or someone’s memory. Rex agents run continuously in the background and resolve work to SLA standards so cash keeps moving. We're live with pre-IPO tech companies, managing  >$500m in receivables from F100 companies, cutting manual follow-up cycles from weeks to hours.

We founded Rex after spending four years building Sequence, an a16z-backed finance ops platform, from zero to Series A — where we saw firsthand that at-scale, O2C still runs on manual labour.

Rex is the #1 winner of the Vercel AI Accelerator out of 2,500 teams, selected by Guillermo Rauch and leaders from OpenAI, Anthropic, Browserbase and more.
rex-inc.industry_sub_vertical: Enterprise order-to-cash operations automation via AI agents
rex-inc.phenotype_primary_label: Vertical AI workflow agent (AI department for X)
rex-inc.what_they_sell: AI-native managed service: continuous AI agents that automate order-to-cash operations (invoicing, customer management, exception resolution) on behalf of enterprise customers, managing SLA-based outcomes
rex-inc.ai_play: Vertical workflow automation via AI agents that handle messy, context-dependent, exception-heavy processes that traditional RPA cannot address. Agents run continuously in background, learning customer context and resolving work to SLA standards.

rhizome-ai.name: Rhizome AI
rhizome-ai.description:
Agent Platform for Life Sciences

It takes 500,000 days of office work to bring a drug to market. We want to make it 5. To get there, we need agents doing most of the work. 

Today, our research agent is the best way to know what the FDA thinks. Users ask a question and get an answer backed by up to 1,000 documents, where each statement has a citation. 

It’s the best because we have the best retrieval engine. We’ve tuned it on our life science-specific dataset, and we find what others miss.

As more teams use Rhizome, we gain more data on what regulatory professionals actually need, which makes retrieval even better. This flywheel is how we become the retrieval engine that powers all human and agent work in life sciences.

Chetan started his career as a research engineer, but quickly realized he enjoyed building more than research. He joined EvolutionaryScale as their sole founding product engineer, launching their developer-scientist platform and scaling to tens of thousands of users and billions of API calls. He was also #16 at Instabase helping banks with document processing, closing $7m as the technical closer.

Agents can do magical things today, but most in life sciences only use them to edit emails. Agents are missing the context they need to 100x the number of drugs we can bring to market. Rhizome AI is focused on that critical problem.

rhizome-ai.phenotype_primary_label: Vertical AI workflow agent (AI department for X)
rhizome-ai.what_they_sell: Agent platform that automates regulatory intelligence work for biopharma teams—users ask questions about FDA requirements and get citation-backed answers synthesized from regulatory documents
rhizome-ai.ai_play: Domain-tuned retrieval engine for life sciences regulatory documents that powers both human research and agent workflows, with a data flywheel from regulatory professional usage

rimba.name: Rimba
rimba.one_liner: Streamlining Data Capture to Report Creation for Heavy Industries
rimba.description:
Streamlining Data Capture to Report Creation for Heavy Industries

Rimba integrates fragmented data — PDFs, Excel files, time-series, IoT sensors, equipment telemetry, and system performance data — to complete a workflow, such as populating a database, running analytics, and creating a report. 

Our software streamlines the entire journey from data capture to report creation for the physical world, starting with heavy industries such as renewables, oil & gas, supply chain, and chemicals. 

Legacy systems don't communicate, and critical operational data remains siloed. Rimba bridges that gap by connecting data from fragmented systems and structures — ERPs, SCADA, SharePoint, email, and more — to automate workflows, classify inputs, transform data, and improve data monitoring.
rimba.industry_sub_vertical: Heavy industrial operational data integration for asset maintenance and compliance reporting (renewables, oil & gas, chemicals)
rimba.vertical_label: Power plant & transmission asset maintenance scheduling

rimba.ai_play: AI agents parse unstructured documents (PDFs, emails), classify and extract structured data from heterogeneous sources, transform and enrich telemetry streams, and orchestrate multi-step workflows (capture → classify → transform → report). Reduces manual data wrangling and enables autonomous report generation.

risely-ai.name: Risely AI
risely-ai.one_liner: AI agents that automate administrative work across college campuses.
risely-ai.description:
AI agents that automate administrative work across college campuses.

Risely’s AI agents will form the new operating system for universities, improving retention, staff productivity, and efficiency. Our platform integrates directly into existing university systems (SIS, LMS, CRM), learns each institution’s unique workflows, and deploys specialized AI agents. This dramatically reduces the $735 billion universities spend annually on administrative labor, expands staff capacity without increasing headcount, and improves the student experience.

This hasn't been done before because university workflows require nuanced, autonomous judgment, exactly what agentic AI was designed to solve. Our team uniquely combines deep expertise in higher education, enterprise-scale AI, and regulated enterprise sales.

Sadia previously built Salesforce’s Education Cloud from scratch, creating the core Student Information System widely used across higher education. She deeply understands university operations and maintains trusted relationships with hundreds of higher-ed CIOs and Provosts.

Danial was one of DoorDash’s earliest engineers, where he architected and scaled complex systems from zero to billions of transactions, including their search, recommendation, and Voice AI platforms. He knows how to build robust AI solutions that reliably perform at enterprise scale. 

Shahryar was a GM at Airwallex, where he built the entire Americas business from 0 to 1 and drove 11x revenue growth.  He’s also a master closer, single-handedly securing over $17M in enterprise deals at NerdWallet.  He’s a relentless startup executor with deep expertise launching and scaling go-to-market machines in highly regulated industries.

We launched six weeks ago and are already at $8k MRR, growing 55% week-over-week -- one of the fastest ramps ever in higher ed. Universities urgently need solutions that expand labor capacity and efficiency, especially as they face unprecedented budget pressure and staf…
risely-ai.industry_sub_vertical: Higher education administrative workflow automation for student services, enrollment, and compliance
risely-ai.what_they_sell: End-user-facing SaaS platform deploying autonomous AI agents to automate administrative workflows across college campuses (student services, enrollment, advising, compliance, staff operations). Agents integrate with university SIS, LMS, and CRM systems, learn institution-specific processes, and execute tasks autonomously.
risely-ai.ai_play: AI agents replace manual administrative labor by autonomously handling student inquiries, enrollment workflows, advising coordination, compliance documentation, and staff task routing. Agents learn each university's unique processes and integrate deeply with legacy enterprise systems (Salesforce, Banner, Workday) to execute end-to-end workflows without human intervention.

ritivel.name: Ritivel
ritivel.description:
AI-native platform for Life-Sciences Documentation

Ritivel is an AI-native workspace for regulatory and medical writing teams at life sciences companies. Our AI agents draft CTDs, CSRs, INDs, and BLAs in minutes instead of weeks, helping drugs reach patients faster.

Every month a drug is delayed from reaching the market costs pharma companies ~$45M in lost revenue and more importantly, delays treatment for thousands of patients who need it. Yet regulatory teams are stuck in a painful, months-long process: synthesizing thousands of pages of clinical data, hunting through SharePoint folders for the right documents, chasing colleagues for missing inputs, and manually drafting submissions.

Ritivel deploys AI agents that transform how regulatory teams work. Our agents generate comprehensive first drafts directly in Microsoft Word, following FDA formatting requirements and pulling from your existing clinical data and prior submissions. Every data point includes citations linked back to the original source, so reviewers can verify with one click. Connected to SharePoint and Veeva, our agents automatically source the right documents. Integrated with Outlook, they handle reminder emails and follow-ups automatically.

We're engineers who previously built AI copilots at Microsoft Research. After 50+ conversations with pharma professionals, we discovered the critical bottleneck in regulatory submissions and built Ritivel to solve it.
ritivel.phenotype_primary_label: Vertical AI workflow agent (AI department for X)
ritivel.what_they_sell: Vertical SaaS platform: AI-native workspace for regulatory and medical writing teams that deploys agents to generate first-draft regulatory submissions (CTDs, CSRs, INDs, BLAs) directly in Microsoft Word with full source citations and integrated document retrieval
ritivel.ai_play: Vertical workflow automation: AI agents replace months-long manual regulatory submission process by automating data synthesis, document sourcing, and first-draft generation while maintaining FDA compliance and auditability

We blend AI agents with experienced human operators to find what traditional vulnerability scanners miss and break through organizational cyber defenses with swarms of AI agents.

Agents learn organizational defenses and adapt tactics in real-time. Humans supervise and validate findings. Scales pentesting from manual labor to agentic automation.

rivet-design.one_liner: Visual editor to design in production code
rivet-design.description:
Visual editor to design in production code

Rivet is a visual AI editor for product designers to make UI changes.  Designers ship the changes they make directly to their codebase. 

The most painful problem for designers today is that their vision doesn't match code.  Rivet replaces slow collaboration between designers and engineers by letting designers just do it themselves. Rivet's editor helps turn product designers into design engineers.
 
Design-led companies in YC are Rivet customers.

Learn more at rivet.design

rivet-design.ai_play: AI bridges the designer-engineer gap by automating the translation from visual design decisions to executable code. Removes the collaboration bottleneck and lets designers act as design engineers, compressing iteration cycles and reducing rework.

riviera.name: Riviera
riviera.description:
AI Employees for Hotels

Riviera builds AI Employees for Hotels. Our first agent is a hotel phone receptionist that lets hotels spend less time answering phone calls and more time helping customers. Our system handles front-desk inquiries, in-room dining orders, and reservations. It answers every question instantly and in any language, 24/7.

We are solving a problem that older phone systems and IVRs can't: customers hate not being able to talk to someone immediately, but most travel businesses can’t dedicate additional staff to manage phone lines. Voice AI has always seemed out of reach because the technology infrastructure in the travel industry is often fragmented, with reservation systems, loyalty programs, and in-house operations software that weren’t designed with voice AI in mind. Riviera addresses this by integrating seamlessly with existing software providers and using human-sounding voice models that are highly trained on data specific to each business type and department.

Hotels spend hundreds of billions annually on staffing and risk losing potential revenue when phone lines are overwhelmed or callers hang up. By enabling them to handle unlimited calls, day or night, Riviera unlocks additional revenue and eases labor challenges.
riviera.industry_sub_vertical: Hotel guest services contact center automation
riviera.what_they_sell: AI voice receptionist agents deployed as SaaS for hotels. Agents handle inbound phone calls, guest inquiries, in-room dining orders, and reservations 24/7 in multiple languages. Integrates with existing hotel PMS, loyalty, and operations systems.
riviera.ai_play: Replaces human front-desk phone staff with autonomous voice agents trained on hotel-specific workflows and data. AI learns guest context from integrated systems (reservations, loyalty, room status) to answer questions instantly and route complex issues. Solves the 'fragmented tech stack' problem in hospitality by acting as a unified voice interface across legacy systems.

roark.name: Roark
roark.one_liner: Test, monitor, and improve your voice agents
roark.description:
Test, monitor, and improve your voice agents

Roark helps teams test, monitor, and improve their voice agents.

Voice AI is exploding, but reliability is still the #1 challenge. Teams spend hours manually testing agents and still miss failures. In the last 6 months, Roark has processed over 10M minutes of calls, powering monitoring and simulation for teams across the Voice AI ecosystem (including YC companies).

We close that gap by combining:

 📊 Monitoring & Evaluation - 40+ built-in metrics (latency, instruction-follow, sentiment, etc.), custom dashboards, alerts, and the ability to define your own. Up to 15 speakers with automatic speaker identification.
 🎭 Simulations & Personas - end-to-end phone/WebSocket simulations for inbound and outbound agents, with configurable personas (accents, languages, speech & behavior profiles). Define tests as conversations with a graph-based approach, so you can easily branch into edge cases and variants.
 🔁 Full lifecycle loop - failed calls automatically become repeatable tests, so every failure makes your agent stronger.

Roark is the missing QA layer for Voice AI - helping teams ship agents they can trust.
roark.industry_sub_vertical: Voice agent testing, monitoring, and evaluation platform
roark.what_they_sell: SaaS platform for testing, monitoring, and evaluating voice AI agents. Provides 40+ built-in metrics (latency, instruction-follow, sentiment), custom dashboards, alerts, end-to-end phone/WebSocket simulations with configurable personas, and automated test generation from failed calls.
roark.ai_play: AI agents (especially voice agents) are unreliable in production. Roark uses AI-driven simulation (synthetic personas, speech profiles) and automated evaluation metrics to catch failures before deployment and convert production failures into repeatable test cases. The platform itself uses AI to generate test scenarios and analyze agent behavior at scale.

robby.name: Robby
robby.one_liner: AI agents that grow revenue for home services businesses
robby.description:
AI agents that grow revenue for home services businesses

Robby is an AI growth engine for home services businesses that uncovers revenue opportunities and collects additional data from every technician visit. Our AI combines customer and third party data to generate dozens of new leads every day, and then arms the technicians with talking points to increase close rates, giving GMs a single command center to manage and drive revenue. We have several paying customers that are each uncovering 6 figures in additional revenue opportunities every week. On our first day of launch, we helped close $40k in new business within an hour.

Our team has spent the last few months riding along with dozens of technicians and shadowing every position in the office to best understand the industry. We're also studying for the EPA 608 exam to become certified technicians ourselves.

Vineet and Feroze have both built critical products and infra at prominent startups (Ironclad, Porter, Affinity, Uber, Cloud Health Systems). Joe previously consulted PE firms on software acquisitions and led home services growth projects at Bain. We all met at Harvard Business School, and dropped out to work on Robby full-time.

rocketable.name: Rocketable
rocketable.one_liner: The AI Maximalist Software Holding Company
rocketable.description:
The AI Maximalist Software Holding Company

Rocketable is building a large portfolio of wildly profitable software businesses by acquiring existing products and replacing human teams with AI agents.

Today’s foundation models already possess enough intelligence to automate most of the tasks required to run a profitable software business. In the functions where agents aren’t yet intelligent enough to replace humans, they will be soon.

When every human function required to operate a software product has an AI agent equivalent, the next step will be within reach: operating an entire company with a team of AI agents instead of humans.

But superintelligent agents within each function won’t be enough. To operate a software company with 0 human employees, the agents will need to be directed towards common goals, integrated to collaborate across functions, tuned with feedback loops connected to product metrics, and trained to make resource allocation decisions.

We are creating the tools needed to replace the entire org chart of a software company with a team of AI agents. We are developing these tools by owning the products that we automate, because we know from 10+ years of experience building automated systems with AI/ML that integration is the key to unlocking superhuman performance.
rocketable.industry_sub_vertical: AI agent orchestration for cross-functional SaaS operations automation
rocketable.what_they_sell: Acquires and operates existing SaaS products by replacing human teams with coordinated AI agents across all business functions (engineering, ops, sales, support, finance). Monetizes via the acquired product's existing revenue streams (SaaS subscriptions, usage fees) while dramatically reducing COGS through agent-driven automation.
rocketable.ai_play: AI agents replace human employees across entire org chart (product, engineering, customer success, finance, operations). Core innovation: multi-agent orchestration framework that coordinates agents across functions, aligns them to shared business metrics, and enables autonomous resource allocation and decision-making. Agents learn from product telemetry and feedback loops to improve performance over time.

Rote's agents recover denied revenue by taking shop estimates and referencing technical repair data to autonomously file and defend shop claims.

Our AI agents analyze clinical data to identify care needs. We treat common conditions through our integrated virtual clinic. For more complex care, our agents find the best in-network providers using millions of price and quality data points, and handle end-to-end appointment booking.

AI replaces manual care coordination and provider search, reducing friction and cost while improving outcomes.

AI FDE Engine that runs your engineering workflows

It replaces internal forms, manual Slack triage, and scattered docs with an AI front desk that understands requests, assigns owners, updates context, and posts status changes directly into Slack. Rovr’s built-in ops CRM gives teams a single system of record for eng requests — from tooling access to platform incidents to dev-infra workflows — reducing operational drag across the entire org.

Replaces manual forms, Slack triage, and scattered documentation with a single ops CRM system of record for engineering requests (tooling access, incidents, dev-infra workflows).

Reduces operational drag by eliminating manual handoffs and creating a unified request-tracking system that learns team workflows and routing patterns.

rowflow.name: RowFlow
rowflow.description:
Replacing forms with AI conversations

RowFlow replaces clunky web forms with natural conversations that run over text, slack, or wherever your users are. Our platform increases your form’s response rates while cutting your internal overhead in half. 

With RowFlow, you can take any existing form and instantly convert it into an AI-powered conversation. New flows launch in minutes and reach respondents over your preferred channel or embedded chat. We guide the exchange, follow up automatically, and return clean structured data without extra work from your team.

Forms power billions of business interactions yearly. Whether it’s forms for client intake, registrations, compliance, feedback, or surveys, they all follow the same painful pattern: low conversion, messy data, and frustrated users. Teams have long tolerated forms only because there's been no scalable alternative for collecting structured information from people - until now. Our goal is for RowFlow to become the new default way for how organizations collect user data in an AI-first world.
rowflow.industry_sub_vertical: Enterprise form-to-conversation workflow automation for intake, compliance, and data collection
rowflow.what_they_sell: SaaS platform that converts traditional web forms into AI-powered conversational agents deployable across chat, Slack, embedded widgets, and other channels. Agents guide users through data collection workflows, handle follow-ups, and return clean structured data.
rowflow.ai_play: AI agents replace rigid form UX with natural conversation, dramatically improving completion rates and data quality while reducing manual data cleaning and follow-up overhead. Agents learn form logic, adapt to user responses, and extract structured outputs autonomously.

Reasoning and verification infra for AI

AI Takeoffs for Concrete

ruma-care.name: Ruma Care
ruma-care.one_liner: The operations stack for biologic infusion clinics
ruma-care.description:
The operations stack for biologic infusion clinics

Ruma Care automates all admin work for infusion clinics - starting with prior authorizations & copay assistance enrollment.

Biologics are expensive medications that cost $80-$150K+ per year per patient, and often need to be administered in specific settings called infusion clinics. Medical providers buy these drugs up front to secure pricing deals and safer inventory - they are reimbursed for the cost of the medications through the patients’ insurance. 

Current medical workflows aren't built for infusion clinics. Inventory, storage, transport, and billing is still managed through paper and excel spreadsheets. And because they’re so expensive, these specialty medications are denied by insurers at a rate of 37% each year. When they are denied, when workflows fail, or patients are infused before paperwork is cleared, providers don’t get reimbursed for the medication and are left covering the costs. Ruma Care solves this so clinics get paid, patients get treated faster, and care teams spend less time fighting forms. 

We do this in three ways: 
1. For each medication, diagnosis, and insurance combination, Ruma extracts the submission criteria required to get the drug approved by insurers. 
2. We pull out the correct forms, then automate the form-filling for prior authorizations. 
3. Lastly, we enroll patients in copay assistance programs, all in one workflow and platform. 

We turn a process that traditionally spans 70+ online portals, disparate paper forms, and manual phone calling into a single, streamlined platform. As we process prior authorizations, our models learn from denial patterns to understand exactly what insurers need to see to get a prior authorization approved.
ruma-care.industry_sub_vertical: Biologic infusion clinic prior authorization & copay assistance automation
ruma-care.phenotype_primary_label: Vertical AI workflow agent (AI department for X)
ruma-care.what_they_sell: Operations platform for biologic infusion clinics that automates prior authorizations, copay assistance enrollment, inventory management, and billing workflows
ruma-care.ai_play: AI-powered form extraction, automated prior authorization submission, and denial pattern learning to maximize reimbursement approval rates for high-cost specialty medications

The default way of running on-device AI at Scale

RunAnywhere turns that into an enterprise-ready workflow: one SDK to run models on-device, plus a control plane to manage models, enforce policies, and measure outcomes across thousands of devices.
runanywhere.industry_sub_vertical: Edge AI runtime & on-device model orchestration platform
runanywhere.what_they_sell: SDK for on-device model execution + control plane for model management, policy enforcement, and observability across heterogeneous edge devices
runanywhere.ai_play: Infrastructure layer that makes edge AI deployment enterprise-ready by solving device fragmentation, runtime variability, and operational complexity at scale

runharbor.name: Harbor
runharbor.one_liner: AI-native CRO for clinical trial operations
runharbor.description:
AI-native CRO for clinical trial operations

Harbor is building an AI-native contract research organization (CRO) for clinical trials. We started with an AI-native system of record for clinical trial data (electronic data capture system), grew the software business to seven trials and ~$187k in contracted software revenue over the next twelve months, then expanded into full-service trial execution and signed our first CRO contract worth $1.93M over three years.

Clinical trials consume 45% of all new drug and device development spend. While some of that goes to software, sites, and patients, the largest line items are services: project management, monitoring, data management, site coordination, source verification, query resolution, record reconciliation, and analysis.

Today, drug and device companies outsource clinical operations to legacy CROs and their massive teams, which is why the CRO market is $82B annually. Harbor delivers the regulated services companies buy from legacy CROs, but built around our AI-native system of record from day one. Our software already automates the core data workflows: study build, data capture, query generation, monitoring, signing, and database lock. Because we own the system of record, we can expand into the surrounding service workflows: site contracting and billing, subject engagement and retention, statistics, reporting, and more.

We built Harbor because we lived through the problem. Albert spent four years in clinical trials and regulatory strategy at a medical device startup, taking an unproven wearable from first-in-human trials to FDA authorization. Nate brings the technical depth, having built scalable software at Google and Ramp and served as employee #1 at a previous YC startup.
runharbor.industry_sub_vertical: AI-native CRO services for clinical trial operations and drug/device development
runharbor.what_they_sell: Full-service clinical trial execution (CRO contracts) + AI-native system of record software; revenue from outcome-based contracts ($1.93M/3yr) and software licensing (~$187k ARR)
runharbor.ai_play: AI-native system of record automates regulated clinical trial workflows (EDC, query generation, monitoring, database lock); enables Harbor to deliver CRO services at scale with fewer human resources while maintaining regulatory compliance

runrl.name: RunRL

Reinforcement learning as a service

RunRL improves LLMs and AI agents with reinforcement learning. Do you have a model that needs to get better at a certain task? Are you tired of messing around with prompts? Do you spend a lot of money on observability, and wish that all this data could let your model self-improve? Well, head on over to RunRL.com, and see what we have to offer! If you give us a model, a prompt, and a reward, we’ll make your model’s reward go up.

runrl.ai_play: Converts observability data and reward signals into automated model improvement loops. Uses RL to optimize model behavior end-to-end, eliminating manual prompt iteration and enabling models to self-improve from production feedback.

We're live with fast-growing YC scaleups empowering their Engineers, PMs, designers, marketers, and ops to contribute to their codebase or build prod-grade zero-to-one apps.

s2-dev.name: s2.dev
s2-dev.one_liner: API for unlimited, durable, real-time streams
s2-dev.description:
API for unlimited, durable, real-time streams

S2 is an API for durable streams. We make working with streaming data dead simple and reliable.

The more we worked on data systems, the more we felt like there was a missing building block. The seamless experience of object storage simply did not exist for durable streams – so we set out to fix that!

S2 reimagines streams as an unlimited and access-controlled web resource. Like if Kafka and S3 had a baby.

- Building agents? Use granular streams to persist context in real time, make workflows auditable, and coordinate between agents.

- Publishing fast-moving data? Streams support high fanout and can be accessed directly over the internet, so they are a great fit for broadcasting real-time feeds.

- Sandboxing? Emit to per-instance streams, and read history or live events just as easily.

- Local-first and multiplayer experiences? Propagate updates reliably and efficiently.

Stop dealing with clusters, and start streaming.
s2-dev.industry_sub_vertical: Durable stream infrastructure for agent context persistence and coordination
s2-dev.what_they_sell: API for durable, unlimited, real-time streams with granular access control. Positioned as a foundational building block for agents, real-time data systems, and multiplayer experiences. Combines the simplicity of object storage (S3) with the durability and streaming semantics of Kafka.
s2-dev.ai_play: Enables agents to persist context, coordinate between multiple agents, maintain auditable workflow histories, and sandbox per-instance state in real time. Solves the 'context explosion' problem by providing a reliable, web-accessible stream abstraction that agents can read/write without managing infrastructure.

saffron.name: Saffron

Helping your company find 10x engineers.

Saffron allows companies to quickly evaluate how well software engineers use AI to code. 

The way engineers write code has fundamentally changed, but the way companies evaluate them hasn't. Saffron gives teams full visibility into how candidates use AI agents to build, debug, and ship real features on an actual codebase. 

Saffron was founded by Robert Chondro (formerly MIT and Jane Street), Jerry Yao (Stanford and Jane Street), and Kazuma Choji (Harvey Mudd, published in NeurIPS and ICML), and is backed by Y Combinator (P26) and Afore Capital.

salesgraph.name: Salesgraph
salesgraph.one_liner: the context layer for fast moving sales teams
salesgraph.description:
the context layer for fast moving sales teams

Salesgraph equips reps with the most relevant context throughout the deal stage, providing proactive pre-call notes and post-call next steps. Sellers are CEOs of their deals; they need to know who the buyer is, what triggered them to take the first call, what their pain points are, how much value this new tool is bringing, are there any technical blockers, etc. 

A sale is only good when it doesn't feel like a sale to your customer, but rather the sales rep solved a problem for the customer. This was the problem Ricardo and I solved at Mintlify. We created a business case generator that took in call recordings, background news triggers and job updates, Mintlify's ROI and Pricing calculator, past deals won, and customer case studies --> produced a 3 page document expressing the value Mintlify provided + why the quote presented is justifiable. In doing so we closed more enterprise deals at a higher ACV as our champion was able to build a better purchasing case internally. 

Our goal is to empower every sales team to close deals at a higher ACV, while making sure reps learn from their mistakes and create a smooth sales experience for their end customer.

salespatriot.description:
AI powered operating system for distributors and OEMs

SalesPatriot is a back-office operating system for distributors and OEMS. We build custom AI workflows for sales and supply chain teams to manage procurement, requests for quote and purchase orders.

In large orgs that operate as key nodes of the supply chain data is scattered across twelve systems. Quotes get lost and Executives lack visibility. Supply chain workflows are time consuming because data isn't where it needs to be in the format it needs to be.

Employees are stuck between their email, ERP, CRM, marketplaces, and spreadsheets instead of winning business and protecting margin.

Instead of employees manually hunting across 12+ systems, agents crawl, extract, and structure scattered data (quotes, POs, supplier info) into actionable context, then autonomously execute workflows (RFQ routing, PO creation, margin protection). Reduces manual data entry and decision latency.

salus.name: Salus
salus.one_liner: Guardrails to validate your agent's actions before they execute
salus.description:
Guardrails to validate your agent's actions before they execute

Your agent processed a refund without looking up the order ID, costing you thousands. You only found out three hours later from a support ticket. Evals, output scoring, and observability can reduce the likelihood of mistakes like these occurring - but there's no solution that inspects and prevents an action as it’s about to execute. Salus does that.

We’ve built an API that wraps around your agent and checks its actions at run time, blocking incorrect ones and providing immediate feedback to guide retries. Kevin and Vedant were roommates at Stanford, where they both studied computer science.
salus.industry_sub_vertical: Agent action validation, safety guardrails, and runtime execution blocking
salus.what_they_sell: API infrastructure that validates and blocks agent actions at runtime before execution
salus.ai_play: Runtime safety layer that inspects agent actions pre-execution and prevents errors through validation and blocking

AI replaces manual document review and synthesis, reducing legal team time-to-insight and enabling faster deal closure.

samora-ai.name: Samora AI
samora-ai.one_liner: Multilingual voice agents that outperform humans
samora-ai.description:
Multilingual voice agents that outperform humans

Samora runs multilingual voice operations for organizations with high-volume calling without requiring engineering teams, call centers, or AI expertise.

Many important tasks still depend on phone calls, including customer support, outreach, follow-ups, screening, and intake. But voice AI often fails in production because real callers interrupt, go off-script, switch languages mid-sentence, and speak in local dialects. Teams also worry about safety and compliance, especially when an agent can accidentally make the wrong promise.

Samora solves this with voice agents that sound local and follow strict rules. Samora agents handle inbound and outbound calls, collect information, and update internal systems like CRMs, ticketing tools, and ATS platforms. When a call becomes sensitive or uncertain, the agent hands off to a human. It can also follow up over WhatsApp, SMS, or email when needed.

With Samora, teams get:
1. Voice agents that work in real conversations, including dialects and code-switching
2. Strict safety controls so agents don’t make unauthorized offers, discounts, or promises
3. Calls that result in completed actions, system updates, and safe human handoff
samora-ai.industry_sub_vertical: Contact center automation & high-volume calling operations (customer support, recruiting, intake, outreach)
samora-ai.what_they_sell: Managed voice operations service — Samora runs the entire calling workflow (customer support, recruiting, intake, outreach) using AI agents that sound local, follow compliance rules, and update internal systems
samora-ai.ai_play: AI replaces contact center labor — voice agents handle high-volume calls in multiple languages/dialects, execute actions in CRM/ticketing/ATS, and hand off to humans when needed

saudara-ai.description:
AI Native Sourcing Broker For Overseas Manufacturing

Every deal runs through a real human broker, supercharged by AI that handles sourcing, quoting, QC, and logistics. 10x faster, at a fraction of the cost.

scalar-field.name: Scalar Field
scalar-field.one_liner: Your Agentic Trading Desk — Building the next era of agentic…
scalar-field.description:
Your Agentic Trading Desk — Building the next era of agentic…

We’re building the agentic trading desk for the new operating system of markets.

I used to be a trader at Tower Research and Goldman Sachs, and I’m building Scalar Field with my co-founder Ramakant, who led engineering teams at Microsoft.

We’ve both spent our careers at the intersection of finance and technology, and we’re using that experience to rethink how markets are analyzed, tested, and traded in the age of agents.

Scalar Field is built around a simple belief: over the next few years, agents will not just help people research markets — they will actively participate in them.

They will monitor news, parse filings, track sentiment, test hypotheses, rebalance portfolios, and execute trades. They will turn ideas into strategies, and strategies into live portfolios.

But today’s financial infrastructure was not built for that world.

Terminals are dashboards. Backtesting tools are fragmented. Execution systems are separate. Market data is hard to unify. And most platforms still assume the human is the only decision-maker.

Scalar Field changes that.

We’re building an agentic trading platform where users can create financial agents that research data, backtest strategies, monitor market events, and trigger trades when specific conditions are met.

The long-term vision is agentic ETFs: portfolios created, managed, and rebalanced by agents around any idea, narrative, event, or market signal.

Scalar Field lets users go from thesis to backtest to live portfolio in one place.

It is infrastructure for the agentic trading era.
scalar-field.industry_sub_vertical: Agentic trading infrastructure for institutional portfolio automation
scalar-field.what_they_sell: An agentic trading platform where financial professionals (traders, PMs, hedge funds) deploy autonomous AI agents to research markets, backtest strategies, monitor events, and execute trades. Agents integrate with market data, news, filings, and execution systems to turn investment theses into live portfolios without manual intervention.
scalar-field.ai_play: AI agents replace manual trader workflows: research → hypothesis testing → backtesting → execution. Agents autonomously monitor news/filings, parse sentiment, test strategies in real-time, and trigger trades when conditions are met. Long-term vision is agentic ETFs managed entirely by agents. AI is the core execution engine, not just a copilot.

scheduling-wizard.name: Scheduling Wizard
scheduling-wizard.one_liner: Logistics infrastructure to modernize healthcare operations
scheduling-wizard.description:

scope.name: Scope

scope.description:
The infra layer for AI agent experience.

Scope is the system companies use to measure and improve how agents discover, interact and use their product.

sf-tensor.name: SF Tensor
sf-tensor.one_liner: Infrastructure for AI labs to focus on research.
sf-tensor.description:
Infrastructure for AI labs to focus on research.

AI researchers should be pushing the boundaries of what's possible with new architectures and training methods. Instead, they waste weeks configuring cloud infrastructure, debugging distributed systems, and optimizing their GPU code. We know because we lived it: While training our own models across thousands of GPUs earlier this year, we spent more time fighting our infrastructure than doing actual research.

That's why we're building two things. First, Elastic Cloud: a managed platform that automatically finds the cheapest GPUs across all providers, handles spot instance preemption, and cuts compute costs by up to 80%. Second, automatic kernel optimization that makes training code run faster by modeling hardware topology, often beating hand-tuned implementations.

The problem is that getting high performance across different hardware is genuinely hard. NVIDIA's CUDA moat exists because writing fast kernels requires deep expertise. Most teams either accept vendor lock-in or hire expensive kernel engineers. Our goal is to break the CUDA moat.

The compute bottleneck is the biggest constraint on AI progress. NVIDIA can't manufacture enough GPUs, and their monopoly keeps prices astronomical. Meanwhile, AMD, Google, and Amazon are shipping capable alternative hardware that nobody uses because the software is too hard. We're breaking that moat. If we succeed, anyone will be able to train state-of-the-art models without thinking past their PyTorch code.
sf-tensor.industry_sub_vertical: Multi-cloud GPU workload orchestration for AI model training
sf-tensor.what_they_sell: Managed GPU compute platform (Elastic Cloud) that abstracts multi-provider GPU sourcing with automatic spot-instance management and cost optimization; plus automatic kernel optimization layer that compiles training code to run faster across heterogeneous hardware (NVIDIA, AMD, Google TPUs) without manual tuning.
sf-tensor.ai_play: AI enables automatic hardware topology modeling and kernel code generation to optimize training performance across diverse accelerators, breaking NVIDIA's CUDA moat by making alternative hardware (AMD, TPU) viable without vendor lock-in or expensive kernel engineers.

socratix-ai.name: Socratix AI
socratix-ai.one_liner: AI coworkers for fraud and risk teams.
socratix-ai.description:
AI coworkers for fraud and risk teams.

Socratix builds AI coworkers for fraud and risk teams so that humans don't have to spend their days drowning in alerts and spreadsheets.

Today, fraud and risk teams at fintechs and banks are overwhelmed. Analysts jump between tools, manually stitch together context, and make judgment calls under pressure, often for hundreds of alerts a week. Too much of their work is slow, repetitive, and error-prone. We're here to change that. 

Socratix gives fraud and risk teams AI coworkers that investigate alerts in real time, replacing manual reviews with fast, explainable decisions. Socratix agents plug into existing workflows and reason across signals just like human analysts to help teams reduce fraud losses, minimize false positives, and scale operations without scaling headcount.

We've seen this problem firsthand. At DoorDash, Riya helped save $30M+ a year by building smarter fraud detection and investigation tooling, and at Unit21, she built products for analysts that made them 3X faster. We're able to build and sell enterprise-grade software. At Cruise, Satya built scalable AI systems powering petabyte-scale data, and at LinkedIn, he built enterprise products from 0 to 1 generating $50M+ in incremental revenue. Now, the two of us are teaming up to eliminate the manual toil in fraud and risk.

We're obsessed with fraud, LLMs, real-world automation, and the messy edge cases traditional ML has trouble handling. We believe that every fraud analyst should have an AI coworker - and the future of fraud will involve combining human-level reasoning with machine-speed execution.

Agents reason across multiple signals, synthesize context from disparate tools, and produce explainable decisions. Integrates into existing fraud/risk workflows at fintechs and banks.
socratix-ai.ai_play: AI agents act as 'coworkers' that eliminate manual alert triage and investigation toil. LLM-powered reasoning replaces repetitive spreadsheet work and context-stitching; agents handle edge cases and judgment calls that traditional ML struggles with. Explainability is critical for compliance and analyst trust.

Solidroad builds AI agents for CX teams, starting with training and QA. Solidroad agents train human reps in a simulated environment, and evaluate their performance in live customer channels.

By starting with training and QA, our agents learn how humans learn, and their performance can be compared directly with human reps. This enables us to prove the value of the rest of the agents on our roadmap.

Since launching last summer, we’ve reduced onboarding times by 50% at several of the world’s largest outsourced contact centres/BPOs like PartnerHero and Tech Mahindra, and improved go-live CSAT at Crypto.com by 3% (now above 90% CSAT).

sourcebot.name: Sourcebot
sourcebot.one_liner: Helping humans and AI agents understand massive codebases
sourcebot.description:
Helping humans and AI agents understand massive codebases

Sourcebot is an open source code understanding platform for massive codebases. We’re used by thousands of engineers in some of the largest companies in the world, including NVIDIA, Red Hat, Wikimedia, and Arista Networks.

Understanding code, not writing it, is the primary bottleneck for large engineering teams. For developers, this means onboarding onto complex codebases faster. For AI agents, it means getting the necessary code context to minimize hallucinations and maximize cohesion within the wider codebase.

Sourcebot solves this by giving developers and AI agents the ability to regex search across millions of lines of code instantly, as well as ask questions across thousands of repos using any flagship reasoning model. Being open source and on-prem, we can get deployed in enterprises within minutes before other tools even get approval.

We met a decade ago at McGill University and have been building together full time for over 2 years. We’ve personally felt the pain of understanding large codebases while working at Microsoft, EA, Ubisoft, Google, and Meta.

sourcebot.ai_play: Solves the 'code context explosion' problem: AI agents need rich codebase context to minimize hallucinations and maintain coherence, but raw code is too verbose for token budgets. Sourcebot compresses and structures code context into semantically dense, agent-consumable formats via search and retrieval-augmented generation.

Squid is AI powered grid planning in your browser. We have spent years inside National Grid, Octopus Energy, and AWS, building and learning what breaks. Now we are building what we wished existed.

standout.name: Standout
standout.one_liner: Talent and companies each get an agent that makes intros when it matters
standout.description:
Talent and companies each get an agent that makes intros when it matters

TL;DR: We're a talent agent connecting the world's best startup talent with the companies building what's next.

We don't sell software, we deliver introductions. Both sides get an autonomous agent that vets the other end and only makes the intro when the fit is real. Introductions in hours, not weeks. Free for talent, success-only for companies. One month in: 100 intros done.

Hiring is broken on both sides. We're rebuilding it around agents.



❌ The Problem

Hiring should match the right people to the right roles. It rarely does. Five failures repeat on every search, and almost no one escapes them.

* Spam — Talent fire hundreds of AI applications. Recruiters fire hundreds of AI messages. Both inboxes drown in noise.
* Visibility — Early stage founders struggle to reach the talent worth hiring. The best talent gets buried in the inbound. Both sides struggle to stand out.
* Asymmetry — Talent see titles and comp bands. Founders see resumes and LinkedIn. Neither side sees what actually matters.
* Privacy — Looking around means risking your current job. There's no way to say "I'm open" without saying "I'm leaving”
* Cost — Recruiters take 20–30% of first-year salary, after weeks of back-and-forth, and the role still goes to someone they didn't find.

✅ Our Solution

Standout is an agentic hiring marketplace. Talent and companies each get an autonomous agent that represents them, vets the other side, and only makes the intro when the fit is real.

* Spam, gone — No application
standout.industry_sub_vertical: Agentic talent marketplace for startup hiring

standout.ai_play: Autonomous agents on both sides eliminate spam, async vetting, and visibility asymmetry. Agents represent talent/company preferences, filter noise, and only surface high-fit intros. Solves the 'cold outreach at scale' problem by making agents do the vetting work instead of humans drowning in applications.

throxy.description:
Vertical AI agents that run the sales funnel on autopilot

throxy builds vertical AI agents that book meetings for software companies selling into traditional industries: manufacturing, logistics, education, and finance.

Outbound is broken. Generic automation gets ignored, and decision-makers in legacy sectors are hard to reach. Most of your TAM isn't even on LinkedIn, and tools like Clay, Apollo, and ZoomInfo only cover about 65% of the market. throxy fixes this by running bespoke, fully managed outbound systems for software sales teams trying to crack these industries. We use proprietary scraping tools to map your entire addressable market, then combine AI agents with human experts to deliver hyper-personalised email campaigns and human cold calling that is consistently generating six-figure qualified pipelines.

Since 2023, throxy has powered outbound for B2B software companies, from industrial SaaS to fintech providers, replacing the need for internal SDR teams or stacks of tools with a solution that outperforms on both speed and quality. Today, we have a team of 55 across London and Cape Town, booking on average 8 to 12 qualified meetings per month per client, with some clients seeing 20+ in their first weeks after we doubled down on human-led cold calling.

AI handles the data: building custom databases, scoring leads against your ICP, and personalising outreach at scale. Humans handle the conversations: real cold calls, real emails, real relationships. That's the difference between us and every AI SDR on the market.

Our founding team has built AI at JP Morgan, scaled businesses from age 14, and led enterprise sales from Seed to Series D. We're not just automating outbound, we're redefining what sales execution looks like for software companies selling into traditional industries.

throxy is the AI SDR purpose-built for the sectors software forgot.

throxy.what_they_sell: Fully managed outbound sales execution service: proprietary lead database mapping, AI-driven lead scoring and personalization, human cold calling and email campaigns. Sold on outcome basis (qualified meetings booked per month), not SaaS seats.
throxy.ai_play: AI handles data layer (database building, lead scoring, email personalization at scale); humans handle relationship layer (cold calls, relationship building). AI eliminates manual SDR data work and enables humans to focus on high-touch conversations. Replaces internal SDR teams and fragmented tool stacks (Clay, Apollo, ZoomInfo) with integrated managed service.

Today, most tickets are still sold manually: spreadsheets, guessing prices, and listing on one site at a time. The biggest brokers outsource pricing to teams in the Philippines… 

We built Ticket Wallet because we lived this. Truman has been flipping tickets for the last 5 years. Ryan built pricing software after seeing the mess first-hand. We’ve turned that pain into a product.

Since launch, we’ve onboarded $3M+ in ticket inventory, signed up 100+ paying sellers, and started working with pro teams. We charge 10% per ticket sold. This is our wedge into the $26B resale market.

Other platforms cost you money. We make you more of it.

tinfoil.name: Tinfoil
tinfoil.description:
Encrypted AI with verifiable privacy

Tinfoil makes it easy to make your AI workloads secure and provably private. You get the privacy of on-prem deployments, while running on the cloud. It's like end-to-end encrypted messaging but for your AI applications. 

We’ve built a full-stack platform on top of the latest NVIDIA GPUs offering confidential computing capabilities, meaning that you don’t have to trade off performance for privacy. We integrate a suite of recent advances in secure hardware technologies, in particular NVIDIA’s confidential compute mode available on Hopper and Blackwell. When combined with Tinfoil’s software stack, companies can prove their security claims like "we can't see and don’t log your queries.” Tinfoil guarantees that all data always stays private and cannot be accessed by anyone other than the end user -- not even by Tinfoil or the cloud provider it’s processed on. Everything can be made end-to-end encrypted and private with Tinfoil. 

The founding team combines deep academic and industry experience in security and Internet protocols. Tanya was previously a systems engineer at Cloudflare, where she built Internet security protocols used by billions, and contributed to the Workers AI platform. Jules and Sacha hold PhDs from MIT, where they worked on secure hardware, cryptography, and privacy technologies. Jules has also worked at NVIDIA on their confidential computing team. Tinfoil was born from our personal frustration with the false choice between access to powerful AI and the massive data privacy implications of deeply integrated AI.

AI is a universal tool that becomes part of our personal lives and business workflows. In the process, it needs access to all personal, private, and proprietary data. Right now, the only solutions are data processing agreements (i.e., "pinky promises"), band-aids like PII redaction that don't work in practice, or AI locally/on-prem, which doesn't scale. Tinfoil promises to unlock significantly deeper…
tinfoil.industry_sub_vertical: Encrypted AI inference on confidential computing GPUs for privacy-critical enterprise workloads
tinfoil.what_they_sell: Full-stack encrypted AI inference platform leveraging NVIDIA confidential computing (Hopper/Blackwell GPUs) to enable private, verifiable AI workloads. Offers: (1) consumer chatbot with end-to-end encrypted queries, (2) developer API for private inference with zero-access guarantees, (3) Tinfoil Containers for deploying arbitrary applications in secure enclaves with public attestation.
tinfoil.ai_play: AI infrastructure that solves the privacy-performance tradeoff by running inference inside hardware-backed trusted execution environments (TEEs). Eliminates the false choice between cloud-scale AI and on-prem privacy. Cryptographic proofs and attestation allow customers to verify that their data is never accessible to Tinfoil, cloud providers, or any third party—even during inference.

ValCtrl is the world model for Prediction Finance, and Kassandre…

ValCtrl is building the world model for Prediction Finance. Prediction markets contain useful prices about the future, but today those prices are fragmented across venues, titles, rules, and proxy contracts. Users think in beliefs; markets are stored as scattered contracts.

Our first product is Kassandre Search. Users type a natural-language belief, and Kassandre maps it to relevant prediction markets with backtrace and quality labels. Existing markets are the first scaffold. The long-term product path is search -> composed exposures -> native quotes -> gated bet/trade placement, with legal/compliance gates respected at each step.

We are looking for hard belief-to-market queries from forecasters, investors, operators, and YC founders.

valgo.name: Valgo
valgo.one_liner: Insurance risk layer for physical AI
valgo.description:
Insurance risk layer for physical AI

Insurers struggle to price autonomous systems because the historical data simply doesn't exist. Your car insurance draws from over 30 billion claims records, but autonomous trucks and robots have nearly zero. Valgo is the risk quantification platform that closes that gap. We are building probabilistic models of routes, tasks, and environments from the bottom up. We output a simulated loss estimate that insurers need to price coverage. Valgo is the foundational layer that gives insurance providers confidence to properly price autonomy risk.

Our team combines expertise in risk estimation for autonomy with deep experience in the insurance industry. Sydney and Robert are Stanford PhDs with leading expertise in safety of physical AI systems. Sydney wrote the textbook on validating safety-critical systems and teaches the course at Stanford. Robert spent 7 years at MIT Lincoln Laboratory on the core team that designed and validated an FAA-certified aircraft collision avoidance system, now a worldwide standard. Jon is a Sloan Fellow from the Stanford GSB and an actuary who spent over 12 years in insurance leadership and led over $5 billion in M&A as head of corporate development for one of the largest insurers in Asia-Pacific.

valgo.ai_play: Bottom-up probabilistic models of routes, tasks, and environments that generate synthetic actuarial data for pricing coverage on physical AI systems

Voltair is building the world's first globally distributed network of autonomous drones for Earth observation.

Utilities spend tens of billions of dollars every year just looking at their own equipment. We envision a future in which drone "instances" are requested on-demand through our platform, enabling any application builder to serve these critical markets without ever operating their own hardware.

voygr.name: VOYGR
voygr.one_liner: Real-world place intelligence for AI apps and agents
voygr.description:
Real-world place intelligence for AI apps and agents

VOYGR is a better maps API every agent and AI app will need. Google says '4.2 stars, open till 10 – VOYGR knows the chef left, wait times doubled, and locals moved on. Our intelligent local search combines accurate place data with fresh web context – news, articles, and events. We expand beyond 10-15 map attributes into infinite, queryable place profiles, enabling agents to reason and act in the real world.

Maps are no longer browsed – LLMs/agents use them to reason and act. 20M+ apps/websites, up to 40% of search queries, and 20% of LLM prompts need local context. 
10-15 attributes per place are not enough for AI. Places change constantly - restaurants close, hours change, businesses move. LLMs struggle with semantic queries “Specialty coffee shops in SF with Wi-Fi, popular with YC founders”. Agents cannot reliably “parse half the internet” - they need real-world ontology

We’re experienced builders in maps, search, and ML to solve this. Vlad knows this space inside and out – he worked on the Google Maps APIs GTM, plus firsthand customer experience from building in ridesharing and travel. Yarik has spent over a decade leading ML/search teams at Apple, Google, and Meta. 

Google Places alone is a $XXB/Yr monopoly. Agents turn it into a transactional layer opportunity for local commerce and ads.

In 3 months, we went from zero customers to Virginia's Executive Order 51, requiring all state agencies to use Vulcan.

Our initial agency partners use legal cartography to draft lawful regulations, respond to public comments on regulations, and instantly generate mandatory cost-benefit analyses.

We have both public and private sector visions.

In the public sector: we automate the entire regulatory process end-to-end; replacing the consulting industrial complex with software.

In the private sector: we automate legal tracking and regulatory compliance, tackling the $4 trillion regulatory cost on the U.S. economy.

vybe.name: Vybe
vybe.one_liner: Secure internal apps. Built by AI in seconds. Powered by your data.
vybe.description:
Secure internal apps. Built by AI in seconds. Powered by your data.

We're 2 repeat YC founders. We founded Plato (W16, sold to Coda) and Wolfia (S22). Quang lead Product/GTM for Coda Solutions and Fabien is ex-SWE at Meta and lead Engineering at Wealthfront before.

We’re building Vybe: "Lovable for internal apps". We come with pre-built building blocks: Integrations (Gmail, Gcal, Github, Jira, etc.), SSO and AI tools (Websearch, Summarization etc.) so anyone in a company can build and launch internal AI-powered apps.

Vibe coding is dramatically lowering the barrier for non-technical users to create full web apps. Lovable, Replit, Bolt, Google, Canva, Figma all launched their vibe-coding platforms. People love them. They're great for prototyping, but it's difficult to roll out inside a company for internal use cases for those reasons: 

1. Data: If you want to connect your existing data (e.g. Salesforce, Gmail, Jira), you'd need to rebuild the API auth, pagination, etc. 

2. SSO: If you build 20 apps, you'll have 20 different logins

3. Security: AI-built apps have massive risk of exposing data, especially if built by non developers

So companies are stuck in the old world: clunky spreadsheets, rigid SaaS solutions or complex no-code tools.

Time to build!

But WithAI has found the right form factor, context management, and consultative sale to help independent asset managers hold their own against the huge platforms' in-house projects. Ben and Ian became fast friends at Princeton co-founding a technology investment firm. Ben became the founding researcher at unicorn Sentient Labs, where he built LLM coordination and security tech. His contrarian conclusion: the future of work isn't just "managing agents." That form factor works for coding, but non-verifiable work is structurally different. You check whether code is good by running it. But do you check whether a stock is good by shorting it?

Fundamental equity hedge funds are elite, time-constrained, un-automatable knowledge workers in dire need of AI augmentation, so they make an ideal customer. But the combination of customization lock-in and huge ACV is not the real prize. If human knowledge work survives this decade, it will be AI-augmented. We're building that augmentation.

zenbu-2.name: Zenbu
zenbu-2.one_liner: An IDE for coding agents, shaped by the way you work
zenbu-2.description:
An IDE for coding agents, shaped by the way you work

Hi, I’m Rob, the founder of Zenbu

## The problem

Coding agents are changing how software gets built, but they also create a new kind of complexity: running several agents in parallel, reviewing changes nobody wrote by hand, verifying their work, switching contexts, and keeping track of the codebase.

## The solution

Zenbu is an IDE for managing that complexity.

It’s built on top on Pi, the minimal, customizable coding agent. Around Pi, Zenbu adds an extensible IDE where everything is a plugin, including the tools for managing agents.



That matters because every developer and company works with agents differently. Instead of forcing one workflow, Zenbu lets the best solutions get built as plugins by developers and teams with their own needs. Over time, the best ways to work with agents become part of the shared foundation everyone can build on.



## About me

I build developer tools. I co-authored React Scan, an open source tool now at 22k GitHub stars and 800k weekly installs. I also worked at Vercel, where I joined the Next.js team and built an internal development environment.

Zenbu is the IDE I wanted for working with coding agents every day.

## Asks

I’d love to hear from developers who use coding agents seriously, especially if you customize your setup.

Try it at zenbu.dev and tell me what you’d change first: rob@zenbu.dev

zenbu-2.ai_play: Abstracts away agent complexity (parallel execution, verification, context management) so developers can focus on agent workflows rather than plumbing. Plugin architecture lets teams customize agent behavior and tooling without forking. Positions Zenbu as the 'VS Code for agents' — open extensibility + commercial services.

Artificial Specialized Intelligence

We are on a mission to build the world’s most accurate, fastest, and cheapest task-specific models for every production AI system.

Most AI products, whether copilots, agents, or search systems, depend on frontier LLMs to handle every step of their pipeline. 

Yet, the vast majority of these steps are narrow, repeatable workloads: reranking, embedding, classification, routing, query rewriting, context compression, where frontier intelligence is overkill. 

Running them on general-purpose models is slow and expensive, capping what production AI can achieve. 

That is why we're building ZeroEntropy: to train small, task-specific models that replace frontier LLMs on these workloads, and empower developers to ship AI products that are more accurate, faster, and cheaper.

zeroentropy.ai_play: ZeroEntropy trains specialized models optimized for specific production tasks, eliminating the need for expensive frontier LLM inference on repetitive steps. This dramatically reduces latency, cost, and improves accuracy by replacing general-purpose models with task-optimized alternatives.
